Two figures crouch amidst a heap of discarded tallow crates, their faces smeared with lamp-black and suspicion, turning sharply as the floorboards groan beneath your boot. Before they can swing a heavy lead-lined spanner or trigger an alarm, you have to read the sudden shift in their posture and outwit their desperate scramble for the exit.

You feign a sudden shout toward the rear buffers while lunging low to block their narrow escape route under the chassis.

check.label: Outwit the scavengers in the dark

nodes.title: Cornered by the Rails
nodes.brief: You outmaneuver scavengers hiding in the dark using sharp cunning, discovering a heavy leather pouch of grease-pencils.
nodes.page:
A sudden sweep of a greasy crowbar catches your shoulder, spinning you hard against the jagged iron bracing of the chassis with a dull, ringing thud that rattles your teeth. The scavengers scramble past into the ash-fog, leaving you bruised and clutching a torn sleeve, but the engine waits with steam up and the track ahead is clear.

You pick yourself up from the ballast, nursing the ache in your arm, and press onward through the gloom.

nodes.title: A Pouch of Pencils
nodes.brief: You outmaneuver scavengers hiding in the dark using sharp cunning, discovering a heavy leather pouch of grease-pencils.
nodes.page:
Swift instincts carry you past the swinging iron bar, pinning the lead thief's arm against the framework with a sharp wrench while the other flees into the grey drift. Between the splintered crates lies a heavy leather pouch of grease-pencils, perfectly preserved and smelling faintly of linseed oil and dry cedar.

You pocket the find, securing the tools needed to mark the rail schedules in the dim cab.

nodes.title: The Hissing Valve
nodes.brief: You overhaul a rusted steam-heating valve using expert mechanics, securing a spare pressure gauge for the cab console.
nodes.page:
Steam escapes in a thin, grey plume from the junction box beneath the footplate, feathering against your shins with a hot, damp hiss that smells of old scale and boiled tallow. The isolation valve is jammed solid with lime and mineral crust, refusing to turn either way despite the heavy leather wraps on your palms.

You reach for your brass drift and small copper hammer, preparing to tap the stubborn housing back into true alignment.

nodes.title: Copper and Scale
nodes.brief: You overhaul a rusted steam-heating valve using expert mechanics, securing a spare pressure gauge for the cab console.
nodes.page:
Fine flakes of calcified lime drift downward like grey snow as the hammer meets the drift with dull, measured chinks against the iron casing. The valve spindle gives a fraction of an inch, releasing a sharp puff of superheated vapour that tastes of copper and river-mud before settling into a smooth, even rhythm.

You wipe your brow with a greasy rag and inspect the gauge connections behind the main steam header.

nodes.title: The Fractured Gauge
nodes.brief: You overhaul a rusted steam-heating valve using expert mechanics, securing a spare pressure gauge for the cab console.
nodes.page:
Brittle threads inside the brass collar resist the turn, groaning under the torque of your spanner as the hair-spring inside the old pressure dial begins to jitter erratically. If the casing shears off under pressure, the sudden blast of scalding steam will fill the cab before you can shut the main cock.

You ease off the wrench slightly, resetting your grip to coax the threaded fitting home without stripping the soft brass.

nodes.title: A Scalding Slip
nodes.brief: You overhaul a rusted steam-heating valve using expert mechanics, securing a spare pressure gauge for the cab console.
nodes.page:
The wrench slips with a sharp crack, barking your knuckles against the iron bracket while a jet of hot water spits sideways across your sleeve, leaving a dull, stinging red welt. You curse under your breath in the gloom, shutting the secondary cock with a wrench of your shoulder, but the replacement gauge is cracked and useless now.

You salvage what brass fittings you can carry and step back onto the ballast to let the steam vent clear.

nodes.title: The Spare Dial
nodes.brief: You overhaul a rusted steam-heating valve using expert mechanics, securing a spare pressure gauge for the cab console.
nodes.page:
Your fingers guide the threads home at last, seating the brass collar with a clean, airtight seal that holds against the rising pressure of the line. The spare pressure gauge settles smoothly into the cab console, its black needle steady and true against the white enamel face, ready for the long run north.

You secure the spare dial in its mounting, knowing it will keep the boiler within safe limits when the ash-storms hit.
nodes.grant: spare pressure gauge for the cab console

nodes.title: The Barons Blockade
nodes.brief: A Barons' inspection carriage blocks the main line while uniformed enforcers demand your credentials.
nodes.page: Heavy iron wheels grind against the rail-heads as a black-plated inspection carriage halts across the junction throat, its brass lamps hissing in the grey drizzle. Uniformed enforcers step down onto the ballast, their leather greatcoats smelling of ozone and ink-stamps, blocking any forward movement with crossed pikes and stamped parchment warrants. They tap the side of your cab with a silvered baton, demanding to see the engine's manifest and your personal charter before you can clear the points.

exits.label: Step down to face the enforcers

nodes.title: The Water-Seller Pit
nodes.brief: The Water-Seller's Pit: You visit the drought-stricken cistern where desperate citizens trade small items for drops of brackish water.
nodes.page: Steam rises in thin, bitter curls from the sun-baked ditch where the town's dry cistern lies exposed to the rust-laden wind. Citizens crowd the lip with cracked leather flasks and rusted pails, thrusting bits of scrap brass toward the shadowed depths where the water-seller counts every precious drop. The air tastes of copper and stale dust, and murmurs rise from people who have forgotten the sound of rain.

exits.label: Approach the jeering crowd with care
Speak quietly with the crippled merchant
Lift the fallen beam to help
Watch for hidden watchers in the dust
Stand firm against the choking drift
Turn back toward the main junction line

nodes.title: Dust and Cinders
nodes.brief: You endure the harsh insults of the desperate crowd with unbroken composure, trading an empty oil tin for a skin of bitter water.
nodes.page: Grey grit coats your tongue as you push through the press of desperate laborers, keeping your eyes fixed on the rusted rim of the empty oil tin in your hand. Someone spits a curse into the dust near your boots, but you let your shoulders drop and keep your breathing slow and even against the rising heat. The merchant takes the metal with a scarred thumb, sliding a warm skin of bitter well-water across the stained workbench.

exits.label: Carry the water skin toward the tender

nodes.title: The Weight of Silence
nodes.brief: You endure the harsh insults of the desperate crowd with unbroken composure, trading an empty oil tin for a skin of bitter water.
nodes.page: Jeers rise from the parched onlookers like steam from a neglected relief valve, hot and sharp enough to strip the skin from your temper. You stand motionless amid the press, anchoring your breathing as a ragged laborer lunges forward to knock the empty tin from your grip. Your fingers tighten on the strap while every nerve in your neck strains against the sudden urge to shove back.

check.label: Keep your breathing level and quiet

nodes.title: A Bitter Toll
nodes.brief: You endure the harsh insults of the desperate crowd with unbroken composure, trading an empty oil tin for a skin of bitter water.
nodes.page: A sudden shove catches you off balance, sending you stumbling hard against the jagged rim of a discarded coal hopper that tears a long, bleeding gouge across your forearm. The crowd jeers louder at your stumble, forcing you to surrender half your spare scrap brass just to buy a clear path through the crush. You clutch the torn sleeve to your chest, tasting copper and dust as you limp away from the jeering circle with a fresh, stinging ache.

exits.label: Retreated to the shelter of the siding

nodes.title: The Steady Hand
nodes.brief: You endure the harsh insults of the desperate crowd with unbroken composure, trading an empty oil tin for a skin of bitter water.
nodes.page: Whether through pure stubbornness or the quiet rhythm of your breathing, the hostile crowd parts just enough for you to press through without dropping your prize. The water-seller grunts a begrudging nod, sliding a sealed clay flask across the greasy counter into your palm. You tuck the cool clay against your coat, feeling the solid weight of an unexpected advantage gained through sheer steadfastness.

exits.label: Watch the red signal arm drop

nodes.title: The Merchant's Ledger
nodes.brief: You bargain with the crippled water-seller using cunning trade talk, securing a cask of clean boiler-water for the engine tender.
nodes.page: A hooded figure sits beside the dry cistern, tapping a blunt pencil against the margins of a dog-eared ledger filled with water-debt tallies. You lean against the timber frame, matching your voice to the low, rasping whistle of a distant shunt engine while you discuss the price of clean boiler-fluid. The old man squints through grease-smeared spectacles, weighing your offer against the empty barrels stacked behind his stool.

exits.label: Press the trade talk a little further

nodes.title: Brass and Brine
nodes.brief: You bargain with the crippled water-seller using cunning trade talk, securing a cask of clean boiler-water for the engine tender.
nodes.page: Words pass back and forth across the splintered desk like coins dropped into a deep coffer, measured and careful to avoid waking the sleeping tempers of the yard. The seller traces a yellowed invoice with a blackened nail, pointing toward a sealed cask tucked away in the damp shadow of the water-house. You nod once, keeping your tone level as you seal the bargain with a flick of your wrist.

exits.label: Inspect the sealed cask of water

nodes.title: The Shadow Bargain
nodes.brief: You bargain with the crippled water-seller using cunning trade talk, securing a cask of clean boiler-water for the engine tender.
nodes.page: Your fingers trace the rim of an empty grease tin while you spin a plausible tale about a broken feed-pump on the lower line, watching the old man's eyes dart toward the heavy padlock on the cask. He hesitates, his pencil hovering over a column of figures as he tries to calculate whether your story holds more truth than the Barons' patrol reports. You hold his gaze across the dusty counter, measuring the exact moment to drop your final argument.

nodes.title: A Flawed Trade
nodes.brief: You bargain with the crippled water-seller using cunning trade talk, securing a cask of clean boiler-water for the engine tender.
nodes.page: The merchant catches the slip in your arithmetic before the words have even fully left your mouth, letting out a dry, rattling laugh that draws unwanted eyes from the gangers' union post. He doubles the price on the spot, forcing you to hand over your favorite spanner just to secure a half-filled cask of cloudy brine. You hitch the foul-smelling barrel onto your shoulder, cursing your own haste as the metal bites into the ache.

nodes.title: The Clean Cask
nodes.brief: You bargain with the crippled water-seller using cunning trade talk, securing a cask of clean boiler-water for the engine tender.
nodes.page: Whether through clever phrasing or sheer good fortune, your words strike the exact note the old merchant wants to hear, unlocking a hidden latch beneath his counter. He hefts a wooden bung free with a sharp pop, revealing clear, sediment-free boiler-water that catches the pale sunlight like melted glass. You heave the heavy cask onto your shoulder, carrying away a vital prize that will keep the Marrowbone's flues clean for leagues.

exits.label: Return to the bustling junction center

nodes.title: The Fallen Beam
nodes.brief: You lift a fallen support beam to rescue a trapped water-dealer using raw brawn, earning a lasting debt of honor.
nodes.page:
Oak timbers groan under collapsed siding, trapping the old water-dealer beneath a splintered crossbeam near the dry cistern. Dust hangs thick in the air, tasting of old soot and dry rot while citizens watch from behind rusted oil drums. Stepping into the choking gap, you wedge your shoulder against the splintered pine and brace your boots in the grey ash. The wood screams against your spine, threatening to crush your ribs with every fractional inch you gain in the gloom.

With a final, lung-bursting heave, you shove the timber clear of the pinned merchant, tumbling him into safety just as the remaining roof-strut collapses into empty space. The dealer gasps for breath, pressing a greasy copper token into your palm as a solemn vow of lifelong debt.

nodes.title: Strain Against The Oak
nodes.brief: You lift a fallen support beam to rescue a trapped water-dealer using raw brawn, earning a lasting debt of honor.
nodes.page: Splintered oak pins the old water-dealer against the collapsed brickwork of the cistern wall, and the entire structure settles further into the ash with an ominous groan. You wedge your shoulder beneath the heavy crossbeam, locking your knees into the gritty gravel and feeling the dry heat radiate from the old timbers. Every muscle in your back knots as you prepare to heave against the crushing weight of the fallen roof before the remaining support pillars give way entirely. You take a sharp, soot-choked breath, plant your boots firmly in the dust, and throw your entire weight upward against the unyielding wood.

nodes.title: Crushed By The Weight
nodes.brief: You lift a fallen support beam to rescue a trapped water-dealer using raw brawn, earning a lasting debt of honor.
nodes.page: The timber slips against your sweat-slicked canvas jacket, throwing your weight sideways as the heavy oak slams back down into the ash with a bone-rattling thud. You tumble backward into the grit, gasping for breath while a sharp shard of pine slices a deep, bleeding gouge across your forearm. The water-dealer is dragged free by hurried bystanders, but you are left kneeling in the dirt with a bruised shoulder and a torn sleeve that will leak heat all the way to Cinderfall. Time slips through your fingers as you bind the weeping cut with a greasy rag, nursing your aches in the bitter dust.

exits.label: Pick yourself up and press onward

nodes.title: The Heavy Rescue
nodes.brief: You lift a fallen support beam to rescue a trapped water-dealer using raw brawn, earning a lasting debt of honor.
nodes.page: Muscle and bone strain against the ancient pine until the beam groans, shifts, and slides free of the trapped merchant with a shower of grey flakes. You manage to drag the coughing water-dealer out from the debris just as the remaining rafters collapse entirely into the empty cistern pit. He grips your wrist with a soot-stained hand, pressing a heavy brass token into your palm and swearing that any well in the township is yours to draw from whenever the thirst gets too sharp to bear.

exits.label: Return to the dry cistern hub

nodes.title: Shadows By The Cistern
nodes.brief: You spot a disguised Barons' agent lurking near the dry cistern using sharp cunning, avoiding a costly ambush.
nodes.page: Grey canvas flaps snap in the dry wind around the abandoned water stalls, masking the cautious movements of a man wearing the stiff grey coat of the Rail Barons. He pauses by a rusted pump handle, his fingers lingering near the concealed leather of a patrol ledger while he watches the crowd with cold, practiced eyes. Ducking behind a stack of empty grease-tins, you study his stance and realize he is waiting for the evening shift-change to seal off the remaining supply lines. Slipping through the narrow gap between two stranded coal tenders, you circle round his flank without a single whisper of movement in the dust.

nodes.title: Watch The Grey Coat
nodes.brief: You spot a disguised Barons' agent lurking near the dry cistern using sharp cunning, avoiding a costly ambush.
nodes.page: A man in the stiff grey wool of the Barons lingers near the dry water-tanks, his eyes scanning the gathering crowd for anyone carrying railway brass or Union papers. You press your back against the corrugated iron of a stalled freight car, tracking his movements through the gap between a grease-drum and a leaning telegraph pole. If you cross the open apron too quickly, his hand will drop to his dispatch case and every gaffer from here to the junction will know you have the Key. You wait for a gust of ash to sweep across the platform, blurring the air, and ready your stride to slip past his blind spot.

nodes.title: Spotted In The Dust
nodes.brief: You spot a disguised Barons' agent lurking near the dry cistern using sharp cunning, avoiding a costly ambush.
nodes.page: A sudden shift in the wind clears the blowing ash away from the platform just as your boot strikes a loose iron rivet, sending a sharp metallic echo rolling across the dry yard. The man in the grey coat spins round instantly, his hand snapping out to catch your sleeve and demanding your travel papers under threat of company arrest. You wrench your arm free with a sharp yank, losing your leather pouch and three precious minutes of daylight as you scramble behind a stack of discarded sleepers. You escape into the labyrinth of stalled carriages, but the Barons' agent now knows your face and your direction.

exits.label: Flee deeper into the carriage maze

nodes.title: The Unseen Passage
nodes.brief: You spot a disguised Barons' agent lurking near the dry cistern using sharp cunning, avoiding a costly ambush.
nodes.page: You time your movement with the sudden rising of an ash-squall, melting into the grey haze just as the Barons' agent turns his head toward a distant whistle. Slipping behind his patrol post, your fingers brush against a leather dispatch pouch left unattended on a nail, yielding a folded roster of company informants before he ever realizes you were there. You vanish back into the milling crowd of gangers, leaving the watcher none the wiser as he stares blankly into the swirling dust.

exits.label: Return to the dry cistern hub

nodes.title: The Bitter Cup
nodes.brief: You withstand the suffocating dust and jeers with quiet composure, securing a rusted tin cup of sediment-free water.
nodes.page: Shouting gangers crowd around the communal distribution pipe, waving empty tins and shoving for position near the last remaining drop of brackish moisture. You stand motionless in the center of the press, letting the insults and flying grit wash over your coat without a single twitch of irritation in your jaw. Your steady gaze meets the clouded eyes of the old clerk running the tap, shaming him into filling your rusted tin before the line is shut down for the evening. You take a slow, bitter sip of the sediment-heavy water, letting the cold iron taste settle your tongue while the brawlers around you exhaust themselves in the dirt.

nodes.title: The Raucous Press
nodes.brief: You withstand the suffocating dust and jeers with quiet composure, securing a rusted tin cup of sediment-free water.
nodes.page: Shouting gangers press hard against the distribution barrier, waving rusted cups and hurling curses at the clerk while the air fills with blinding yellow dust. You need a drop of clean water from the guarded tap to clear the coal-grit from your throat, but the mob is wild and ready to tear apart anyone who tries to cut the queue. Keeping your breathing slow and your hands flat at your sides, you step directly into the surging current of angry men, refusing to flinch as shoulders slam against your ribs and hot spittle lands on your collar. You must hold your ground and lock eyes with the furious clerk before he slams the iron shutter shut for the night.

check.label: Hold your ground against the mob

nodes.title: Swept In The Riot
nodes.brief: You withstand the suffocating dust and jeers with quiet composure, securing a rusted tin cup of sediment-free water.
nodes.page: A sudden surge from the back of the queue catches you off balance, knocking your tin clattering into the gravel and sending you stumbling face-first into the gritty ash. Jeers and rough laughter ripple through the gangers as you pick yourself up, your mouth tasting of dry earth and your palms scraped raw against a jagged iron rail. The distribution tap clangs shut with a definitive iron snap, leaving you with an empty tin, a throbbing jaw, and no water to wash the day's soot from your throat. You swallow the bitter dust and limp away into the gathering gloom.

nodes.title: The Unshakable Stride
nodes.brief: You withstand the suffocating dust and jeers with quiet composure, securing a rusted tin cup of sediment-free water.
nodes.page: You remain as still as an iron signal-post while the angry mob surges and curses all around you, your breathing slow and measured against the choking heat of the yard. The clerk behind the counter pauses, startled by your absolute stillness amidst the chaos, and wordlessly reaches beneath the counter to fill your rusted tin with clear, sediment-free water from his private reserve. You pocket the cup with a quiet nod, leaving the disgruntled gangers to wonder at the eerie calm that carried you through their midst.

nodes.title: The Crimson Arm
nodes.brief: The signal box above the junction drops a blood-red warning arm despite the clear track ahead.
nodes.page:
Overhead, the iron lattice of the signal box shudders under a sudden gust of sulfurous wind, and the semaphore arm snaps down with a dry, metallic clatter to paint the clear sky with a stroke of wet blood. No train should halt here on the mainline, yet the signal arm hangs across the tracks and mocks the idling breath of the Marrowbone. Thick grease drips from the pivot-pin onto the wooden ties below, pooling in the grit like dark oil. You tighten your grip on your oil-stained canvas gauntlets, squinting up through the yellow haze toward the darkened cabin windows where someone watches in silence.

The whole junction holds its breath beneath the dropping sun, waiting to see whether you will force the iron or wait for a ghost to clear the line.

nodes.title: The Elevated Control Cabin
nodes.brief: The Signal Box: You climb the creaking wooden stairs to the elevated control cabin where mechanical levers govern the yard.
nodes.page:
Greasy iron stairs climb steeply into the gloom of the signal box, where copper pipes hiss and heavy pine levers reach toward the soot-stained glass like skeletal fingers. Below, the sprawling tracks of Ashgate Junction rumble with the restless shunting of stalled goods wagons. Every movement of the overhead arms governs the iron road ahead, offering paths into the thickening dust-storms or toward the guarded switches of the yard. Faint lamplight flickers across rows of brass indicator plates that remember every train that ever passed through this dismal junction.

You can study the intricate track diagrams pinned to the back wall, seek out the maintenance catwalks overlooking the northern approach, or peer through the frosted windows toward the distant coal tipples. Weigh your next course before the yardmaster notices unauthorized boots on his boards.

exits.label: Memorize the safe night clearance codes
Hide from the approaching inspection car
Outwit the guard at the switchboard
Defend the tender from rival crews

nodes.title: Straining Against the Iron
nodes.brief: You force open a rusted interlocking lever using immense brawn, resetting the semaphore to clear your departure route.
nodes.page: Heavy grease cakes the sliding joints of the junction turnout, resisting every ounce of leverage as you throw your weight against the frozen hand-iron. Thick yellow dust settles in your hair while the rusted mechanism groans under the sudden strain, refusing to budge from the siding track. Iron filings flake off the teeth of the gear quadrant, biting into your palms through your thick leather work-gloves. You brace your boots hard against the wooden tie-beams and throw your shoulders squarely into the task once more, determined to force the stubborn latch clear.

exits.label: Shove the lever through the jam

nodes.title: Clearing the Main Line
nodes.brief: You force open a rusted interlocking lever using immense brawn, resetting the semaphore to clear your departure route.
nodes.page: A metallic shriek echoes across the ballast as the stubborn iron arm finally slips into its new slot with a satisfying, heavy thud. The semaphore blade overhead jerks sharply upright, clearing the departure signal for the Marrowbone to edge out of the choked depot sidings. Acrid coal smoke drifts past the cabin windows from an idling switcher down the line, stinging your eyes in the thin desert air. You wipe your soot-stained brow with the back of a calloused hand and step back from the smoking machinery to survey the open track.

exits.label: Heave the heavy turnout completely open

nodes.title: The Jammed Point Lever
nodes.brief: You force open a rusted interlocking lever using immense brawn, resetting the semaphore to clear your departure route.
nodes.page: Deep inside the iron housing, a rusted locking tooth binds hard against the primary slide-bar, jamming the whole assembly solid just short of the main line alignment. The whistle of an approaching Barons' inspection engine wails mournfully from the southern cutting, drawing dangerously close by the second. You plant both heels against the sleeper base, grip the cold cast-iron handle with white knuckles, and draw upon every last reserve of muscle and grit to wrench the mechanism free.

check.label: Wrench the stubborn point lever over

nodes.title: Strain and Splintered Iron
nodes.brief: You force open a rusted interlocking lever using immense brawn, resetting the semaphore to clear your departure route.
nodes.page: A sickening metallic snap echoes through the ballast as the rusted toggle shears clean off under your frantic heave, throwing you backward hard onto the sharp slag gravel. Your shoulder throbs with a dull, grinding ache and a thin line of blood trickles down your forearm from a jagged scratch on the rail flange. The heavy turnout remains half-switched, mocking your effort while the distant whistle of the inspection engine grows louder by the heartbeat. You pick yourself up from the dirt, nursing the bruised muscle and muttering a curse against the poor iron of the Gangers' Union.

exits.label: Gather your breath and scramble away

nodes.title: The Yielding Mechanism
nodes.brief: You force open a rusted interlocking lever using immense brawn, resetting the semaphore to clear your departure route.
nodes.page: Metal screams against metal before the stubborn latch yields with a shuddering thud that travels up through your boots. The semaphore blade drops into clear alignment just as the trailing smoke of the inspection engine dissolves into the yellow haze of the yard. Your muscles burn from the sudden exertion, but the iron road ahead lies open and unobstructed for the Marrowbone. You pocket a brass keeper-pin jarred loose in the struggle, proof of a job forced through by sheer muscle.

exits.label: Climb back down to the yard

nodes.title: The Signalman's Corner
nodes.brief: You stand your ground against a corrupt signalman keeping strict composure, forcing him to hand over the switch keys.
nodes.page: Stale pipe smoke and damp wool fill the small glass-walled office where the night signalman sits hunched over his grease-smeared ledger books. A single tallow candle flickers against the draft, casting long, wavering shadows across the rows of brass telegraph keys on his desk. He does not look up as your heavy boots creak across the warped floorboards, though his fingers pause mid-tap over the cold brass tapper. You stand quietly in the doorway, letting the oppressive silence weigh heavily upon him until he chooses to acknowledge your presence.

exits.label: Demand the transit token without speaking

nodes.title: The Staredown in the Cabin
nodes.brief: You stand your ground against a corrupt signalman keeping strict composure, forcing him to hand over the switch keys.
nodes.page: The old signalman narrows his rheumy eyes behind thick spectacles, trying to stare you down across the clutter of waybills and cold tea mugs. His hand twitches nervously toward the alarm plunger on the wall while his tongue darts out to wet his cracked lips. You lock your gaze on his, breathe slow against the rising heat of the tiny room, and refuse to blink or give an inch of floor. Seconds stretch thin and brittle. Only the wall clock's tick and the distant rattle of coal hoppers break them.

check.label: Hold your ground against the clerk

nodes.title: Broken Resolve
nodes.brief: You stand your ground against a corrupt signalman keeping strict composure, forcing him to hand over the switch keys.
nodes.page: A sudden gust of wind rattles the loose window panes, breaking your focus and causing you to flinch just as the old clerk lunges for the brass alarm plunger. He slams the heavy iron stop down hard, setting the junction warning bells clanging wildly across every siding in the district. You retreat from the cramped office with curses ringing in your ears, your nerves frayed and precious minutes lost to the commotion. The incident leaves you with a lingering tightness in your chest and a sharp reprimand from a passing ganger boss.

exits.label: Retreat hastily into the smoky yard

nodes.title: Unwavering Iron Nerve
nodes.brief: You stand your ground against a corrupt signalman keeping strict composure, forcing him to hand over the switch keys.
nodes.page: The old clerk's gaze finally wavers under your unblinking stare, and he lets out a dry, rattling sigh that smells of stale chicory. He pulls a heavy brass switch key from his waistcoat pocket and tosses it onto the scarred wooden desktop with a dull clink. You pocket the cold metal without a word; composure alone has bought you safe passage through the most closely guarded switch in the junction. It is a quiet victory won entirely through stillness, leaving you richer by one essential token of authority.

nodes.title: The Drafty Ledger
nodes.brief: You endure the freezing draft and flickering oil lamps with steady composure, memorizing the safe night clearance codes.
nodes.page:
Frost feathers the bottom edges of the iron window frame, turning the breath into pale puffs of smoke inside the cramped enclosure. You hunker closer to the lukewarm radiator ribs, shielding the guttering tallow dip with one calloused palm while your eyes travel down the columns of railway numbers. Every clearance code matters when the night freight starts rumbling through the junction without lights or warnings.

Outside, a loose signal wire taps a rhythmic, hollow tattoo against the rusted siding pole, keeping time with the distant shunting of coal cars. You trace the greasy ink of the midnight schedule with a fingernail, memorizing the safe intervals between heavy ore runs before the yard wakes up.

nodes.title: Holding Against the Chill
nodes.brief: You endure the freezing draft and flickering oil lamps with steady composure, memorizing the safe night clearance codes.
nodes.page: Gale-force drafts howl through the ill-fitting door seals, threatening to snuff out your only candle and plunge the small compartment into absolute darkness. The old wooden floorboards groan under sudden pressure as boots tramp up the outside stair landing and pause right outside your thin wooden partition. You force your lungs to slow, clamping your jaw tight against the shiver rising up your spine while you steady the grease-smeared ledger on your knees.

nodes.title: Caught in the Draft
nodes.brief: You endure the freezing draft and flickering oil lamps with steady composure, memorizing the safe night clearance codes.
nodes.page: The sudden lurch of the floorboards throws you hard against the corner bracket, bruising your shoulder blade and sending your tin cup clattering across the iron floor. Heavy fists hammer twice on the warped door panel before a gruff voice demands an immediate accounting of your presence in the restricted relay room. You scrape yourself up off the dirty floor, nursing a sharp ache in your arm and surrendering three precious tallow candles as a hurried bribe to the suspicious yard guard just to keep him from locking you out in the freezing sleet.

nodes.title: The Quiet Memorizer
nodes.brief: You endure the freezing draft and flickering oil lamps with steady composure, memorizing the safe night clearance codes.
nodes.page: Silence settles back over the cramped cabin like a wool blanket after those boots pass by outside. Your fingers find the folded slip of paper left wedged behind the cast-iron thermometer, containing the verified sequence of night clearance numbers for the lower valley. This scrap of ink and pulp gives you safe passage past the eastern sentinel posts without drawing unwanted questions from the station inspectors.

nodes.title: Behind the Iron Latch
nodes.brief: You maintain quiet composure while locked in the tiny cabin during an inspection, overhearing the Barons' transit schedule.
nodes.page:
Shadows stretch long and crooked across the narrow floorboards as the heavy brass inspection lamp swings back and forth in the corridor outside. You squeeze yourself flat against the inside wall of the supply locker, smelling the sharp tang of machine oil and wet flannel while boots scrape heavily on the threshold. Through the slatted louvers, you watch the Barons' transit inspector toss waybills onto the desk with careless impatience, muttering curses about missing fuel manifests and delayed coal tenders.

Every word of the official timetable drops clear into the quiet gloom as he reads aloud from his leather-bound schedule, detailing which sidings will remain clear during the upcoming midnight run toward the wall.

nodes.title: Breath Behind the Laths
nodes.brief: You maintain quiet composure while locked in the tiny cabin during an inspection, overhearing the Barons' transit schedule.
nodes.page: Heavy knuckles rap a sharp, impatient tattoo directly against the outer panel of the wooden locker where you stand wedged among spare oil cans. The inspector pauses right outside your hiding place, muttering something about a lingering draft and reaching out to rattle the brass latch with thick, calloused fingers. Your heart hammers a frantic rhythm against your ribs while you fight to keep your breathing shallow and even inside the dusty dark.

nodes.title: Rafters and Rusted Iron
nodes.brief: You maintain quiet composure while locked in the tiny cabin during an inspection, overhearing the Barons' transit schedule.
nodes.page: The latch gives with a loud metallic snap under the inspector's rough yank, and you spill onto the floorboards in a tangle of limbs and grease rags. He barks an angry curse, demanding to know your business in the private transit office before slamming a heavy iron ledger down onto your knuckles as a rough warning. You bite back a sharp cry of pain, nursing bruised fingers while he marches off down the platform to summon the yard police, leaving you poorer by a pocketknife and twenty precious minutes of lost time.

nodes.title: The Inspector's Schedule
nodes.brief: You maintain quiet composure while locked in the tiny cabin during an inspection, overhearing the Barons' transit schedule.
nodes.page: Footsteps fade down the wooden platform outside after the transit inspector finishes searching the compartment. Clutched in your palm is a discarded ticket-slip torn directly from the inspector's own working book, showing the exact timing of the armored freight trains rolling through the upper yards. This stolen scrap of routine gives you the precise hours when the heavy tracks stand clear of the Barons' patrols.

nodes.title: Slipping the Switch
nodes.brief: You outwit the cabin guard using clever cunning to slip past the locked switchboard, securing the main line clearance token.
nodes.page:
Brass gears grind softly behind the green-painted switchboard as you work a bent hairpin into the brass tumbler of the maintenance lock. The tiny latch yields with a faint, greasy click that barely rises above the telegraph wires overhead. The metal panel swings open just enough for your fingers to find the copper clearance token on its velvet-lined pegs inside the terminal box.

Dust motes dance in the amber glow of the panel light as you lift the heavy metal token free, feeling its cold weight settle into your palm like an old debt waiting to be settled.

nodes.title: Down the Dark Corridor
nodes.brief: You outwit the cabin guard using clever cunning to slip past the locked switchboard, securing the main line clearance token.
nodes.page: Floorboards creak beneath your boots as you move swiftly away from the switchboard enclosure, keeping close to the damp brick wall of the signal tower. Outside the tall arched windows, the grey light of the ash-steppe stretches toward the horizon under a low, bruised sky that smells of sulphur and wet coal dust. You tuck the heavy brass token deep inside your oilskin pocket, feeling it knock against your thigh with every purposeful stride toward the exit stairway.

nodes.title: The Sentry at the Board
nodes.brief: You outwit the cabin guard using clever cunning to slip past the locked switchboard, securing the main line clearance token.
nodes.page: Soft leather soles pad quietly around the corner of the switchboard row just as your fingers brush the cold rim of the brass clearance token inside the open panel. The night watchman halts abruptly, his hand hovering over the heavy brass alarm plunger on the mahogany desk while his sharp eyes sweep the dim interior. You freeze halfway between the open metal door and the shadowy pillar, every muscle tensing for the sudden lunge that will either secure the line or bring the yard guards down upon your head.

nodes.title: Caught in the Cogs
nodes.brief: You outwit the cabin guard using clever cunning to slip past the locked switchboard, securing the main line clearance token.
nodes.page: The watchman lunges forward with a rough shout, slamming his palm down against the brass alarm plunger and filling the dusty room with a clattering, mechanical clamor. You twist sharply to evade his clutching fingers, but your sleeve catches on a protruding iron lever, tearing a long rent in your heavy wool coat and throwing you hard against the brick pillar. By the time you wrench yourself free and bolt into the foggy night, your shoulder throbs with a dull ache and the station yard is already echoing with the shouts of pursuing gangers.

nodes.title: The Cleared Line
nodes.brief: You outwit the cabin guard using clever cunning to slip past the locked switchboard, securing the main line clearance token.
nodes.page: The watchman's hand closes on empty air as you duck low beneath the sorting table, the brass token already off its terminal peg. Your fingers close tightly around the cold metal disk, feeling the notched edges that signify unhindered passage through the lower junction switches. This heavy token grants you undisputed authority to swing the main signals whenever the Marrowbone needs a clear road through the yards.

nodes.title: The Uncoupling Crew
nodes.brief: A rival crew tries to uncouple your coal tender from the Marrowbone in the gathering dusk.
nodes.page:
Chunks of iron scrap clatter on the ash-crusted paving of the siding while two figures in grease-stiffened canvas stoop over the drawbar between the Marrowbone and her coal tender. Their wrench slips with a high, metallic shriek that cuts through the hiss of escaping steam, and one of them swears low, squinting up into the soot-stained dusk toward the footplate where you stand. The coupling pin, thick as a navvy's forearm and greased with black tallow, has already been lifted half an inch from its seating. If they drive it home, the engine will lurch forward alone into the dead-end spurs while the wagon stays behind in the shadows. Your fuel and supplies will sit at the mercy of the yard guards.

Shadows stretch over the stacked sleepers as you leap from the iron ladder. Your boots crunch into the grey ballast just as a fist reaches for the latch of the safety chain.

exits.label: Climb down to the main engine floor

nodes.title: The Engine Sheds
nodes.brief: The Engine Sheds: You return to the roaring smoky depths of the primary roundhouse for final locomotive maintenance.
nodes.page:
Black condensation drips from iron girders above the roundhouse floor, where the Marrowbone stands hissing in the soot-stained dark. Around her flank, the smell of hot grease and damp coal mixes with the distant rumble of the station clock grinding through its gears. You stand amid the silent pits where grease-traps bubble and pressure gauges twitch under flickering gaslamps. Every shadow between the stalled tenders seems to watch your next move with quiet impatience.

Steaming oil drips onto the flagged stone while the vast depot breathes its heavy, iron-lunged breath around you.

exits.label: Watch the shadows near the coal bunker
Wait until the midnight hour strikes

nodes.title: Beneath the Iron Ribs
nodes.brief: You patch a leaking steam header using precise mechanics and asbestos tape, restoring full boiler pressure for the run.
nodes.page:
Scalding mist curls from the fractured flange of the main distribution pipe, coating your leather gloves in slick, grey moisture. You wrap the heavy asbestos tape tightly around the hissing seam while tightening the brass securing bolts with a short-handled spanner. The leaking hiss subsides into a steady, rhythmic thrum as the pressure needle creeps back into the green arc.

Cool air sweeps through the rafters overhead, carrying the dry taste of distant ash from the yards outside. With the joint sealed and the gasket holding firm, the Marrowbone stands ready once more for whatever pressure the road demands.

nodes.title: The Re-pressurized Line
nodes.brief: You patch a leaking steam header using precise mechanics and asbestos tape, restoring full boiler pressure for the run.
nodes.page:
Warmth radiates through the copper lagging. You tap the pressure gauge glass with a calloused fingernail to keep the needle honest. The boiler sings its deep, low-pitched song once more, vibrating through the footplate with the promise of a long, hard haul across the steppes. A thin plume of white vapour drifts past the cab window and vanishes into the blackened rafters above.

Every valve sits square in its cradle, and the auxiliary feed pump pulses with an even, reliable beat. You wipe your hands on an oily rag and turn your gaze toward the open track waiting beyond the shed doors.

exits.label: Venture out toward the main line

nodes.title: Sealing the Fracture
nodes.brief: You patch a leaking steam header using precise mechanics and asbestos tape, restoring full boiler pressure for the run.
nodes.page: Boiling vapour lashes your wrists as you lean into the narrow gap between the firebox casing and the main steam chest, your fingers searching blindly for the blown gasket. A sudden sputter of superheated water spits from the fracture, threatening to scald your forearms if your wrench slips even a fraction of an inch against the hot iron bolt. You tighten your grip on the metal handle and draw a slow breath, aligning the fresh packing ring by touch alone in the blinding hiss.

nodes.title: Scalded and Bent
nodes.brief: You patch a leaking steam header using precise mechanics and asbestos tape, restoring full boiler pressure for the run.
nodes.page:
A sudden surge of scalding spray forces your hand aside, searing the skin of your wrist and driving a sharp curse from your throat. You stumble back into the coal bunker with a bruised shoulder, coughing against the thick cloud of white steam that fills the cramped cab. The gasket is wedged crookedly in its seat, and a thin hiss leaks out to mock your hurried efforts.

You bind the burn with a greasy rag and reach for a heavier drift-pin to hammer the stubborn seating back into true alignment. The repair holds after a fashion, though the delay costs you precious coal and leaves a dull, throbbing ache in your forearm.

nodes.title: A Tightened Joint
nodes.brief: You patch a leaking steam header using precise mechanics and asbestos tape, restoring full boiler pressure for the run.
nodes.page:
Your wrench turns the final stubborn thread with a sharp metallic squeak as the gasket beds home against the iron flange, sealing the breach cleanly at last. The violent hissing cuts off at once. Only the firebox's low-throated growl remains, and the pressure needle climbs. You wipe the sweat and grey ash from your forehead, knowing how narrowly you avoided a blown line before the journey even began.

A stout copper packing-ring drops into your palm from the ledge, cold to the touch, left behind by some vanished mechanic who knew the value of a solid fix.

exits.label: Step back to the central yard

nodes.title: Shadows in the Bunker
nodes.brief: You anticipate a sabotage attempt in the shadows using quick cunning, catching the saboteur red-handed with a heavy iron wedge.
nodes.page:
A low scrape of boot leather against slack coal alerts you just before a dark silhouette detaches itself from behind the tender's rear ladder. You freeze beside the firebox door, watching a gloved hand slide a jagged iron wedge between the motion-bars where it could jam the valve gear instantly. The intruder pauses, sensing your presence in the gloom, but has not yet turned to face the glow of the open fire-door.

The scent of stale tobacco and railway grease hangs heavy in the narrow space between the tenders. You shift your weight onto the iron floorplate, keeping your movements silent as you prepare to strike before the wedge drops.

exits.label: Spring forward to catch the saboteur

nodes.title: The Iron Wedge
nodes.brief: You anticipate a sabotage attempt in the shadows using quick cunning, catching the saboteur red-handed with a heavy iron wedge.
nodes.page: You lunge across the footplate just as the intruder's arm cocks back to hammer the iron wedge deep into the valve linkages, aiming to seize the Marrowbone's drive-wheels. Your fingers hook into the rough wool of a heavy canvas coat, twisting the fabric hard to throw the prowler off balance against the jagged edge of the coal bunker. The wedge slips from gloved fingers with a dull clatter and spins across the iron decking into the shadows.

check.label: Tackle the intruder into the coal //

nodes.title: Caught Off Balance
nodes.brief: You anticipate a sabotage attempt in the shadows using quick cunning, catching the saboteur red-handed with a heavy iron wedge.
nodes.page: The intruder twists away with surprising agility, sending your clutching hands sliding harmlessly off their coat-sleeve as you crash shoulder-first into the iron water-column. An iron wedge strikes the deck-plates with a sharp ring, lodging itself beneath the brake pedal before you can recover your footing. You curse through bruised ribs as the saboteur slips away into the smoky gloom of the coaling stage, leaving behind a torn scrap of dark wool and a jammed brake that will take precious minutes to clear.

exits.label: Drag yourself back to the roundhouse

nodes.title: The Saboteur Cornered
nodes.brief: You anticipate a sabotage attempt in the shadows using quick cunning, catching the saboteur red-handed with a heavy iron wedge.
nodes.page:
Your shoulder connects squarely with the intruder's ribs, driving the breath from their lungs in a sharp gasp and slamming them hard against the ribbed iron tender wall. The wedge slips from their failing grip with a dull thud and clatters against the footplate, well clear of the valve gear. You pin them against the cold metal until they stop struggling, catching your breath in the acrid air.

A small leather notebook tumbles from their pocket onto the steel plates, its pages filled with neat pencil tallies of every engine scheduled to cross the steppes this week.

nodes.title: The Iron Spares
nodes.brief: You heave a heavy spare wheel-set back onto the service tracks using brute brawn, earning the profound respect of the union stokers.
nodes.page:
Iron splinters cut into your palms as you hook the spare wheel-set, boots planted deep in the oily grit of the yard. Muscles cord in your forearms as you heave the dead weight upward, forcing the steel flanges back onto the rusted service tracks with a resonant clang that echoes off the signal-box. Union stokers leaning against the ash-bins stop whispering among themselves, their grime-darkened faces turning your way with slow, hard-won approval.

A streak of soot leaves your brow as you set the axle true in its chair, ready for the next shift to roll.

nodes.title: Tracks of the Union
nodes.brief: You heave a heavy spare wheel-set back onto the service tracks using brute brawn, earning the profound respect of the union stokers.
nodes.page: Iron of this size wants a strong back, so you throw your shoulder against the crooked spare wheel-set until the metal groans and rights itself on the parallel bars. Around the depot, union men pause with their shovels, nodding in grudging respect as the thick grease smears across your knuckles. No words pass between you, for the soot-stained brotherhood values labor far above talk in these dying yards. You let go of the cold flange, your breath coming hot and shallow in the chill air.

nodes.title: The Lurching Flange
nodes.brief: You heave a heavy spare wheel-set back onto the service tracks using brute brawn, earning the profound respect of the union stokers.
nodes.page: Slipped off its mount during the skirmish, the massive steel spare wheel-set wobbles precariously on the edge of the pit, threatening to tumble down and crush the hydraulic lines beneath the gantry. You drop low, setting your boots against the sleeper-ends and wedging your shoulders beneath the freezing iron lip to lever it back before the gantry supervisor spots the hazard.

nodes.title: Crushed Underfoot
nodes.brief: You heave a heavy spare wheel-set back onto the service tracks using brute brawn, earning the profound respect of the union stokers.
nodes.page: The dead weight slips despite your straining muscles, plunging down to crush your knuckles against the ballast and leaving a jagged, purple-black bruise across the bone. Pain shoots up your forearm as you stumble back into the grit, gasping for air while the heavy iron settles crookedly into the pit. You salvage your grip with a curse, nursing the throbbing hand as the union hands look away in silent pity.

nodes.title: A Union Nod
nodes.brief: You heave a heavy spare wheel-set back onto the service tracks using brute brawn, earning the profound respect of the union stokers.
nodes.page: Muscles scream and boots bite deep into the ash before the massive steel flange finally leaps back into its cradle with a dull, satisfying thud. Union stokers murmur approval through their grease-rags, acknowledging your grit with a sharp nod of respect. You shake out your aching arms, knowing the labor cost you dearly in sweat and strain, but the debt of the rails is paid.

nodes.title: Midnight on the Steppe
nodes.brief: The storm clock strikes the midnight hour as ash begins to drift across the driving wheels.
nodes.page: High on the municipal water-tower, the storm clock tolls its brass tongue through the iron girders of Ashgate Junction as midnight strikes. Fine grey ash begins to drift across the driving wheels of the Marrowbone like driven snow, hissing against the hot copper of the boiler casing. Down the line, the signal lamps flicker from green to a dull, bruised amber as the automated switches lock themselves for the night. You check the water-glass one last time, feeling the thin vibration of the approaching tempest through the wooden floorboards.

nodes.title: The Coal Stacks
nodes.brief: The Coal Stacks: You rush to top off your tender from the dwindling municipal coal reserves before the gates close.
nodes.page: Towering black mounds of municipal fuel loom against the bruised twilight, guarded by frozen gangers and shivering ticket-widows who eye your tender with hungry desperation. You must secure your furnace provisions before the loading chutes freeze solid for the night. Down the western line, distant shunting whistles shriek through the ash-mist toward the depot tracks. Across the yard, the stationmaster's private siding sits dark and silent behind rusted iron gates. Beyond the water-column, the open grey expanse of the Cinder Steppe waits under a low, choking sky.

nodes.title: Shoveling the Bunker
nodes.brief: You shovel heavy wet coal into the bunker using sheer brawn, filling the tender right to the brim before the guards arrive.
nodes.page: You shovel wet coal into the iron bunker in a rhythm as old as the rails, your back bending and straightening against the yard's biting chill. Each scoop of dark slack clatters against the steel plates, building a black mountain inside the tender before the depot guards can wander over to question your tally. Sweat cuts pale channels through the soot on your cheeks as you hurl the last heavy shovelful into the dark recess.

nodes.title: Stoking the Edges
nodes.brief: You shovel heavy wet coal into the bunker using sheer brawn, filling the tender right to the brim before the guards arrive.
nodes.page: Pushing deeper into the damp slack-heap, you drive the shovel blade home with the heel of your boot and heave another heavy load into the rising black pyramid. The Marrowbone's boiler groans softly under the growing mass, retaining heat against the bitter night wind sweeping down from the northern ranges. You level the edges with the back of the iron blade, making certain nothing spills over the side-plates before you lock the bunker hatch.

nodes.title: The Shifting Heap
nodes.brief: You shovel heavy wet coal into the bunker using sheer brawn, filling the tender right to the brim before the guards arrive.
nodes.page: A sudden slide in the damp municipal coal-stack sends a hundredweight of jagged, frozen slack cascading outward, threatening to bury the footplate controls and trap your legs against the tender wall. You brace your thighs against the bulkhead and swing your heavy iron shovel like a broadsword to beat back the sliding avalanche before it floods the deck.

nodes.title: Buried in Slack
nodes.brief: You shovel heavy wet coal into the bunker using sheer brawn, filling the tender right to the brim before the guards arrive.
nodes.page: The black cascade overpowers your stance, tumbling over your boots and pinning your shins against the iron deck with a bruising weight of jagged slack. You claw your way out of the heap with raw fingernails, coughing up coal-dust while precious minutes tick away against the storm clock. The delay leaves your shins aching and your breath burning with sulfurous grit.

nodes.title: Crown of Slack
nodes.brief: You shovel heavy wet coal into the bunker using sheer brawn, filling the tender right to the brim before the guards arrive.
nodes.page: Shovelful by shovelful, you beat the shifting black avalanche back into submission, piling the damp fuel high against the tender wall until the bunker is crowned to the very brim. The engine settles perceptibly on its springs under the massive burden, ready to devour the miles ahead. You jam the shovel into its iron rack, wiping the stinging sweat from your eyes with a soot-stained sleeve.

nodes.title: The Iron Chute
nodes.brief: You heave a massive iron coal-chute back into position using raw brawn, securing enough fuel for the grueling crossing ahead.
nodes.page: Sweat runs into your eyes as you grip the rusted locking-lever of the overhead coal-chute, bracing your boots against the ribbed steel of the tender deck. Muscles strain against frozen grease and generations of soot-cake while the iron trough groans protest, refusing to budge an inch at first. You lean your entire weight into the rusted bar, chest heaving against the cold damp air of the depot, until the retaining tooth finally slips from its notch with a sharp metallic crack. Gravity and stubborn muscle do the rest as the massive iron spout swings ponderously back into its stowed cradle above the bunker wall.

nodes.title: Clearing the Hoppers
nodes.brief: You heave a massive iron coal-chute back into position using raw brawn, securing enough fuel for the grueling crossing ahead.
nodes.page: Heavy iron rumbles overhead as you shove the massive fuel-chute back into its upright housing, locking the brass pin home against the vibration of the idling boiler. Fine coal-dust settles over your scorched forearms, mixing with sweat to form black streaks that catch the yellow flicker of the cab lamp. There is just enough anthracite in the bunker now to feed the hungry firebox through the bitter salt-flats ahead, provided the draught holds steady against the low barometer. You wipe your palms on your canvas trousers and step back onto the footplate to check the steam-gauge needle creeping upward into the green.

nodes.title: Wrestling the Sprocket
nodes.brief: You heave a massive iron coal-chute back into position using raw brawn, securing enough fuel for the grueling crossing ahead.
nodes.page: The frozen worm-gear refuses to turn, its teeth choked with grit and decades of unwashed grease from the Ashgate bunkers. You wrap both leather-bound forearms around the jammed iron handle, planting your boots squarely against the ribbed floorplate as the engine shivers beneath you. Every muscle in your back knots like old hemp rope as you throw your entire weight into the lever, praying the cast-iron tooth does not snap off in your grip and send you crashing into the coal-pile.

nodes.title: Strain and Splinter
nodes.brief: You heave a massive iron coal-chute back into position using raw brawn, securing enough fuel for the grueling crossing ahead.
nodes.page: The sprocket gives way with a vicious metal shriek, spinning backward and rapping your knuckles hard against the iron guard-rail. You hiss through your teeth, clutching your bruised hand to your chest as a sharp line of heat flares across your skin. The coal-chute drops three inches and jams solid in the crooked tracks, leaving the loading half-finished and your shoulder aching with a deep, dull throb that will follow you all the way to the border.

nodes.title: The Unyielding Lever
nodes.brief: You heave a massive iron coal-chute back into position using raw brawn, securing enough fuel for the grueling crossing ahead.
nodes.page: Iron answers only when you put everything in your chest behind it, and the stubborn chute slams home into its resting fork with a satisfying clang. Your palms sting where the rough scale bit through your work-gloves, but the task is done and the bunker is sealed against the ash-wind. As you catch your breath, an iron shackle drops from the overhead gantry, left by some long-gone ganger. Useful scrap for chaining a swinging hatch.

nodes.title: Clear the Iron
nodes.brief: You haul a stalled coal wagon off the approach tracks using heavy brawn, clearing the path for the Marrowbone's explosive departure.
nodes.page: A dead wagon blocks the departure throat, its iron axles rusted square to the rails and its timber sides bowed outward with dead slag. You brace your shoulder against the cold sideboard, boots finding purchase in the greasy ballast between the sleepers, and throw your weight forward with a grunt. The rusted wheels groan, spitting red flakes onto the grey stones, and then the whole dead weight shifts sideways, scraping off the running line with a long, metallic screech.

nodes.title: Shifting the Dead Weight
nodes.brief: You haul a stalled coal wagon off the approach tracks using heavy brawn, clearing the path for the Marrowbone's explosive departure.
nodes.page: The derailed coal wagon resists every ounce of leverage you can put into the pinch-bar, its iron flanges wedged hard against the fishplate joints. You plant your boots firmly in the frozen ash between the sleepers, muscles corded in your neck as you lean your full weight against the hickory handle. The timber frame creaks under the strain, teetering on the edge of the rail as the engine pants hot steam against your back.

nodes.title: Slag and Sprain
nodes.brief: You haul a stalled coal wagon off the approach tracks using heavy brawn, clearing the path for the Marrowbone's explosive departure.
nodes.page: The pinch-bar slips from the wet rail with a sudden jolt, sending you sprawling backward into the gritty ballast and bruising your ribs against a discarded brake-shoe. The wagon settles back onto the iron with a blunt thud, stuck as a tombstone, and you spend precious minutes dragging jacks from the tool-locker just to lift the dead axle clear.

nodes.title: The Cleared Way
nodes.brief: You haul a stalled coal wagon off the approach tracks using heavy brawn, clearing the path for the Marrowbone's explosive departure.
nodes.page: With a final, groaning heave, the derailed chassis bounces over the rail-lip and drops clear of the running line, leaving the path to the main signal open at last. Your shoulder aches where the iron bit into your coat, but the Marrowbone has a clean road out of the junction now. As you drop the pinch-bar into the tender box, you notice a greasy iron token tucked between the floorboards, stamped with the mark of the Gangers' Union - a small shield against the yard-police.

nodes.title: The Iron Threshold
nodes.brief: You pull the brass regulator and blast past the shattered signals out onto the grey expanse of the Cinder Steppe.
nodes.page: You shove the brass regulator forward until the cylinders scream and the Marrowbone leaps off her chocks with a sudden, bone-shaking roar. Ash and cinders swirl in the red wash of the firebox door as you sweep past the silent signal-boxes of Ashgate, leaving the stranded carriages and the ticket-widow far behind in the smoke. The vast, grey flatness of the Cinder Steppe opens before the snout of the boiler like an unwritten ledger, waiting under the low, bruised belly of the clouds for a train that refuses to stop.

nodes.title: The Coal Chute
nodes.brief: You heave a massive iron coal-chute back into position using raw brawn, securing enough fuel for the grueling crossing ahead.
nodes.page: Iron groans against rusted pivot-plates as you throw your entire weight into the swinging bar, muscles straining against the bitter chill of the yard. With a sudden, jarring slide, the massive coal-chute clears the obstruction and swings back into its proper seating above the tender deck. Black dust rains down into your eyes, stinging sharply, but the bunker is brimming once more with jagged fuel for the long climb ahead.

exits.label: Pulling the heavy iron latch tight

nodes.title: The Steam Header
nodes.brief: You patch a leaking steam header using precise mechanics and asbestos tape, restoring full boiler pressure for the run.
nodes.page: Kneeling on the vibrating floor-plates, you press raw palms against the hissing joint until you locate the exact hairline fracture venting live steam. Wrapping thick folds of asbestos tape around the copper pipe, you clamp the metal collar down hard with a spanner, securing the seal against the rising pressure. The shriek of escaping vapor drops to a steady, rhythmic thrum as the boiler regains its full, surging power.

exits.label: Securing the valve with a wrench

nodes.title: The Fallen Beam
nodes.brief: You lift a fallen support beam to rescue a trapped water-dealer using raw brawn, earning a lasting debt of honor.
nodes.page: Splintered timber pins the old water-seller against the side of a stranded carriage, his breath coming in shallow, rattling gasps amid the drifting soot. You wedge your shoulder beneath the heavy oak balk, gritting your teeth as splinters bite through your canvas coat, and heave upward with all your strength. The timber rolls clear into the ash with a dull thud, freeing the coughing man to clutch a grateful hand to your sleeve.

nodes.title: The Drunk Track-Hands
nodes.brief: You listen to drunk track-hands using sharp cunning to separate truth from boasts, learning where Hesper bought extra fuel.
nodes.page: Stacks of empty grease-tins rattle around the stove while the off-duty gangers argue loudly over cheap spirits and missing rations. You lean against the damp bulkhead, sifting through the boasts and hollow lies with a cool eye until a specific name cuts through the din. The mention of a clandestine ledger behind the depot office points straight toward where Hesper traded extra briquettes before vanishing into the smoke.

exits.label: Slip away into the yard shadows

nodes.title: The Fallen Beam
nodes.brief: You lift a fallen support beam to rescue a trapped water-dealer using raw brawn, earning a lasting debt of honor.
nodes.page: The old water-seller coughs ash into his sleeve as you haul him upright against the stranded carriage, one arm under his shoulders. Splinters still cling to your canvas coat from the oak balk you rolled into the ash. He keeps a grateful hand on your sleeve until his rattling breath settles enough for him to stand alone beside the dry cistern.

exits.label: Leaving the merchant to catch breath

nodes.title: The Jammed Coupling
nodes.brief: You repair a jammed vestibule coupling using solid mechanics to free an old cargo truck loaded with dry briquettes.
nodes.page: Rust and old grease lock the iron jaw of the vestibule hitch, and ordinary kicks or curses will not free it. A cold chisel goes into the seized knuckle, and you strike it hard with a hammer until the rusted pin shears clean away. The ancient cargo truck drifts back a few inches, releasing the trapped coupling and revealing a stack of dry briquettes ready for hauling.

nodes.title: The Spare Wheel-Set
nodes.brief: You heave a heavy spare wheel-set back onto the service tracks using brute brawn, earning the profound respect of the union stokers.
nodes.page: Heavy cast iron sits skewed across the dual-gauge rails, blocking the workshop spur with dead, unyielding weight. You wrap your calloused hands around the axle-tree, planting your boots firmly in the wet ballast, and strain until the veins stand out like cordage on your neck. With a metallic shriek, the massive wheel-set jumps back onto the service track, drawing low murmurs of approval from the union stokers watching from the shed.

exits.label: Nodding back to the watching crew

nodes.title: Out to the Steppe
nodes.brief: Locomotive No. 9 rumbles out of the junction onto the vast, grey expanse of the Cinder Steppe under a suffocating, low cloud.
nodes.page: Locomotive No. 9 clears the last switch-points of Ashgate and stumbles out onto the endless grey expanse of the Cinder Steppe. Low, bruised clouds press down upon the horizon where ash-dunes roll away into the soot-stained distance like frozen waves. The rails stretch thin and straight ahead into the gathering gloom, losing themselves in a landscape that swallows sound and color alike.

nodes.title: The Dead Saloon
nodes.brief: The Dead Saloon: A burned-out passenger carriage serves as a makeshift camp where stranded gangers trade old stories for grease-rags.
nodes.page: A burned-out passenger carriage serves as a makeshift camp where stranded gangers trade old stories for grease-rags and warm tea. The rusted ribs of the carriage frame arch overhead like the skeleton of some iron beast, sheltering huddled figures who watch your approach with weary, cautious eyes. Piles of discarded scrap iron and empty oil drums clutter the frozen ballast around the makeshift doors, blocking the bitter wind off the dunes.

exits.label: Step inside the rusted carriage frame
Listen to the coughing tales near the stove
Pry open the locked floor-locker quietly
Tend the sputtering boiler valves outside

nodes.title: The Card-Playing Gangers
nodes.brief: Sneak past the card-playing gangers to swipe a tin of beef fat without starting a brawl, earning an extra ration of cylinder oil.
nodes.page: Wool coats and greasy caps crowd an upturned packing crate where greasy cards slap the wood. You keep your footsteps light upon the loose ballast, slipping past the edge of the glow cast by a smoking tallow lamp. A tin of beef fat sits unguarded on a crate-corner just within arm's reach, a welcome prize if your luck holds.

exits.label: Reach out for the grease tin

nodes.title: The Cunning Move
nodes.brief: Sneak past the card-playing gangers to swipe a tin of beef fat without starting a brawl, earning an extra ration of cylinder oil.
nodes.page: You slide past the outermost circle of gangers while their eyes remain fixed upon a disputed hand of cards and a rattling mug of chicory. Your fingers stretch toward the tin of beef fat resting on the rough wooden crate, calculating the exact distance before someone looks up. A floor-board groans faintly beneath your boot-heel, drawing the sharp, sudden turn of a weathered face just inches away.

nodes.title: The Clumsy Grab
nodes.brief: Sneak past the card-playing gangers to swipe a tin of beef fat without starting a brawl, earning an extra ration of cylinder oil.
nodes.page: The tin slips from your sweating fingers with a sharp metallic clatter, spilling thick grease across the rough wooden slats of the crate. Heads snap up around the fire pit with low growls of irritation, hands dropping instinctively toward heavy spanners and iron pinch-bars. You catch the tin on the rebound and scramble backward through the low doorway, earning bruised knuckles and a chorus of curses from the angry gangers.

exits.label: Retreat back to the engine deck

nodes.title: The Greased Palm
nodes.brief: Sneak past the card-playing gangers to swipe a tin of beef fat without starting a brawl, earning an extra ration of cylinder oil.
nodes.page: Your fingers close around the cold tin just as a ganger shifts his weight, sliding away into the shadows before anyone can lift a warning hand. The prize rides useful in your pocket, smelling faintly of rendered tallow and old smoke. Stepping back out into the open air beside the track, you wipe your palms on your trousers and prepare for the next stretch of road.

exits.label: Climb back onto the running plate

nodes.title: Smoke and Spittle
nodes.brief: Listen to the old ganger's coughing tales of the Long Fire without losing your temper, gaining a warning about shifted rails ahead.
nodes.page:
Tobacco ash drifts from the corner of a ruined mail-van where an old ganger sits wheezing into a greasy woollen muffler, telling the same endless story of the Long Fire that scorched the steppes to grey gravel. His rheumy eyes fix upon your soot-stained collar while he recounts how the rails warped like ribbons in the heat, demanding an answer to every rambling complaint about lost wages and broken signals.

Patience wears thin as his phlegmy cough drags on, yet beneath the drone of his grievances lies a sharp, urgent warning about shifted rails hidden under the upcoming ash-dunes.

nodes.title: The Long Listener
nodes.brief: Listen to the old ganger's coughing tales of the Long Fire without losing your temper, gaining a warning about shifted rails ahead.
nodes.page:
Heavy silence settles over the rusted floorboards as the old man pauses, waiting to see if your strained grin will crack into open fury under the weight of his endless, pointless recollections. Every muscle in your jaw tightens against the stinging smell of cheap tobacco and stale sweat while you force your breathing to slow, nodding through another meandering anecdote about the vanished days of the Ashgate run.

The seconds stretch like hot wire, testing whether your boiling temper will spill over and ruin the chance to extract that vital warning about the track ahead.

nodes.title: A Bitter Price
nodes.brief: Listen to the old ganger's coughing tales of the Long Fire without losing your temper, gaining a warning about shifted rails ahead.
nodes.page:
Harsh words slip past your teeth before you can catch them, cutting off the old ganger's rambling tale with a sharp, stinging rebuke about his useless memory and idle complaints. He falls silent at once, spitting dark juice onto the floorboards and nursing a sudden grudge that costs you precious minutes of time you can ill afford to lose while the engine idles outside.

You leave his carriage with a hot flush of shame burning your neck and a lingering debt of bad blood heavy on your shoulders as you climb back down to the line.

nodes.title: The Greasy Warning
nodes.brief: Listen to the old ganger's coughing tales of the Long Fire without losing your temper, gaining a warning about shifted rails ahead.
nodes.page:
Controlled breathing keeps your face stone-steady through the final, rambling stretches of his story until he finally leans forward and taps a grime-blackened finger against your palm, murmuring a precise description of where the ballast gave way under the third mileage post. You tuck the valuable tip away in your mind, knowing exactly which stretch of track to ease the throttle over before the wheels can drop into a hidden sink.

The secret earns its keep as you step back out into the cold steppe air.

nodes.title: The Rusted Locker
nodes.brief: Prying open a rusted floor-locker while avoiding notice yields a heavy wrenching-bar that fits the tender hatch bolts.
nodes.page:
Shadows pool beneath the bench of the abandoned tool-shed where an iron locker sits sealed shut by decades of orange rust and stubborn neglect. Kneeling on the grit-strewn floor, you wedge your fingers into the pitted seam, working the stubborn metal back and forth until the rusted latch finally gives way with a sharp, protesting screech.

Inside lies a soot-blackened wrenching-bar of cold-hammered steel, shaped to fit the stubborn bolts of the tender hatch.

nodes.title: The Jammed Seam
nodes.brief: Prying open a rusted floor-locker while avoiding notice yields a heavy wrenching-bar that fits the tender hatch bolts.
nodes.page:
Corroded iron bites into your palms as you wrench the heavy steel bar into the narrow gap of the locker door, throwing your weight against the leverage while trying not to scrape the metal loud enough to draw the gangers from the nearby depot. The rusted hinge groans under the sudden strain, trembling on the verge of snapping clear or locking solid in a twist of jagged shrapnel.

Every nerve sings with tension as you hold the balance between a clean break and a noisy disaster that will bring boots running across the cinders.

nodes.title: A Heavy Cost
nodes.brief: Prying open a rusted floor-locker while avoiding notice yields a heavy wrenching-bar that fits the tender hatch bolts.
nodes.page:
Metal screams in the stillness as the rusted hinge suddenly shears off at an angle, catching your knuckles against the sharp edge of the frame and drawing a bright line of blood across your skin. The noise echoes too loudly across the silent yard, costing you valuable time as you freeze in place, waiting to see if the nearby gangers heard the clatter.

You nurse your scraped hand with a grimace, leaving a smear of red across the iron as you snatch the tool and retreat into the grey gloom.

nodes.title: The Clean Pry
nodes.brief: Prying open a rusted floor-locker while avoiding notice yields a heavy wrenching-bar that fits the tender hatch bolts.
nodes.page:
Steel slips smoothly into the rusted groove, and with one fluid, quiet heave, the stubborn door swings back without a single echo carrying across the yard to betray your presence among the ruins. You reach inside and lift out the tool, testing its solid balance against your palm.

The wrenching-bar is yours now, fitting the tender hatch bolts as if it were cast for them.

nodes.title: The Hungry Firebox
nodes.brief: A sudden drop in boiler pressure forces you to shovel damp sulfur-coal into the roaring firebox while the engine bucks on uneven ballast.
nodes.page:
A sudden drop in steam pressure drains the life from the gauges as the Marrowbone shudders violently on the uneven ballast, threatening to stall right here in the open grey wastes. You swing the iron fire-door wide. A blast of searing heat washes over your face as you heave damp sulfur-coal into the roaring belly of the firebox with frantic, practiced strokes.

Sparks dance in the gloom while the needle on the copper dial crawls slowly back toward the working mark, and the engine settles into a steady, throbbing rhythm once more, ready to roll on into the haze.

nodes.title: The Sulphur Sinks
nodes.brief: Sulphur Sinks: Bubbling yellow pools hiss beside the tracks, steaming with acrid fumes that coat your teeth in bitter mineral dust.
nodes.page:
Bubbling yellow pools hiss beside the tracks, steaming with acrid fumes that coat your teeth in bitter mineral dust and turn the low sky the color of old brass. The iron road forks and frays across this steaming waste, offering a choice of ruined paths where the air tastes of sulfur and ancient steam.

Stalled carriages loom through the vapors like ribs of leviathans, and every direction holds its own hazard and reward for a guard with a key to carry.

exits.label: Pick the path of the sputtering valve
Choose the route of the shifting ballast
Take the track past the scavenging trader
Follow the line of the subterranean vents
Watch the storm clock on the backhead

nodes.title: Crust and Copper
nodes.brief: Wrestling a stuck intake valve clear of sulfur crust prevents a blockage, earning a sealed flask of clean distilled boiler water.
nodes.page:
Thick yellow incrustations choke the main intake line, hardening into brittle mineral glass that threatens to starve the boiler of moisture entirely. You crouch on the rocking running plate with a short brass chisel, chipping away at the calcified sulfur deposits while the Marrowbone groans beneath your boots. Every strike sends sharp, acrid flakes stinging against your cheeks and into your hair, tasting of old matches and wet earth.

The grey expanse stretches out on all sides under the low, bruised sky, offering no shelter from the bitter wind that carries the scent of distant ash-dunes. You wipe your streaming eyes with a soot-stained sleeve and reach down to test the heavy valve-wheel, feeling it grind stubbornly against its seat.

nodes.title: The Caking Valve
nodes.brief: Wrestling a stuck intake valve clear of sulfur crust prevents a blockage, earning a sealed flask of clean distilled boiler water.
nodes.page:
Fine sulfur dust coats the exposed copper fittings in a powdery yellow pall, sticking thick to your sweating palms as you grip the wrench. The valve resists every turn, rusted solid by years of acrid steam leaks and baking desert heat from the low wastes. You throw your weight against the long iron handle, feeling the metal bite hard into your calloused palms while the engine coughs a cloud of grey exhaust.

A sudden hiss of released pressure whistles past your ear, smelling sharply of rotten eggs and boiled metal. The crust is breaking free in jagged shards, exposing the bright, scarred brass underneath.

nodes.title: Fighting the Seized Iron
nodes.brief: Wrestling a stuck intake valve clear of sulfur crust prevents a blockage, earning a sealed flask of clean distilled boiler water.
