You tumble backward against the coal-trolley, hissing through your teeth as the smell of burnt hair and ozone fills the cramped cabin. The short-circuit plunges half the gantry into darkness, drawing a storm of angry whistles from the guards who pull you out by your collar and fine you two days' water rations for sabotage.

nodes.title: The Hum of Current
nodes.brief: You rewire the station signal-box to flash an emergency recall, risking short-circuit sparks to force the guards to abandon their posts.
nodes.page: The copper switch seats itself with a deep, satisfying thud that runs straight through the floorboards and into the soles of your boots. Across the viaduct the emergency klaxon wails its false warning and draws every guard away from the lower freight gates in a blind panic. Tucked into your palm is a discarded brass contact lug picked straight from the relay floor.

nodes.title: The Dispatcher's Tongue
nodes.brief: You mimic the harsh dialect of Baronial dispatchers, risking a linguistic slip to bluff your way through the checkpoint.
nodes.page:
Gravel crunches beneath heavy boots as you step past the iron barrier, throat tight with the specific rasp of a Baronial dispatcher. Every syllable must carry the weight of authority, flat and clipped, mimicking the men who sit in warm brick offices counting rivets while the world freezes. You swallow the bitter taste of coal-dust and pitch your voice to ring against the corrugated tin of the checkpoint booth. The sentry narrows his eyes, squinting through grease-smeared glass at your soot-blackened coat, waiting for a misplaced vowel that might betray your loyalties to the line.



Leaning hard against the wooden counter, you force your jaw to stay rigid and bark out a demand for immediate track clearance.

exits.label: Step through the iron checkpoint gate

nodes.title: The Baronial Dispatch
nodes.brief: You mimic the harsh dialect of Baronial dispatchers, risking a linguistic slip to bluff your way through the checkpoint.
nodes.page:
Iron gates loom ahead under the blue bunting of the Rail Barons, and armed toll-takers lean against the brass telegraph box with bored faces. Your fingers tighten over the brass valve-key tucked inside your coat, feeling its cool weight against your ribs as you lean out from the footplate of the Marrowbone. You rasp out a string of fabricated dispatch codes, mimicking the gravelly nasal cadence of a senior Baronial line-inspector to cow the guards into dropping the barrier without checking your manifests.

Sweat beads along your hairline and runs into your eyes against the acrid soot while the guard captain squints up at your grease-stained cap, his hand drifting toward the signal horn at his hip as he weighs your crisp bureaucratic consonants against the soot on your nose.

nodes.title: A Flash of White Solder
nodes.brief: You mimic the harsh dialect of Baronial dispatchers, risking a linguistic slip to bluff your way through the checkpoint.
nodes.page: Sparks shower across your knuckles in a blinding white cascade as the circuit violently rejects your clumsy adjustment, searing deep across the skin of your wrist. A sharp, chemical smell of scorched wool and ozone fills the cramped booth as you jerk your hand back with a sharp hiss of pain. The relay box remains stubborn, its iron casing clicking shut with a finality that costs you precious minutes and leaves a weeping red welt across your forearm. You clutch the injured limb to your chest, blinking back the glare-spots dancing in your vision while the heavy boots of a patrol grow louder down the metal walkway.

exits.label: Drag yourself past the locked gate

nodes.title: The Dispatcher's Seal
nodes.brief: You mimic the harsh dialect of Baronial dispatchers, risking a linguistic slip to bluff your way through the checkpoint.
nodes.page: Iron latches drop back with a dull echoing clatter as you hold the copper relay without a slip. The sentry spits a wad of dark tobacco onto the ballast and shoves a brass-stamped waybill across the stained counter without a second glance. It is an old, ink-stained pass bearing the personal stamp of a district inspector who vanished months ago, a scrap of paper the gangers still treat as real authority. You tuck the paper into your breast pocket, feeling the cold metal of its seal press against your ribs like an unspoken promise.

nodes.title: The Crane Yard's Grip
nodes.brief: The Marrowbone shunts onto a rusted siding overhanging a thousand-foot drop while heavy crane-jaws lock onto the tender.
nodes.page: Heavy iron jaws plunge from the grey fog above, slamming onto the polished steel shoulders of the tender with a shriek of tortured metal. The Marrowbone shunts violently onto a rusted siding that hangs suspended over a thousand-foot drop into the misty canyon, rocking on her springs as the massive overhead hoisting chains take her weight. Steam screams from the ruptured exhaust lines of the gantry engines, filling the damp air with white billows that smell of hot oil and wet coal. Down below, tiny figures move along the slender catwalks, shouting commands through copper-funnel megaphones while the great crane-drums whine, hauling your engine bodily off the iron road.

nodes.title: The Gantry Labyrinth
nodes.brief: The Crane Yard: You navigate a labyrinth of swinging cargo derricks and suspended catwalks high above the misty canyon floor.
nodes.page: Iron catwalks stretch out across the misty abyss like the ribs of some ancient, stranded leviathan, vibrating constantly with the deep, mechanical heartbeat of the viaduct below. Steam hisses from unseen vent-pipes, curling around greasy handrails that slick the palms of your gloves with black condensation. Every direction offers a desperate gamble: above, the crane operators squint through greasy goggles; below, the roaring gears of the hoisting winches offer a dangerous shortcut to the lower tracks. The bitter smell of sulfur drifts up from the canyon floor, mingling with the sharp tang of hot grease from the pulleys.

exits.label: Bleed the steam brakes to slide
Pick through the chemical smog maze

nodes.title: Across the Iron Beam
nodes.brief: You stare down a nervous crane operator across a narrow beam, risking psychological fracture to force him to lower your engine.
nodes.page: A narrow I-beam spans the dizzying gap between the gantry platform and the crane cabin, slick with a fine film of grey coal-dust and freezing mist. On the far side, the crane operator stands with one hand resting on the brass control wheel, his face half-hidden behind a respirator that hisses with every shallow breath. You edge forward, boots scraping against the cold iron while the canyon wind tears at the heavy skirts of your coat. Below your heels, the drop is absolute, nothing between you and the jagged rocks a thousand feet down except a thin lattice of rusted girders.

exits.label: Step closer to the crane booth

nodes.title: Staring Down the Crane
nodes.brief: You stare down a nervous crane operator across a narrow beam, risking psychological fracture to force him to lower your engine.
nodes.page: The crane man stops turning his brass wheel, his dull eyes fixing on your soot-streaked face through the small rectangular window of his steel cabin. Neither of you moves, caught in the tense silence between the rhythmic thud of distant piston strokes and the whistle of wind through the bridge bracing. You lock your gaze onto his, refusing to blink as the cold sweat freezes on your temples, keeping your posture rigid despite the trembling in your knees. Every second on the narrow span stretches like hot wire, testing whether your nerve will hold before his does.

nodes.title: The Crane Operator
nodes.brief: You stare down a nervous crane operator across a narrow beam, risking psychological fracture to force him to lower your engine.
nodes.page:
Overhead, a massive steam-driven hoisting gantry clanks against its rusted track, suspended over a terrifying drop that plunges straight down through the latticed girders of Brasswind Viaduct into the grey mist below. A young toll-operator grips the crane's brake-lever in white-knuckled panic, eyes darting toward your engine with trembling indecision while he threatens to drop your track-sling into the void. You step out onto the narrow timber footway, locking your gaze onto his darting eyes and breathing out a slow, deliberate cloud of pipe-smoke as you force your shoulders to drop and your posture to harden into absolute stillness.

The plank beneath your boots groans under the wind, and you keep your breathing slow and even, projecting the cold authority of a man who has stared down boiler explosions and never blinked once.

nodes.title: A Fracture of Will
nodes.brief: You stare down a nervous crane operator across a narrow beam, risking psychological fracture to force him to lower your engine.
nodes.page: Your vision blurs at the edges as a sharp wave of vertigo hits you, forcing you to blink and lean heavily against the cold iron handrail with a dry sob. The crane operator catches the momentary weakness in your stance, his shoulders relaxing as he spits through the gap in his teeth and reaches for the lowering lever. A deep-seated fatigue settles into your bones, leaving your thoughts scattered like dry ash while the massive steel jaws above you drop another foot with a terrifying metallic groan. You stagger back onto the gantry grating, chest heaving and hands trembling from the strain of a standoff lost.

nodes.title: Breaking the Standoff
nodes.brief: You stare down a nervous crane operator across a narrow beam, risking psychological fracture to force him to lower your engine.
nodes.page: The operator looks away first, his shoulders slumping as he releases the tension on the brass control wheel with a dry metallic click. He mumbles something unintelligible through his respirator and jerks his chin toward the side exit, gesturing to a coil of greasy hemp rope hanging from the gantry frame. It is a rough, practical tool left behind by careless trackmen, frayed at the ends but stout enough to lash a valve shut or rig a makeshift hoist when the steam goes down. You coil the stiff rope over your shoulder, feeling its rough fibers bite through your coat as you turn back toward the waiting engine.

nodes.title: The Valve Assembly
nodes.brief: You override the hoisting winch hydraulic valves, risking a high-pressure blowout to drop the Marrowbone back onto clear rails.
nodes.page:
Steam hisses from the copper manifold, painting the rusted iron girders with thick, grey condensation. You reach past the chattering pressure gauges toward the primary hydraulic bypass. Every joint in the hoisting winch groans under the weight of the suspended track, vibrating against your palms with a low, bone-deep tremor. The greasy air smells of hot oil and burnt lime

Below the viaduct, the endless drop waits in the silent mist, offering no mercy if the lines snap. You must clear the hydraulic blockage before the pressure seals weld themselves shut forever.

nodes.title: Releasing the Pressure
nodes.brief: You override the hoisting winch hydraulic valves, risking a high-pressure blowout to drop the Marrowbone back onto clear rails.
nodes.page: Hot condensate spits from the loosened unions, stinging your knuckles and leaving greasy tracks of soot across your skin. The winch housing rattles violently as the hydraulic fluid finds a new channel, weeping out in thin, shimmering jets that evaporate instantly into the draft. You grip the iron wheel and lean into the counter-turn. The Marrowbone settles with a sharp metallic clank, its steel wheels finding the true line of the rails at last.

nodes.title: Purging the Line
nodes.brief: You override the hoisting winch hydraulic valves, risking a high-pressure blowout to drop the Marrowbone back onto clear rails.
nodes.page:
Fingers slick with grease, you spin the bleeding cock three full turns against the screeching resistance of rusted threads. The pressure needle climbs past the red line, trembling violently as superheated steam forces its way toward the ruptured valve body. A hair-thin plume of scalding white vapour shrieks into the cabin, blurring your vision and heating the cramped space like an oven

You brace your boots against the ribbed floorplate, waiting for the split second the housing either holds or shatters.

nodes.title: Scalded and Stranded
nodes.brief: You override the hoisting winch hydraulic valves, risking a high-pressure blowout to drop the Marrowbone back onto clear rails.
nodes.page: The gasket blows with the force of a pistol shot, filling the cabin with a suffocating wall of white vapour that leaves your forearms raw and weeping. You stagger back against the coal bunker, coughing dryly as the heat slowly dissipates into the damp canyon air. A jagged blister forms across your wrist and burns each time you shift your grip on the cold iron handrails. The winch settles with a crooked sigh; you are bruised and behind schedule on the grey viaduct.

nodes.title: Clear of the Hoist
nodes.brief: You override the hoisting winch hydraulic valves, risking a high-pressure blowout to drop the Marrowbone back onto clear rails.
nodes.page:
Hot metal pings and settles in the cooling silence as the winch motor finally falls dead, its iron teeth disengaging from the chassis with a dull thud. You wipe the greasy sweat from your forehead with a soot-stained sleeve, breathing in the cold air rising from the depths below. The Marrowbone rests squarely on the parallel rails, ready to roll

However narrowly you managed to drop the engine back onto clear iron, you claw back precious inches against the mounting schedule.

nodes.title: The Jammed Lever
nodes.brief: You shoulder a jammed emergency release lever, risking a crushed shoulder to free the locked crane cables manually.
nodes.page:
Heavy iron pins bind tight within the rusted quadrant, holding the emergency crane cables taut across the locomotive roof. You square your shoulders against the ribbed steel bar, feeling the cold bite of the metal through your wool coat. The entire gantry shudders as a distant gust of wind sweeps down the viaduct, rattling the suspension chains

There is no room for hesitation now, only the brute leverage of bone and muscle against dead machinery.

nodes.title: Shunting the Dead Iron
nodes.brief: You shoulder a jammed emergency release lever, risking a crushed shoulder to free the locked crane cables manually.
nodes.page:
Muscles strain to the point of tearing as you throw your full weight against the jammed emergency release lever, pressing hard into the unyielding iron. The rusted pivot refuses to budge, holding the steel cable taut like a drawn bowstring across the foggy deck. Your vision darkens at the edges with a sudden wave of vertigo, your breath coming in hot, ragged gasps

You brace your boots against the greasy deck plates, gathering every ounce of strength for one final, desperate heave.

nodes.title: Crushed and Bent
nodes.brief: You shoulder a jammed emergency release lever, risking a crushed shoulder to free the locked crane cables manually.
nodes.page:
The lever slips with a sickening crunch, pinning your shoulder against the iron bulkhead and sending a blinding shock of white pain down your arm. You bite down hard on your lip until the taste of copper fills your mouth, dragging yourself free with a dry, rattling sob. A deep purple bruise blooms across your collarbone, stiffening the muscle and making every breath feel like a knife edge

The cable snaps free a second later, whipping into the ash-dunes with a sharp crack.

nodes.title: The Lever's Release
nodes.brief: You shoulder a jammed emergency release lever, risking a crushed shoulder to free the locked crane cables manually.
nodes.page: You throw your weight against the jammed emergency release lever, trusting your shoulder to the biting friction of ungreased iron as the locked crane cables finally shudder and uncoil with a loud, metallic crack. A thick cloud of warm oil-smoke billows into your face and makes your eyes water, but the path ahead clears as the swing-arm judders into its rest. You pocket a grease-stained brass token dropped by the operator in his haste, a private pass stamped with the seal of the Viaduct Watch that should buy your silence at the lower toll-gates.

exits.label: Step through the drifting chemical fog

nodes.title: Bleeding the Brakes
nodes.brief: You bleed the steam brakes to slide the engine past the grapple hooks, risking a runaway derailment to escape the trap.
nodes.page:
Brake shoes groan against the cast-iron rims as you ease the brass release valve, letting a measured hiss of compressed air escape into the gloom. The Marrowbone begins to creep forward on the greasy rails, sliding inches at a time past the swinging grapple hooks of the toll-city gantry. Every wheel flange chatters against the check-rails

A single misjudgment will drop the tender right into the path of the Barons' patrol carriages.

nodes.title: Sliding the Margins
nodes.brief: You bleed the steam brakes to slide the engine past the grapple hooks, risking a runaway derailment to escape the trap.
nodes.page:
Frost and oil mix on the tread-plates, making every foothold treacherous as you inch the brass brake handle forward by hairbreadths. The engine's heavy pistons pulse beneath the floor, eager to bolt the moment the shoes release their grip on the wheels. Outside the narrow cabin windows, the iron claws of the gantry swing slowly in the thermal draft, missing the smokestack by a fingernail

You hold your breath, nursing the air pressure down to the exact PSI required to slide past.

nodes.title: Caught on the Grapple
nodes.brief: You bleed the steam brakes to slide the engine past the grapple hooks, risking a runaway derailment to escape the trap.
nodes.page:
A sudden drop in line pressure locks the shoes mid-slide, catching the tender's rear corner on a swinging iron grapple with a screech of tearing plate. You fight the brass wheel, but the dead weight of the engine works against you, pulling a long, ragged groove down the side of the coal bunker. Cinder dust rains down from the overhead beams like dry grey snow

You break the seal on the auxiliary tank just to keep the boilers from starving.

nodes.title: Slipping the Trap
nodes.brief: You bleed the steam brakes to slide the engine past the grapple hooks, risking a runaway derailment to escape the trap.
nodes.page:
Brake shoes release with a wet, heavy sigh, letting the Marrowbone glide smoothly through the narrow gap between the toll-house pillars just as the warning bells begin to clamor overhead. You keep your hand steady on the regulator, feeding just enough steam to maintain headway without kicking up a telltale plume of soot

However narrowly you managed to slide past the grapple hooks, the engine slips out into the open track beyond the gantries.

nodes.title: Choking Iron
nodes.brief: Thick chemical smog rolls off the viaduct floor, turning the iron track into a treacherous maze of condensation and greasy soot.
nodes.page: Thick chemical smog rolls off the viaduct floor, turning the iron track into a treacherous maze of condensation and greasy soot. Every rivet on the Marrowbone weeps yellow moisture as the heat of the boiler fights the damp draft of the lower gantries. Sulphur stings the back of your throat, and the low groaning of stressed bridge-iron vibrates straight up through the tread-plates into your boots.

nodes.title: The Smog Corridor
nodes.brief: The Smog Corridor: You creep along an enclosed maintenance tunnel choked with toxic vapors and discarded railway debris.
nodes.page: You creep along an enclosed maintenance tunnel choked with toxic vapors and discarded railway debris. Dim orange signal-lamps flicker overhead, casting long, wavering shadows across rusted grease-drums and discarded coupling-pins. The air tastes of copper and burnt hair, urging you to choose your footing with utmost care. Forward paths diverge into deeper gloom, each offering its own hazard beneath the groaning weight of the viaduct.

exits.label: Pry open the heavy floor hatch
Follow the wall toward the lower vents
Endure the leaking steam pipe directly
Confront the armored cargo convoy head-on

nodes.title: The Blocked Hatch
nodes.brief: You heave a massive iron sleeper to clear a blocked access hatch, risking a strained spine to discover a stash of rations.
nodes.page: Heavy iron ballast pins the square maintenance panel shut against the rising pressure from below. Rust flakes drift down like red snow as you wedge a pinch-bar into the warped seam and lean your entire weight against the shaft. The metal groans in protest, slowly sliding an inch to reveal a dark cavity smelling of old grease and dry biscuit-tins.

exits.label: Reach down into the dark recess

nodes.title: Rations in the Rust
nodes.brief: You heave a massive iron sleeper to clear a blocked access hatch, risking a strained spine to discover a stash of rations.
nodes.page: Fumbling inside the narrow compartment, your gloved fingers brush against grease-wrapped parcels stashed by some forgotten gangers' shift. A tin of salt pork and a spare woollen muffler come free into your grasp, offering a welcome hedge against the chill of the viaduct. You tuck the provisions inside your jacket as the distant chuffing of a stranger's engine echoes through the iron ribs.

exits.label: Return to the main corridor junction

nodes.title: Heaving the Sleeper
nodes.brief: You heave a massive iron sleeper to clear a blocked access hatch, risking a strained spine to discover a stash of rations.
nodes.page: Wedged tight between two buckled support girders, a massive iron railway sleeper blocks the only clear route to the lower inspection ladder. Muscles strain against the cold dead weight as you wedge your shoulder beneath the rusted beam and prepare to lift. Every sinew in your back twangs like a loose piano wire under the unbearable load.

nodes.title: Strained and Bruised
nodes.brief: You heave a massive iron sleeper to clear a blocked access hatch, risking a strained spine to discover a stash of rations.
nodes.page: Pain flares hot and sudden across your lower back as the sleeper slips an inch, grinding your knuckles raw against the jagged edge of the plate. You stagger backward with a sharp gasp, clutching your bruised ribs while the acrid smog fills your smarting eyes. The delay costs precious minutes and leaves a dull, throbbing ache that settles deep into your bones.

nodes.title: The Lifted Beam
nodes.brief: You heave a massive iron sleeper to clear a blocked access hatch, risking a strained spine to discover a stash of rations.
nodes.page: A tooth-rattling groan answers you. The iron beam shifts and rolls clear of the hatch with a hollow metallic clang. You catch your breath, wiping greasy sweat from your forehead with the back of a soot-stained sleeve. Beneath the displaced timber lies a brass spanner bearing the punch-mark of the Gangers' Union.

exits.label: Retrace your steps to the junction

nodes.title: The Iron Rung
nodes.brief: You steady your breathing against the lung-burning fumes, risking blacking out to maintain focus and locate the hidden maintenance ladder.
nodes.page: Acrid sulphur claws at your throat until spots dance behind your eyelids, threatening to pitch you into the dark beneath the iron plates. You clamp your teeth against the burn, forcing your ribs to expand in slow, agonizing pulls while your scorched fingers sweep the greasy brickwork of the pier. Blindly your knuckles strike cold iron, locating the riveted stiles of the narrow maintenance ladder bolted straight into the bridge's spine.

exits.label: Climb upward through the chokesmoke toward the gantry.

nodes.title: Steadying the Mind
nodes.brief: You steady your breathing against the lung-burning fumes, risking blacking out to maintain focus and locate the hidden maintenance ladder.
nodes.page: Vertigo coils in your stomach as the distant screech of grinding metal echoes up from the abyss beneath the viaduct. Your temples throb in time with the wheezing boilers, threatening to pull you down into a shivering panic as the toxic haze grows thicker. Closing your eyes against the stinging vapors, you force your lungs to take one slow, deliberate draw of the foul air.

check.label: Fight the rising panic and focus

nodes.title: Shaken and Blind
nodes.brief: You steady your breathing against the lung-burning fumes, risking blacking out to maintain focus and locate the hidden maintenance ladder.
nodes.page: Black spots dance before your eyes and your knees buckle momentarily, sending you crashing hard against a steaming intake pipe. A sharp hiss of escaping steam sears your forearm, leaving a red, angry welt that throbs beneath your damp sleeve. You cling to the ironwork until the spinning world steadies, though the near-collapse leaves your nerves frayed to breaking point.

nodes.title: A Handhold in the Smog
nodes.brief: You steady your breathing against the lung-burning fumes, risking blacking out to maintain focus and locate the hidden maintenance ladder.
nodes.page: Thick soot cakes your skin and the bitter vapors sear your chest, yet you keep your footing on the wet iron despite the dizzying void below. Your searching fingers close around a discarded brass inspection token left behind by a sympathetic toll-man, its rim notched with a secret rebate that bypasses the lower gate locks. This small wedge of salvaged metal offers a quiet passage through the lower arcades where the Baron guards rarely tread.

exits.label: Slip along the vaulted masonry toward the Smog Corridor.

nodes.title: Scalding Iron Breath
nodes.brief: You endure the suffocating heat of a leaking steam pipe, risking heat exhaustion to salvage a functional pressure valve.
nodes.page:
Superheated fog billows around your ankles, smelling of scorched oil and boiled rivets as the primary gasket fails with a prolonged, shrieked hiss. Your bare hands grope blindly through the blinding white vapor, searching for the screaming joint of the feed-pipe while the deck vibrates violently beneath your boots. Every breath singes your throat, yet you must wrench the loose collar back into alignment before the pressure drops entirely and leaves the Marrowbone stalled on the open viaduct.

Reaching deeper into the scalding fog, your fingers finally wrap around the jagged tooth of the brass valve-collar, ignoring the fierce blisters blooming across your palms as you throw your full weight against the stubborn threading.

nodes.title: The Whiteout Seam
nodes.brief: You endure the suffocating heat of a leaking steam pipe, risking heat exhaustion to salvage a functional pressure valve.
nodes.page: Sweat streams into your stinging eyes, blurring the outlines of the glowing brass union while the ambient temperature climbs past endurance and your heart hammers a frantic rhythm against your ribs. Panic threatens to seize your thoughts, whispering that one wrong twitch of the wrist will strip the thread and bathe your forearms in boiling steam. You force your breathing to slow, steadying your trembling fingers against the scorching metal as you prepare to apply the final, decisive torque to the valve-nut.

check.label: Hold steady against the scalding steam

nodes.title: Scalded and Spent
nodes.brief: You endure the suffocating heat of a leaking steam pipe, risking heat exhaustion to salvage a functional pressure valve.
nodes.page: A sudden surge of scalding mist overwhelms your grip, forcing you to jerk your hands back with a sharp gasp as the searing metal bites deep into your flesh. You collapse against the coal-tender, gasping raggedly for cool air while blisters rise across your palms and fingers, turning every subsequent movement into a dull, throbbing ache. The repair remains botched, leaking a persistent hiss of wasted steam that will cost precious time and fuel to compensate for down the line.

nodes.title: A Seared Keepsake
nodes.brief: You endure the suffocating heat of a leaking steam pipe, risking heat exhaustion to salvage a functional pressure valve.
nodes.page: Through sheer stubborn endurance, whether cleanly executed or achieved through gritted teeth and raw pain, the recalcitrant valve finally yields and spins home with a reassuring, heavy thud. The roaring hiss dies down to a manageable murmur, leaving your skin flushed and your hands smarting with fresh burns, but the pressure gauge stabilizes in the green. Clutched in your palm is the prize you salvaged from the wreckage, a small token of resilience earned from the belly of the machine.

nodes.title: Iron Against Iron
nodes.brief: A rival convoy of armored cargo carriages attempts to shunt the Marrowbone off the single-track bridge into the abyss.
nodes.page: Heavy iron buffers crash together with a teeth-rattling shock that sends loose coal sliding across the footplate as a massive armored cargo tender grinds alongside the Marrowbone. Rail Baron enforcers crowd the opposing deck, heaving shunting poles against your handrails in a brutal bid to shove your engine off the narrow single-track bridge into empty air. Sparks shower from locked wheel-flanges, illuminating grim, soot-stained faces under peaked caps as they try to force your locomotive toward the precipice. You brace your boots against the shifting deck plates, realizing that passive defense will only end in a long drop into the grey fog.

exits.label: Fight for control of the tracks

nodes.title: The Shunting Junction
nodes.brief: The Shunting Junction: You fight for control of the mechanical switch-points amidst roaring exhausts and grinding steel wheels.
nodes.page: Iron mechanisms shriek and shudder underfoot where the permanent way splits above the abyss, offering a dozen perilous paths through the roaring din of rival exhausts. Ahead lies the tangled heart of the viaduct switching station, where every lever and toggle dictates whether the Marrowbone lives to reach Cinderfall or plunges into the ash-wastes below. The enemy engine looms larger still, its cowcatcher grinding against your flanks while you weigh your next desperate move against the oncoming threat.

exits.label: Jam a crowbar in the teeth

nodes.title: Shifting the Iron
nodes.brief: You readjust the points-lever timing while wheels spin, risking a broken linkage to divert the enemy engine onto a dead-end spur.
nodes.page: Iron rods groan as you throw your shoulder against the mechanical linkage, and the rusted points grind sideways in a shower of sparks. The Marrowbone trembles; its driving wheels slip a moment on the grease-slicked rail, then catch and surge forward onto the divergent path. Below, the sheer drop of the viaduct gapes like an open mouth, reminding you that a fraction of a second's hesitation will pitch the entire train into the grey void.

nodes.title: The Divergent Spur
nodes.brief: You readjust the points-lever timing while wheels spin, risking a broken linkage to divert the enemy engine onto a dead-end spur.
nodes.page: Clanging guide-bars hammer a frantic rhythm against the frame as the engine rounds the sharp curve, leaving the main thoroughfare behind for the narrower, neglected branch. Dust and ancient soot rise in thick black billows from the neglected roadbed, coating your tongue in the dry taste of old cinders and forgotten traffic. You keep one hand locked around the brass regulator while your eyes scan the ahead rails for any sign of a blocked buffer or an ambush waiting in the gloom.

nodes.title: The Binding Linkage
nodes.brief: You readjust the points-lever timing while wheels spin, risking a broken linkage to divert the enemy engine onto a dead-end spur.
nodes.page: Jagged teeth of iron gearwork grind together with an ominous screech as you attempt to force the jammed selector lever through a warped rusted quadrant. The metal grows burning hot beneath your calloused palms, trembling violently as the strain threatens to shear the primary connecting pin clean in two. Every muscle in your back knots as you lean your full weight into the ironwork, waiting to see whether the mechanism locks true or shatters under the pressure.

nodes.title: Broken Teeth
nodes.brief: You readjust the points-lever timing while wheels spin, risking a broken linkage to divert the enemy engine onto a dead-end spur.
nodes.page: A sharp, metallic snap echoes above the roar of the boiler as the overworked linkage shears clean through, throwing you sprawling hard across the iron decking. Your shoulder throbs with a deep, grinding ache where you struck the protruding grease-box, and the jammed points remain stubbornly locked in place, refusing your command. You pick yourself up from the soot with a bitter taste in your mouth, knowing the delay has cost you dearly in both time and equipment.

nodes.title: A Victory in Iron
nodes.brief: You readjust the points-lever timing while wheels spin, risking a broken linkage to divert the enemy engine onto a dead-end spur.
nodes.page: The stubborn pins lock into alignment with a thud that climbs straight up through the soles of your boots. The mechanism settles into its housing, securing the track geometry just in time to avert disaster as the trailing wheels rumble past the junction. You catch your breath, wiping grease from your forehead, and pocket a small fragment of sheared pin as a memento of the narrow escape.

nodes.title: The False Signal
nodes.brief: You trick the rival driver into reversing too early, risking a failed bluff to cause a harmless collision that disables their locomotive.
nodes.page:
Steam hisses from the rusted brass fittings of your cab as you lean out into the stinging grit of the viaduct, watching the rival engine loom through the grey haze. Its driver peers ahead, trusting the semaphore lamps rather than the wind. You reach for the signal-wire crank, preparing to flick a false amber flag that will trick them into thinking the main track is closing down the line.

Iron wheels of the Marrowbone grind along the damp rails as you count the second to pitch your voice and shout the premature warning across the narrowing gap between the locomotives.

nodes.title: Shadows on the Bridge
nodes.brief: You trick the rival driver into reversing too early, risking a failed bluff to cause a harmless collision that disables their locomotive.
nodes.page:
Iron girders of the Brasswind Viaduct groan under the weight of passing commerce, smelling of hot grease and coal smoke. The rival locomotive drifts closer on the parallel freight track, its boiler venting a sharp whistle that cuts through the continuous roar of the high winds. You keep one hand steady on the regulator valve, ready to exploit any hesitation in the opposing driver's posture as the two iron beasts lock into a dangerous rhythmic stride.

A scatter of grey cinders rattles against your side-glass, marking the exact moment to make your move and force their hand into an early reverse.

nodes.title: A Game of Bluff
nodes.brief: You trick the rival driver into reversing too early, risking a failed bluff to cause a harmless collision that disables their locomotive.
nodes.page:
Soot-stained condensation patters on your leather cap while you lean far out over the open drop of the viaduct, waving a red flag with deliberate, maddening slowness. You project an absolute certainty into your posture, shouting a fabricated warning about a collapsed rail-bed just around the blind curve ahead. The rival driver's hand twitches toward their reversing gear, doubt flickering across their soot-grimed face as they weigh the risk of a high-speed derailment against your terrifyingly convincing performance.

You hold your breath and wait to see if they swallow the lie and throw their pistons into reverse before they notice the track ahead is clear.

check.label: bait the trap with a false warning

nodes.title: The Tangled Bluff
nodes.brief: You trick the rival driver into reversing too early, risking a failed bluff to cause a harmless collision that disables their locomotive.
nodes.page:
Too late, the rival driver spots the empty rails and lets out a furious blast of the steam-whistle, slamming their regulator forward instead of back. Their heavy iron chassis lunges sideways with a sickening screech of tormented steel, clipping the Marrowbone's side-plating and sending a shower of hot sparks across the decking. You scramble for footing as the impact jars your shoulder against the brass boiler, leaving a deep, throbbing bruise and costing you precious minutes of headway.

The rival engine roars past in a blur of grey smoke, leaving you bruised and battered on the ringing iron road.

exits.label: Regain your footing and press on

nodes.title: The Spoils of Deception
nodes.brief: You trick the rival driver into reversing too early, risking a failed bluff to cause a harmless collision that disables their locomotive.
nodes.page:
With a startled shriek of protesting metal, the rival engine takes the bait and hauls its reversing gear hard over, its wheels locking and sliding with a smell of scorched iron. The sudden deceleration causes a harmless, grinding shunt that jams their driving rods and leaves their locomotive dead and hissing across the points. You glide past them into the clear air of the viaduct, having successfully bought yourself an unhindered path toward the outer gates.

Amidst the cooling steam, you retrieve a discarded brass oil-can left behind on the junction plating, still half-full of clean machine grease.

nodes.title: Iron in the Works
nodes.brief: You wedge an iron crowbar into the switch mechanism, risking a broken arm to lock the tracks against the oncoming attackers.
nodes.page:
Shouts rise from the trailing maintenance carriage as the Rail Barons' enforcers scramble across the coal-tender toward your cab, waving spanners and iron links. You ignore their warning cries, drop low behind the protective steel lip of the tender, and search blindly with your fingers for the rusted manual switch-pin deep beneath the greasy floor plates.

The cold wind bites through your woollen coat and carries the bitter taste of sulphur and old grease as you prepare to throw the iron bar into the mechanism.

exits.label: Jam the lever into the switch

nodes.title: The Desperate Wedge
nodes.brief: You wedge an iron crowbar into the switch mechanism, risking a broken arm to lock the tracks against the oncoming attackers.
nodes.page:
Muscles strain against the unyielding bite of frozen rust as you drive the iron crowbar deep into the throat of the switch-mechanism, using your entire weight to force the heavy points over. The pursuing enforcers leap across the gap onto your footplate, their boots clattering hard against the steel decking just as the rusted locking tooth begins to groan under the sudden lateral stress.

You throw your shoulder against the bar, trusting the solid iron to hold while every tendon in your arm burns with the strain.

nodes.title: A Heavy Cost
nodes.brief: You wedge an iron crowbar into the switch mechanism, risking a broken arm to lock the tracks against the oncoming attackers.
nodes.page:
The jammed lever kicks back with brutal force, striking your forearm with a dull crack that echoes above the pounding rhythm of the cylinders. You stumble back against the water-gauge, gasping for breath as a white-hot pain flares through your arm and leaves it hanging uselessly at your side. The enforcers tumble past you into the coal-bin, swearing and scuffling, but your desperate wedge has thrown their pursuing engine onto a dead siding.

You nurse your throbbing arm while the Marrowbone rattles onward into the grey gloom.

exits.label: Endure the pain and keep moving

nodes.title: The Locked Gate
nodes.brief: You wedge an iron crowbar into the switch mechanism, risking a broken arm to lock the tracks against the oncoming attackers.
nodes.page:
With a resounding metallic crunch, the iron crowbar bites into the heart of the switch-mechanism and locks the tongue-rails dead against the pursuers' path. The enforcers' engine slams to an abrupt halt against the blocked tracks, its steam-whistle wailing in frustrated fury as you pull away into the safety of the viaduct's high arches.

Grease wiped from your brow leaves a black smear across your forehead, and you pocket an iron shackle pin the retreating crew dropped.

nodes.title: The Signalman's Ghost
nodes.brief: You anticipate the rival signalman's next lever pull, risking a misread pattern to trap their engine in a siding.
nodes.page:
High above the clattering tracks, the old gantry lanterns swing in the ash-laden wind like suspended skulls, casting long shadows across the brass-fitted control box. You study the intricate web of copper wires and weighted levers that regulate the viaduct's automated routing system, trying to discern the peculiar rhythm favoured by the nocturnal signalmen who haunt these heights.

Every pulley and counterweight seems to whisper old secrets of the line, waiting for the careless hand that misreads the night's pattern.

nodes.title: The Diverting Hand
nodes.brief: You anticipate the rival signalman's next lever pull, risking a misread pattern to trap their engine in a siding.
nodes.page:
Grime and soot coat the polished brass of the telegraph dial while you trace the thread of the main line ahead, where the tracks split toward the toll-barrens and the dark mouth of the lower cuts. You reach out toward the central brass lever, knowing that a single mistimed tug will send the Marrowbone careening into a deserted siding used for storing wrecked carriages.

The iron floor vibrates rhythmically under your boots, humming with the distant pressure of the approaching storm.

nodes.title: Reading the Iron Pulse
nodes.brief: You anticipate the rival signalman's next lever pull, risking a misread pattern to trap their engine in a siding.
nodes.page:
Fingers hovering over the notched brass quadrant, you wait for the familiar shudder in the track that signals the approach of the automatic semaphore's change. You must anticipate the exact mechanical pulse of the wire-pulls before the warning bell rings, timing your pull to divert the engine into the hidden passage beneath the toll-bridge.

The cold air smells of wet slate and ozone as you commit your weight to the handle, risking a fatal misread of the night's coded signals.

nodes.title: The Misguided Switch
nodes.brief: You anticipate the rival signalman's next lever pull, risking a misread pattern to trap their engine in a siding.
nodes.page:
The lever slips in your slick palm. The points throw a fraction of a second too late, and the Marrowbone crashes onto a rusted spur line choked with abandoned coal-tenders. A shower of sparks blinds you as the engine grinds to a halt against a dead bumper, leaving you stranded in the shadows of the viaduct's upper tiers.

You curse under your breath as you realize the time lost in reversing out of the trap will cost you dearly before the night is through.

exits.label: Back out onto the main line

nodes.title: Snaring the Rival
nodes.brief: You anticipate the rival signalman's next lever pull, risking a misread pattern to trap their engine in a siding.
nodes.page: Hot iron screams against brake-shoes while you anticipate the rival signalman's next lever pull, reading the grease-smudged pattern of the semaphore tracks just a heartbeat ahead. Your boot slams down upon the auxiliary release, locking their lumbering switcher into a blind siding of dead pig iron while the Marrowbone surges through the clearance gap. You pocket a grease-stained brass tally dropped from their fleeing cab, an official token bearing the private seal of the Rail Barons' western district.

nodes.title: The Blown Viaduct
nodes.brief: The bridge shudders as structural maintenance charges detonate ahead, carving a gaping chasm right through the iron roadbed.
nodes.page: Sudden concussion rattles the soot from the cab roof as structural maintenance charges detonate ahead, carving a gaping chasm right through the iron roadbed of the Brasswind Viaduct. Chunks of gray masonry and red-hot rivets cascade into the empty air, leaving two hundred feet of sheer drop where the mainline used to run. Steam hisses from ruptured couplings beneath the Marrowbone as you haul the heavy brass regulator hard into reverse, bringing the shuddering engine to a screaming halt mere inches from the sheared edge of the void.

nodes.title: The Severed Span
nodes.brief: The Severed Span: You stand at the edge of a blown-up rail gap where only twisted girders span the terrifying grey void.
nodes.page: Cold wind howls through the gap where the railway used to be, stirring drifts of fine gray ash against the stalled bogies. You stand at the edge of a blown-up rail gap where only twisted girders span the terrifying grey void, looking for any conceivable way to bridge the drop. Below, the rusted lattice-work of the lower spans offers narrow footings, while above, the gantry cables sway in the updraft like the rigging of a dead ship.

nodes.title: Crossing the Ribs
nodes.brief: You master your vertigo on the swaying girder bridge, risking a paralyzing panic attack to cross and secure a tow-cable.
nodes.page: Iron plates groan under your heavy boots while you master your vertigo on the swaying girder bridge, keeping your eyes fixed strictly upon the next rusted rivet ahead. A sudden gust from the ash-steppes threatens to peel your coat from your shoulders, but you press your palms flat against the vibrating web of steel until the dizziness passes like a cold sweat. Across the gap, a discarded tow-cable hangs from a gantry cleat, waiting to be hauled home.

nodes.title: Crossing the High Span
nodes.brief: You master your vertigo on the swaying girder bridge, risking a paralyzing panic attack to cross and secure a tow-cable.
nodes.page: Cold air claws at your throat as you inch across the skeletal ribs of the viaduct, your boots finding precarious purchase over a thousand feet of empty grey mist. Vertigo hits like a physical blow, tightening your chest until every breath tastes of copper and stale coal-smoke, yet you force your numb fingers to reach into the wind and lash the heavy hemp tow-cable securely around the rusted anchor-bolt before the panic locks your limbs entirely.

exits.label: Haul yourself across to the signal gantry

nodes.title: Testing the Nerve
nodes.brief: You master your vertigo on the swaying girder bridge, risking a paralyzing panic attack to cross and secure a tow-cable.
nodes.page: Cold sweat slicks your palms as you lean out over the endless drop, fingers closing around the frayed strands of the cable while the wind tears at your breath. Every muscle in your spine knots tight against the panic rising in your throat. It nearly unmans you before the iron hook can be lashed to the spar.

check.label: Master your vertigo and secure the tow-cable

nodes.title: Slipping the Footing
nodes.brief: You master your vertigo on the swaying girder bridge, risking a paralyzing panic attack to cross and secure a tow-cable.
nodes.page: Vertigo overwhelms your senses for one blinding second, sending your boots sliding off the narrow flange and leaving you dangling by your fingertips over the sheer abyss. The heavy cable whips free, striking your shoulder with a bruising blow before you manage to haul yourself upward, coughing ash and clutching a wrenched wrist that will ache for leagues.

exits.label: Crawl back to the stable deck

nodes.title: The Price of Height
nodes.brief: You master your vertigo on the swaying girder bridge, risking a paralyzing panic attack to cross and secure a tow-cable.
nodes.page: Wind-scoured girders lurch under you. You lock the connection and haul yourself back onto solid footing with trembling hands. Tucked into the greasy pocket of your canvas jacket is a heavy iron signal-token stamped with the crest of the Brasswind toll-keepers, a small token of passage that will quiet the guards further down the line.

exits.label: Clamber back down to the footplate

nodes.title: The Wire-Cutter's Silence
nodes.brief: You outsmart the demolition crew's tripwires, risking an accidental detonation to salvage undamaged steel plates for a makeshift bridge.
nodes.page: Shadows stretch long across the abandoned loading bay where the Barons left their nests of rusted wire and trip-latches, waiting for scavengers to grow careless. You crouch in the grit, breath held tight against the dust, using the flat of a grease-knife to lift each hairpin trigger just enough to slip the tension without waking the heavy explosive charges wired into the bulkhead above.

exits.label: Pry free the sound plates from the rusted deck

nodes.title: The Tripwire Maze
nodes.brief: You outsmart the demolition crew's tripwires, risking an accidental detonation to salvage undamaged steel plates for a makeshift bridge.
nodes.page: Coils of rusted copper thread the shattered timber of the gantry, linked to a nest of percussion caps taped to a dormant trench mortar. You crouch in the grit, breath shallow against the smell of old cordite and grease, measuring the precise tension of the primary wire with fingers that refuse to warm. If you snip the wrong strand or pull the anchor-peg an inch too wide, the hanging slab of boiler-plate will drop straight into the ravine, taking your bridge-iron with it. Your thumb finds the catch on the pliers, trembling as the metal bites into the salt-corroded core while the wind howls through the girders above.

nodes.title: The Premature Snap
nodes.brief: You outsmart the demolition crew's tripwires, risking an accidental detonation to salvage undamaged steel plates for a makeshift bridge.
nodes.page: A sudden spark leaps from the crude battery box, setting off a minor secondary charge that blasts a shower of hot slag across your knuckles and fills the trench with blinding smoke. You scramble backward into the girders, escaping the worst of the flash but leaving behind your primary blade and half an hour of precious daylight.

exits.label: Salvage what remains in the smoke

nodes.title: The Iron Harvest
nodes.brief: You outsmart the demolition crew's tripwires, risking an accidental detonation to salvage undamaged steel plates for a makeshift bridge.
nodes.page:
You duck the sudden lurch of the wind-scoured girders, lock the vital connection into place, and pull yourself back onto solid footing with trembling hands. Notched steel plates stack in the grit at your boots, sound enough to bridge the gap between the severed rails. In your palm sits a brass transit-token stamped with the crown and pinion of the high surveyors, cold as winter rain and marked with a private cipher that might buy a moment's grace at the toll-gates.

You slide the salvaged iron into the coal-tender alongside your shovel and wipe the black grime from your eyes, listening to the Marrowbone idle below.

exits.label: Haul the plates toward the tender

nodes.title: The Hoist Cable
nodes.brief: You jury-rig the bridge winch motor, risking an electrical shock to pull a stranded carriage across the chasm.
nodes.page: Grease slicks your palms while you drag the emergency winch cable across the rusted iron span. Below your boots, the drop through the viaduct girders reveals only the grey, swirling depths of the canyon where old boxcars lie half-buried in dry silt. Copper contacts spark blue in the damp air as you force the jammed starter lever forward to bridge the gap.

nodes.title: Sparks on the Iron
nodes.brief: You jury-rig the bridge winch motor, risking an electrical shock to pull a stranded carriage across the chasm.
nodes.page: Raw current surges through the wet casing, biting into your skin with the force of an ungrounded arc. You grit your teeth against the sudden vibration shaking the winch frame, shoving the manual gear-dog deeper into its notch while the cable groans under the strain of the stranded carriage. Sweat stings your eyes as the motor begins to whine with a high, dangerous pitch.

nodes.title: Scorched Fumes
nodes.brief: You jury-rig the bridge winch motor, risking an electrical shock to pull a stranded carriage across the chasm.
nodes.page: A blinding flash of white current leaps from the terminal block, scorching your knuckles and filling the narrow gantry with the sharp smell of ozone. You stumble back against the cold rail as the winch motor dies with a dry clank. The carriage sways half-bridged over the drop. Your fingers burn where the slag caught them, a jagged red blister mapping your haste.

nodes.title: The Bridged Span
nodes.brief: You jury-rig the bridge winch motor, risking an electrical shock to pull a stranded carriage across the chasm.
nodes.page: Sparks scatter like hot iron gnats into the abyss as the winch motor catches, holding its rhythm by a hair's breadth. The stranded carriage drags itself across the gap with a metallic screech, finally locking its wheels onto the secure rails of the viaduct deck. You wipe the black soot from your face, catching your breath in the thin mountain air while the machinery ticks cool in the gloom.

nodes.title: Heavy Wool and Brass
nodes.brief: Baronial tax-collectors board the footplate, demanding an inspection of every locker, valve, and coal bunker for smuggled goods.
nodes.page: Barons' tax-inspectors shove through the sliding cabin door in wool coats with polished brass buttons, packing the narrow footplate. Their ledgers snap open with dry, administrative finality while heavy boots scuff the coal dust on the deck plates. Every corner of the tender is probed with long iron rods, searching for untaxed tallow, hidden spirits, or the unauthorized movement of cargo across the toll-bridge.

exits.label: Face the ledger-men with steady hands

nodes.title: The Customs Office
nodes.brief: The Customs Office: You entertain greedy inspectors in the cramped cab while the firebox door remains dangerously unlatched.
nodes.page: Smoke drifts lazy from the coal box while the inspectors crowd every square inch of the cramped engine cab. The station ledger lies open on the small fold-down desk, its pages smelling of stale ink and damp wool. Every lever you touch feels hot under your palms, and the false bottom of the tool locker rests only a few inches from an inquiring brass-tipped cane.

exits.label: Bar the cabin door against them

nodes.title: Ink and Cold Iron
nodes.brief: You maintain absolute calm while an inspector eyes the false bottom, risking a nervous twitch to protect the hidden Water Key.
nodes.page: A heavy ledger drops onto the work-shelf with a dull thud that rattles the pressure gauges. The senior inspector runs a dry thumb down a column of figures, his eyes fixed on the grease-stained floorboards where your boots stand planted. Outside the narrow glass, the vast iron lattice of the viaduct stretches away into the grey haze of the valley.

exits.label: Watch the inspector turn the page

nodes.title: The Ledger's Edge
nodes.brief: You maintain absolute calm while an inspector eyes the false bottom, risking a nervous twitch to protect the hidden Water Key.
nodes.page: Thin parchment pages rustle in the draft blowing through the cab door as the inspector questions your mileage permits. You keep your balance on the metal footplates, listening to the low breath of the firebox behind its iron plate. Every word must be measured against the schedule pinned to the bulkhead.

exits.label: Answer with the official route number

nodes.title: A Watchful Eye
nodes.brief: You maintain absolute calm while an inspector eyes the false bottom, risking a nervous twitch to protect the hidden Water Key.
nodes.page: The inspector's gaze lingers on the fresh scratch marks around the floor-plate seam where the hidden Water Key rests below. Your fingers curl slowly into your palms inside your thick woollen pockets, fighting the sudden urge to shift your weight or shield the iron panel. A single dropped word or a nervous twitch will bring the brass-tipped cane down on the secret seam.

nodes.title: The Sharp Rebuke
nodes.brief: You maintain absolute calm while an inspector eyes the false bottom, risking a nervous twitch to protect the hidden Water Key.
nodes.page: A sharp rap of the brass-tipped cane catches you across the knuckles, drawing a quick hiss of indrawn air through your teeth. The inspector narrows his eyes at your momentary flinch, scribbling a harsh red mark across the margin of the shipping manifest. Hesitation costs you coal and water before they let you turn a wheel.

nodes.title: The Clean Page
nodes.brief: You maintain absolute calm while an inspector eyes the false bottom, risking a nervous twitch to protect the hidden Water Key.
nodes.page: The inspector's chalk scrapes a brief, grudging mark of clearance across the metal bulkhead before he slides his ledger back into its leather case. You keep your expression flat and neutral, watching the heavy wool coats retreat down the gantry steps toward the toll-office. The false bottom remains undisturbed beneath your boots, dark and silent in the gloom.

nodes.title: The Chalked Ledger
nodes.brief: You endure the humiliating interrogation with steady poise, risking a loss of temper to convince them you are simple gangers.
nodes.page:
Saliva tastes of copper and coal-dust as you keep your chin level, absorbing each mocking inquiry with studied dullness. The inspectors lean closer, smelling of cheap gin and oiled paper, searching your grease-stained sleeves for signs of rebellion or sharper wits. Every twitch of your eyelid is a hazard, but you force your breath into an even rhythm, playing the part of a mindless shovel-hand who knows nothing beyond damp slate.

Step back onto the iron footplate before the supervisor loses his patience entirely.

nodes.title: A Steady Pulse
nodes.brief: You endure the humiliating interrogation with steady poise, risking a loss of temper to convince them you are simple gangers.
nodes.page: The senior inspector taps his brass-headed cane sharply against your shin, hunting for a flinch or a curse under sudden provocation. Your teeth grind together until the jawbone aches, but you swallow the bitter retort rising in your throat, fixing your eyes instead on a grease-smear upon the boiler jacket. A single hot word could ruin everything and bring the whole station guard down upon the Marrowbone. You lock your fingers into your palms, keeping every muscle iron-still as the heavy brass watch ticks inside his waistcoat pocket.

nodes.title: The Stiffening Jaw
nodes.brief: You endure the humiliating interrogation with steady poise, risking a loss of temper to convince them you are simple gangers.
nodes.page: Your temper frays at the edges, and a sudden, sharp syllable slips past your lips before you can clamp them shut. The inspector's eyes narrow with sudden triumph, and he scratches a jagged surcharge across your manifest, adding a fresh debt of three days' track-laying to your ledger. The blow leaves a dull, throbbing ache behind your ear where a supervisor's sleeve brushed past, and your pride feels as thin and torn as scorched wrapping paper. Still, the Marrowbone remains yours to steer, and you force another lungful of station soot into your chest.

nodes.title: A Grudging Nod
nodes.brief: You endure the humiliating interrogation with steady poise, risking a loss of temper to convince them you are simple gangers.
nodes.page: Whether by stubborn silence or a masterstroke of dull-witted acting, the officials finally lose interest in your small miseries and turn their gaze toward the next stalled engine. You exhale a long, shuddering breath of ash-choked air as their heavy boots retreat down the metal gantry. Tucked into the greasy corner of your coat pocket rests a scrap of stamped tin, greasy with official wax.

exits.label: Return to the cab before dusk

nodes.title: The Brass Latch
nodes.brief: You physically bar the narrow cabin door against greedy hands, risking a violent scuffle to keep inspectors away from the boiler.
nodes.page:
Hands grip the edge of the cab opening, fingers digging into the teak and iron with greedy intent to haul themselves inside where the secret floor-plate hides. You drop low, set your boots squarely against the iron plates, and slam the weather-curtain down across the opening with a sharp rattle of brass rings. Shouts rise from the platform, muffled by the thick canvas and the steady, lung-filling thrum of the idling firebox.

Jam the iron pinch-bar hard behind the sliding latch.

nodes.title: Shouts Through the Canvas
nodes.brief: You physically bar the narrow cabin door against greedy hands, risking a violent scuffle to keep inspectors away from the boiler.
nodes.page:
Knuckles hammer rhythmically against the exterior wood, accompanied by demands to inspect every square inch of the coal bunker and the floor-plates below. The Marrowbone trembles beneath your boots, her internal pressure climbing as the heat builds against the sealed safety valves. You press your shoulder hard against the partition, feeling the vibration of angry fists and the scrape of brass buttons sliding along the outer plating.

Turn back to the hissing regulator valve.

nodes.title: Shoving Back the Tide
nodes.brief: You physically bar the narrow cabin door against greedy hands, risking a violent scuffle to keep inspectors away from the boiler.
nodes.page: A shoulder hits the center of the weather-curtain and strains the brass eyelets until they scream against the grain. You throw your entire weight against the timber frame, bracing your boots against a grease-slick rivet while the hinges groan under the assault from the platform outside. Every muscle in your back knots like dry hemp as you fight to keep the gap closed against the shoving hands of the toll-men.

check.label: Throw your weight against the door

nodes.title: Battered Shutter
nodes.brief: You physically bar the narrow cabin door against greedy hands, risking a violent scuffle to keep inspectors away from the boiler.
nodes.page: The timber gives way with a sickening crack, and a heavy boot kicks through the canvas, catching you square in the ribs and sending you sprawling across the coal-scuttle. A sharp, tearing pain lances through your side, leaving you gasping for cool air while grease and soot smear across your forehead. Though you managed to tumble them back before they reached the hidden floor-plate, the struggle leaves you bruised and short of breath.

exits.label: Pick yourself up from the coal

nodes.title: The Splintered Guard
nodes.brief: You physically bar the narrow cabin door against greedy hands, risking a violent scuffle to keep inspectors away from the boiler.
nodes.page: Whether by pure muscle or a lucky brace against the bulkhead, the intruders slide away down the slippery gantry with bruised fingers and curses upon their lips. You lean against the battered bulkhead, chest heaving, wiping a smear of dark engine-grease from your forehead with the back of a torn sleeve. Near the bulkhead on the floorboards sits a brass spanner someone dropped in the scramble.

exits.label: Secure the hatch against further intrusion

nodes.title: The Choking Silence
nodes.brief: Steam pressure drops alarmingly as a saboteur closes the main feed-valve, plunging the locomotive into a dangerous cold stall.
nodes.page: The steady, comforting thrum of the boiler dies away into an eerie, high-pitched whistle as the needle on the pressure dial plunges toward the red line. Frost begins to feather the edges of the sight-glass while the firebox below spits a weak, dying puff of gray smoke instead of its usual orange roar. Someone has tampered with the main feed-valve near the tender coupling, starving the belly of the beast just as the ash-storm season begins to howl against the corrugated iron roof above. The Marrowbone is going cold, her iron bones freezing in the drafty depot, and unless you crawl down into the shadows beneath the tender to clear the blocked line, the journey ends here in the dark.

exits.label: Crawl into the auxiliary boiler casing

nodes.title: The Pressure Vault
nodes.brief: The Pressure Vault: You crawl inside the auxiliary boiler casing to hunt down the hidden blockage halting the steam flow.
nodes.page:
Darkness smells of baked scale and old grease inside the auxiliary boiler casing, where the silence presses on your shoulders. Steam hisses through unseen hairline fractures, painting the curved iron plates in ghostly white ribbons of heat. Every breath tastes of iron filings and dry soot. Wire and asbestos tape sit loose beside a spring that still has give.

Your palm finds a warm rivet row. Ahead the drum narrows; the manifold shrieks behind; overhead a freight cable ticks as the elevator sways.

exits.label: Crawl deep into the iron drum
Reach back toward the shrieking manifold
Purge the injector nozzle with wire
Recalibrate the governor spring under heat
Patch the cylinder drain with tape

nodes.title: Into the Drum
nodes.brief: You keep your wits about you in the claustrophobic iron drum, risking claustrophobic terror to locate the sabotage mechanism.
nodes.page:
Narrow iron ribs press against your jacket like the ribs of a buried beast, restricting every inhalation to a shallow gasp. Rivets poke into your spine while you grope blindly along the curved floor for the source of the blockage. Heat radiates from the outer shell, turning the cramped space into a baking oven of stale air and sweat. Through the thick metal walls comes the dull, distant thrum of the viaduct far below.

You inch forward on bruised knees, fingers brushing against something jagged and unexpected tucked behind the main feed pipe. The obstruction feels solid, wedged tightly into the vital passage where the steam must flow to keep the Marrowbone alive.

exits.label: Probe deeper past the jagged obstruction

nodes.title: The Obstruction Found
nodes.brief: You keep your wits about you in the claustrophobic iron drum, risking claustrophobic terror to locate the sabotage mechanism.
nodes.page:
Grime cakes your forehead as you angle your shoulder deeper into the restricted space, forcing your trembling fingers toward the jammed valve mechanism. A thick crust of white lime and scorched scale seals the joint shut, resisting your frantic scratching with stubborn malice. The air grows unbreathable, thick with the oily reek of boiled gaskets and rust.

With one hand braced against the vibrating wall, you hook a fingernail beneath the crust and feel it give with a sharp, brittle snap. Beneath the debris, a small brass lever rests completely askew, tied down with copper wire by someone who wanted this engine stopped for good.

exits.label: Test the tension on the wire

nodes.title: Testing the Nerve
nodes.brief: You keep your wits about you in the claustrophobic iron drum, risking claustrophobic terror to locate the sabotage mechanism.
nodes.page:
Panic scratches at the inside of your throat, threatening to lock your jaw as the claustrophobic walls seem to press closer together in the gloom. You close your eyes for a single heartbeat, forcing the hot, metallic taste of fear back down into your stomach while your fingers map the intricate tangle of sabotage wire in total darkness. The slightest slip of your hand will jam the mechanism forever or tear your knuckles against the razor-sharp plate edge.

Biting your lip until copper-tasted warmth fills your mouth, you ready your fingers to untangle the snare without triggering the spring-loaded trap.

nodes.title: Tangled Fingers
nodes.brief: You keep your wits about you in the claustrophobic iron drum, risking claustrophobic terror to locate the sabotage mechanism.
nodes.page:
Sudden metal fatigue or a careless tremor betrays you, and the tensioned wire snaps back with a vicious whip-crack against your wrist. A hot line of fire flares across your skin, leaving a deep, bleeding welt that smarts fiercely in the dry air. You curse aloud, banging your shoulder hard against the overhead plate as you recoil from the snap.

Time slips away while you nurse your smarting hand in the cramped dark, catching your breath through clenched teeth. You emerge from the casing with a fresh red scar across your forearm and a bruised spirit, but the obstruction is at least cleared enough to limp onward.

nodes.title: The Clear Passage
nodes.brief: You keep your wits about you in the claustrophobic iron drum, risking claustrophobic terror to locate the sabotage mechanism.
nodes.page:
Fingers moving with practiced precision, however narrowly, you unhook the final turn of copper wire and feel the jammed valve spring back into its proper seating with a clean, satisfying thunk. A sudden rush of warm, revitalised steam floods through the newly opened channel, washing over your soot-stained face like an old friend's greeting.

You squeeze backward out of the tight iron throat, dragging yourself into the dim light of the compartment with aching muscles. Clutched in your palm is a small, heavy token of your triumph over the sabotaged machinery.

exits.label: Return to the pressure vault hub

nodes.title: Screeching Metal
nodes.brief: You steady your nerves against the terrifying screech of failing metal, risking a panic attack to restart the auxiliary pump.
nodes.page:
Shrill metallic protests ring out from the auxiliary pump like the cries of a wounded bird trapped inside the iron framing. You throw your weight against the vibrating casing, hands sliding on greasy condensation as the temperature climbs toward the danger mark. The entire bulkhead shudders with every stroke of the failing piston, threatening to tear its mountings from the floorboards.

Gritting your teeth against the rising din, you reach blindly into the machinery to find the primary release valve before the pressure vessel ruptures entirely.

exits.label: Leap across the swaying gantry path

nodes.title: Steadying the Scream
nodes.brief: You steady your nerves against the terrifying screech of failing metal, risking a panic attack to restart the auxiliary pump.
nodes.page:
Deafening shrieks fill the narrow compartment, drowning out your own racing heartbeat as the auxiliary pump threatens to shake itself to pieces. You press your palms flat against the vibrating iron, forcing your trembling muscles to lock into a rigid brace against the bucking bulkhead. Every instinct screams at you to flee the suffocating enclosure before the seal blows.

Closing your eyes against the blinding rush of hot steam, you steady your breathing and reach for the main bypass lever with absolute, freezing focus.

nodes.title: The Cost of Shakes
nodes.brief: You steady your nerves against the terrifying screech of failing metal, risking a panic attack to restart the auxiliary pump.
nodes.page:
A sudden violent heave of the bulkhead throws you sideways into a jagged corner of the iron casing, driving the wind entirely from your lungs. You slump against the coal-scuttle in a heap, gasping for air while a dark purple bruise blooms across your ribs. The pump settles down with a sullen, wheezing groan, leaving you alive but battered by the violent motion.

You pick yourself up slowly, rubbing your aching side with a grimace. The immediate danger has passed, but the cost is etched deep into your sore muscles and the lost minutes ticking away on the distant storm clock.

exits.label: Drag yourself back to the vault

nodes.title: The Unbroken Nerve
nodes.brief: You steady your nerves against the terrifying screech of failing metal, risking a panic attack to restart the auxiliary pump.
nodes.page:
Holding your breath against the searing heat, you throw your full weight onto the stubborn release lever until the screaming metal drops to a deep knock. The pump catches its rhythm once more, spitting a cloud of grey condensation into the bilge before settling into an even, dependable stroke.

You wipe the greasy sweat from your brow with the back of a soot-stained sleeve, tasting the grit of the steppes on your lips. Resting on the deck-plate near your boot, shaken loose by the vibration, lies a small relic left behind by the unknown saboteur.

exits.label: Return to the pressure vault hub

nodes.title: Clearing the Throat
nodes.brief: You purge the clogged injector nozzle with a slim wire, risking scorched fingertips to restore proper water flow to the boiler.
nodes.page:
Sulphur dust settles in the narrow gaps of the floorboards while the Marrowbone shudders against the rising gradient of the viaduct. Steam hisses from a leaky joint near the floor, smelling of boiled iron and old oil. Your fingers are cramped from the sudden wrenching strain, but the brass water-key remains heavy and cold in your coat pocket. Outside, the gantries of the Rail Barons loom through the yellow haze like ribs of dead cattle. You reach for the slim cleaning wire tucked behind the gauge lamp, testing its temper against your thumb.

The copper feed-line vibrates with a dull, hollow thrum that signals trouble within the injector assembly.

nodes.title: The Thin Wire
nodes.brief: You purge the clogged injector nozzle with a slim wire, risking scorched fingertips to restore proper water flow to the boiler.
nodes.page: Bending low beneath the grease-stained deckhead, you peer into the shadowed recess where the primary water feed meets the firebox throat. The metal is hot enough to bake skin at a hand's breadth, radiating a dry, punishing heat that parches your throat instantly. You slide the flexible wire into the narrow nozzle-opening, feeling for the crust of baked mineral scale that chokes the flow. Every jolt of the engine threatens to drive the sharp tip deep into your knuckle.

nodes.title: Testing the Brass
nodes.brief: You purge the clogged injector nozzle with a slim wire, risking scorched fingertips to restore proper water flow to the boiler.
nodes.page: Sweat runs into your eyes as you work the thin steel probe back and forth within the blindingly hot injector throat, feeling the gritty resistance of calcified salt give way only to catch harder against some stubborn slag. The engine gives a violent lurch as it strikes a warped rail-joint on the viaduct, threatening to throw your hand off-balance and weld your skin to the bronze casting. With the pressure gauge trembling near the red line, you grip the wire tighter and shove with all your weight against the blockage.

check.label: Jab the probe against the scale

nodes.title: Scored and Scalded
nodes.brief: You purge the clogged injector nozzle with a slim wire, risking scorched fingertips to restore proper water flow to the boiler.
nodes.page: A vicious hiss of scalding vapour erupts around your knuckles as the blockage shifts too fast, driving a jet of boiling water straight across the back of your hand. You jerk back with a sharp curse, clutching the stinging flesh to your chest while the Marrowbone wheezes in protest. The burn leaves a bright, blistering welt across your skin, costing precious minutes and leaving the feed-line only half-cleared. You wipe the sweat from your forehead with a soot-stained sleeve and reach grimly for the wrench again.

nodes.title: Clear Through the Core
nodes.brief: You purge the clogged injector nozzle with a slim wire, risking scorched fingertips to restore proper water flow to the boiler.
nodes.page: With a sudden, ringing snap, the calcified plug shatters inside the nozzle and washes away into the roaring firebox in a torrent of clean water. The frantic scream of the pump drops at once into a deep pulse, and the pressure needles settle back to a safe, rhythmic crawl. You pull your hand back just in time, nursing a minor scorch that throbs in time with the pistons. Tucked behind the injector flange, your fingers brush against a discarded tally-check left by a previous crew - a scrap of stamped brass bearing the private mark of the Gangers' Union.

nodes.title: The Dancing Governor
nodes.brief: You recalibrate the governor spring under intense heat, risking steam burns to stabilize the erratic engine pressure.
nodes.page: High above the clattering bogies, the engine governor whirls in its brass housing, throwing its weighted arms wide as the steam pressure climbs toward danger. The spring inside groans under the relentless tension, threatening to snap and send the cylinders running wild. You wipe soot from your eyes and eye the adjustment nut sitting squarely between two rattling steam-pipes. The heat in this corner of the cab is thick enough to taste, tasting of copper and dry coal-dust.

nodes.title: Heat on the Iron
nodes.brief: You recalibrate the governor spring under intense heat, risking steam burns to stabilize the erratic engine pressure.
nodes.page: Metal plates beneath your boots thrum with the frantic rhythm of the pistons below, sending shivers up your shins. You lean in close to the oscillating arm, timing your movements to the shudder of the deck so your fingers do not clip the spinning counterweight. The air smells sharply of scorched oil and the bitter dust of the Cinder Steppe drifting through the ventilator slats. Leather mitts on, you set your grip on the brass adjustment screw.

nodes.title: Restraining the Iron Heart
nodes.brief: You recalibrate the governor spring under intense heat, risking steam burns to stabilize the erratic engine pressure.
nodes.page: The heavy spring coils and uncoils with terrifying speed, whining like a trapped hornet as you apply the spanner to its stubborn base-nut. Every rattle of the viaduct tries to throw your wrist off the flats, and a single slip will jam the governor wide open and blow the cylinders. With your teeth clenched against the radiant heat baking your face, you throw your shoulder into the cramped casing and haul the spanner toward the locking notch.

nodes.title: The Price of Slip
nodes.brief: You recalibrate the governor spring under intense heat, risking steam burns to stabilize the erratic engine pressure.
nodes.page: The spanner slips from the greasy nut with a harsh screech, rapping your knuckles hard against the hot iron housing and leaving a dark, weeping bruise across your thumb. The governor bounces wildly, throwing a sudden surge of unmeasured steam into the chest that makes the Marrowbone leap like a startled horse. You spend long, frantic moments wrestling the throttle shut by hand to calm the beast, losing precious steam and earning a dull, persistent ache in your right arm.

nodes.title: The Quiet Pulse
nodes.brief: You recalibrate the governor spring under intense heat, risking steam burns to stabilize the erratic engine pressure.
nodes.page: The spring yields at last under your pressure, settling into a smooth, disciplined pulse as the governor arms drop back to their proper span. The engine settles into its roll, iron lungs breathing against the long climb of the viaduct. As you wipe the greasy tool clean, your eye catches a faded timetable scrawled in chalk on the back of the coal-hopper door - not for the blockade runners, but for an old coal-shuttle rumored to slip east through the mountains after the ash-storm season breaks.

nodes.title: Patching the Iron Lung
nodes.brief: You patch a cracked cylinder drain using asbestos tape, risking toxic inhalation to keep the pistons firing smoothly.
nodes.page: White dust coats your eyelashes as you unroll the stiff band of asbestos tape beside the howling cylinder. Steam escapes in erratic, shrieking bursts from the hairline fracture, superheating the air into a shimmering haze that burns your throat with every shallow inhalation. You wrap the grey fabric tightly around the vibrating iron flank, securing the frayed ends with a wire toggle while the metal beneath your palms throbs like a trapped beast.
