The hissing diminishes to a sullen murmur, but the grey fibers already shed fine, choking particles that coat your tongue in bitterness.

nodes.title: Silence in the Valve
nodes.brief: You patch a cracked cylinder drain using asbestos tape, risking toxic inhalation to keep the pistons firing smoothly.
nodes.page: Fine threads of asbestos dance in the hot updraft as you press your palms against the vibrating brass housing, listening for the internal rhythm of the piston. A sudden shudder rattles the entire assembly, threatening to tear your makeshift binding away before the adhesive sets in the heat. Your fingers hover over the toggle, balancing the need for absolute tightness against the risk of cracking the casting altogether. You draw a careful breath through your teeth, steadying your wrists against the bucking iron frame as the pressure gauge ticks upward into the red.

nodes.title: The Price of Haste
nodes.brief: You patch a cracked cylinder drain using asbestos tape, risking toxic inhalation to keep the pistons firing smoothly.
nodes.page: The wrench slips on the greasy housing with a sharp metallic clatter, sending a jolt of raw pain up your forearm as your elbow smacks hard against the running board. A fresh gust of superheated steam billows from the widening split, scalding your knuckles and leaving a angry, red welt across the back of your hand. You cough violently, tasting copper and bitter grey dust as your vision blurs momentarily from the toxic fumes. The Marrowbone shudders under your boots, demanding attention you can ill afford while the clock ticks inexorably toward the ash-storms.

exits.label: Wipe the ash from your eyes

nodes.title: A Tighter Seal
nodes.brief: You patch a cracked cylinder drain using asbestos tape, risking toxic inhalation to keep the pistons firing smoothly.
nodes.page: Stubborn pressure fights your grip every inch of the way, but the wrench holds true as the final turn bites deep into the cast iron. Escaping steam loses its shrill whistle and settles into a rhythmic breath that smells faintly of scorched hemp and oil. You wipe the sweat from your forehead with a soot-stained sleeve, leaving a dark streak across your brow. That small victory buys you precious moments of engine health, though the lingering taste of asbestos will stay with you long after the journey ends.

nodes.title: Suspended Over the Void
nodes.brief: A massive freight elevator halts midway between viaduct tiers, trapping the Marrowbone on a swaying platform over empty space.
nodes.page: Iron girders push out of the yellow smog. The great freight elevator shudders to a halt halfway between the viaduct tiers. Below the dangling platform, the grey expanse of the lower levels drops away into a bottomless throat of mist and rusted lattice-work. The Marrowbone rests precariously on the vibrating iron deck, its firebox rumbling a low, discontented bass note that sets the suspension springs whining. Above you the hoisting chains groan under the asymmetrical load, and the whole platform swings in a slow, sickening arc over empty air. Rail Baron patrol lanterns flicker on the distant gantries, casting long, accusing shadows across the soot-stained cables.

exits.label: Step out onto the swaying platform

nodes.title: The Hoisting Abyss
nodes.brief: The Lift Platform: You survey the precarious hoisting machinery dangling over the misty chasm with no visible means of descent.
nodes.page: Rust flakes drift like dark snow into the grey nothingness surrounding the stranded platform, where four distinct paths offer uncertain escape from the dangling cage. A rusted access ladder snakes upward into the gloom toward the upper gantry, while a narrow service catwalk hugs the sheer rock face toward the mountain roots. Across the gap, a heavy maintenance cable sways invitingly in the updraft, and a sealed iron bulkhead bears the fresh weld marks of Baron enforcers. Each way forward costs nerve and muscle, and the structural groans beneath the engine grow louder by the heartbeat.

exits.label: Scramble across the swaying maintenance cable
Force the newly welded iron bulkhead

nodes.title: Wrestling the Drum
nodes.brief: You heave against the rusted brake drum with all your might, risking a muscle tear to manually lower the heavy platform.
nodes.page: Heavy iron teeth grind together as you throw your weight against the frozen spokes of the emergency brake drum, calling upon every reserve of strength left in your aching shoulders. The drum refuses to budge at first, rusted solid by decades of damp ash and neglect, while the lift platform gives a sudden, alarming tilt toward the precipice. You brace your boots against the riveted deck plating, lean your entire body into the iron wheel, and feel the stubborn mechanism give a fraction of an inch with a deafening screech of tormented metal.

exits.label: Throw your weight into the spin

nodes.title: The Turning Point
nodes.brief: You heave against the rusted brake drum with all your might, risking a muscle tear to manually lower the heavy platform.
nodes.page: Rust scales rain down onto your shoulders as you strain against the frozen iron spokes, feeling the muscles in your back stretch to their absolute limit. The brake drum groans a high, protesting shriek, teetering right on the edge between holding fast and stripping its ancient gears entirely. Your palms slip slightly on the greasy metal rim, and you must decide whether to commit everything to a final, violent heave or risk losing the entire descent. The drop below waits in absolute silence, save for the ticking of the cooling firebox.

nodes.title: Strained Sinews
nodes.brief: You heave against the rusted brake drum with all your might, risking a muscle tear to manually lower the heavy platform.
nodes.page: A sharp, tearing pain lances through your shoulder as the wheel spins backward with brutal velocity, throwing you hard against the riveted guard rail. Your breath leaves your lungs in a ragged gasp, and a dull, throbbing ache settles deep into your shoulder joint, reminding you of the cost of forcing dead iron. The platform drops a sudden, stomach-churning foot before the emergency dogs finally catch, leaving you dangling and breathless in the dark smog.

exits.label: Drag yourself back to your feet

nodes.title: The Sprocket Yields
nodes.brief: You heave against the rusted brake drum with all your might, risking a muscle tear to manually lower the heavy platform.
nodes.page: Iron teeth engage with a satisfying, deep-throated thud as the heavy platform begins its controlled descent into the gloom. The screech of the brake drum settles into a steady, rhythmic mechanical purr that vibrates pleasantly through the soles of your boots. You flex your aching fingers, feeling the familiar burn of honest work in your muscles as the misty tiers of the viaduct slide past your window. That hard-won mechanical advantage leaves you bruised but functional, ready for whatever lies waiting in the iron corridors ahead.

nodes.title: Hanging in the Grist
nodes.brief: You steady your breathing while hanging off the edge of the lift frame, risking a dizzy spell to secure the dangling safety chains.
nodes.page: Cold grease coats your palms as you dangle over the abyss of the viaduct drop, the wind howling through the massive riveted girders of the Brasswind span. Metal groans in protest beneath your boots while you fight to regain your breath in the thin, soot-choked air. Below, the toy-sized carts of the toll-city crawl along their tracks like beetles beneath a boot. Every muscle trembles from the sudden jolt of the platform, demanding that you anchor yourself before the swinging chains catch you off guard.

exits.label: Secure the dangling heavy safety chains

nodes.title: Silence on the Spans
nodes.brief: You steady your breathing while hanging off the edge of the lift frame, risking a dizzy spell to secure the dangling safety chains.
nodes.page: Fingers aching, you reach out to grab the greasy swing of the iron link, ignoring the hammering of blood in your ears. The haze from the sulphur wells below rises in sluggish plumes, smelling of rotten eggs and burned coal-tar. You take a measured lungful of the acrid air, forcing your ribs to expand against the corset of fatigue. Ahead, the maintenance catwalk stretches into the oily gloom like a spine of rusted tin, offering a narrow passage past the humming gantry motors.

exits.label: Crawl along the narrow maintenance catwalk

nodes.title: The Swaying Abyss
nodes.brief: You steady your breathing while hanging off the edge of the lift frame, risking a dizzy spell to secure the dangling safety chains.
nodes.page: Dizziness claws at the edges of your vision as the massive lift platform continues its sickening oscillations in the draft between the bridge piers. Your temples throb with every mechanical heartbeat echoing through the ironwork, threatening to unseat your focus entirely. Closing your eyes for a single heartbeat, you try to steady the frantic spinning of your thoughts against the vast, empty drop below. The safety chain swings wildly just out of reach, demanding absolute inward stillness to calculate the grab.

check.label: Steady your frayed nerves against the vertigo

nodes.title: A Slip in the Soot
nodes.brief: You steady your breathing while hanging off the edge of the lift frame, risking a dizzy spell to secure the dangling safety chains.
nodes.page: Panic breaks through your discipline like a hammer through thin tin, and your fingers close on empty air as the platform bucks under a sudden gust of wind. A blunt corner of the iron frame catches your ribs on the way down, driving the breath from your lungs with a dry wheeze. You sprawl hard onto the mesh floor, tasting copper and cold dust while the world tilts drunkenly around you. The delay costs precious minutes against the storm clock, leaving a purple bruise across your side that will ache until Cinderfall.

exits.label: Pick yourself up and press onward

nodes.title: The Iron Grip
nodes.brief: You steady your breathing while hanging off the edge of the lift frame, risking a dizzy spell to secure the dangling safety chains.
nodes.page: Willpower holds against the rising tide of panic, anchoring your focus until the vertigo recedes into a dull, manageable thrum behind your eyes. Your hand shoots out through the greasy gloom, catching the swinging link with a sharp, metallic clatter that rings along the girders. With a grunt you haul the chain toward the eyelet and drop the brass pin into place just as the gale threatens to whip it away. The mechanism locks solid with a reassuring, heavy thud.

nodes.title: Strain on the Cable
nodes.brief: You maintain a cool head while the cable groans under stress, risking a mental break to calculate the exact weight distribution.
nodes.page: Iron cables sing a high, dangerous note overhead as the whole gantry hangs by a few frayed strands of wire. You keep your weight balanced evenly across the ribbed plate, watching the grease bubble and slide down the hot housing of the pulley. Every adjustment of your posture sends a tremor through the suspension framework, echoing down into the dark guts of the toll-city. There is no room for haste here, only the careful calculation of balance against the groaning iron.

exits.label: Navigate past the humming pulley housing

nodes.title: Calculating the Load
nodes.brief: You maintain a cool head while the cable groans under stress, risking a mental break to calculate the exact weight distribution.
nodes.page: Sweat cuts pale tracks through the soot on your forehead as you stare up at the straining winch-drum overhead. The geometry of the cantilever bridge warps slightly in the shimmering heat haze, making your tired eyes play tricks on the true load distribution. A single miscalculation in shifting your weight could snap the remaining bracket and send the whole apparatus plunging into the gorge. You must quiet the rushing terror in your chest and weigh the strains purely by the feel of the vibrating deck.

check.label: Calculate the exact weight distribution under pressure

nodes.title: The Fracture Point
nodes.brief: You maintain a cool head while the cable groans under stress, risking a mental break to calculate the exact weight distribution.
nodes.page: A sudden metallic shriek shatters your concentration as the stress calculation goes catastrophically wrong under your boots. The support plate tilts four inches to the left, pitching you hard against a jagged bolt-head that tears a long, bleeding gash through your sleeve and forearm. You bite down hard on your tongue to swallow a curse, hauling yourself back onto level mesh with a frantic heave. The injury burns with a sharp, stinging fire, a fresh debt paid to the relentless iron road.

exits.label: Bind your bleeding arm and continue

nodes.title: The Tense Equilibrium
nodes.brief: You maintain a cool head while the cable groans under stress, risking a mental break to calculate the exact weight distribution.
nodes.page: Mental discipline holds firm against the rising screech of stressed metal, allowing you to trace the exact line of force through the groaning plates. You shift your weight three inches to the right, letting the cantilever settle back into its proper, perilous equilibrium with a dull, grinding sigh. The cable ceases its frantic whipping, settling into a deep, rhythmic hum that vibrates pleasantly through the soles of your boots. You have coaxed the machine into a temporary, grudging truce.

exits.label: Proceed along the settled gantry path

nodes.grant: A coded Rail Baron maintenance pass

nodes.title: The Sealed Horizon
nodes.brief: Rail Baron enforcers weld shut the final exit gate, leaving a labyrinth of hot iron corridors as the only way forward.
nodes.page: Pneumatic hammers ring across the viaduct. Rail Baron work-gangs drop welded plate-iron across the final thoroughfare and turn the upper levels into a maze of dead ends. Steam hisses from severed control lines, filling the narrow corridors with blinding white vapor that smells of hot oil and scorched rubber. Ahead lies the only remaining route: a steep service ladder plunging directly into the dim underworks of the toll-city. The air grows noticeably colder down below, carrying the damp, metallic draft of the tunnels where the old signals still flicker in the dark.

exits.label: Descend the steep ladder into the underworks

nodes.title: The Labyrinthine Siding
nodes.brief: The Labyrinthine Siding: You navigate a maze of parked boxcars and hissing steam vents while guards hunt for trespassers.
nodes.page:
Riveted boxcars cast long, greasy shadows across the timber sleepers while plumes of white steam vent from rusted exhaust pipes overhead. Heavy boots crunch against grey gravel as Rail Baron patrols sweep the maze of tracks with brass lanterns, their voices echoing off corrugated iron walls. Every corner offers a choice between narrow gaps in the dead-end sidings and treacherous open stretches of ballast.

Slipping deeper into the rust-flecked labyrinth requires quick wits and a steady hand to avoid the sweeping beams of light. The low rumble of distant machinery vibrates through the soles of your boots, urging you to pick a path before the guards double back to seal the corridor.

exits.label: Skirt the edge of the steaming vent
Dash past the sweep of the lantern
Wedge yourself between the grease-blacked cars

nodes.title: The Sealed Carriage
nodes.brief: You pick the rusty padlock on a sealed carriage door, risking a jammed pick to find a hidden cache of heavy lubricants.
nodes.page:
Grey ash crusts flake from the iron latch as your cold fingers close on the padlock. Sealed crates of machinery oil wait in the stalled compartment's dimness, smelling of rendered lard and metallic salt. Working the iron pick into the frozen tumbler demands immense patience while the distant clank of patrol boots draws steadily closer along the permanent way.

The rusted shackle finally gives way with a dull, reluctant snap, swinging wide to reveal the dark interior and its valuable contents. Grease tin in hand, you step back into the shadow of the gantry just as a pair of lantern-bearers sweep their light across the adjacent track.

exits.label: Haul the grease toward the main line

nodes.title: The Frozen Tumbler
nodes.brief: You pick the rusty padlock on a sealed carriage door, risking a jammed pick to find a hidden cache of heavy lubricants.
nodes.page:
Cold sweat beads on your forehead as the pick tip grates against jammed brass inside the frozen lock housing. Every subtle vibration through the wire tool speaks of compacted soot and decades of corrosive salt air settling into the mechanism. The footsteps of the Rail Baron patrol grow louder over the ringing steel, leaving mere seconds to force the tumbler before the beam sweeps across the carriage wall.

You lean your full weight into the pick, applying the final twist of leverage as the internal pins bind hard against the rusted cylinder.

nodes.title: The Snapped Pick
nodes.brief: You pick the rusty padlock on a sealed carriage door, risking a jammed pick to find a hidden cache of heavy lubricants.
nodes.page:
A sharp metallic ping echoes off the iron siding as the delicate tip of your pick shears clean off inside the frozen tumbler. The lock remains stubbornly sealed, its mechanism jammed fast by the broken shard of steel and generations of impacted soot. A sudden shout from the corner of the gantry announces that the patrol has caught the sound, forcing you to scramble away into the ash-dune shadows empty-handed.

Lungs burning from the foul air, you nurse a bruised thumb where the slip caught you against the jamb, leaving the stubborn carriage behind as you retreat deeper into the maze.

nodes.title: The Greased Palm
nodes.brief: You pick the rusty padlock on a sealed carriage door, risking a jammed pick to find a hidden cache of heavy lubricants.
nodes.page:
The heavy brass shackle yields at last with a dry, protesting rasp, swinging open to reveal row upon row of sealed metal tins. You snatch a jar of refined axle lubricant and tuck the cold tin deep inside your canvas coat against the biting draught of the viaduct. However narrowly you managed the trick, the quick-witted acquisition leaves you well-equipped for whatever friction lies ahead on the iron road.

A low whistle from the overhead gantry reminds you not to linger among the stalled freight, prompting a swift retreat back into the tangled heart of the siding.

nodes.title: The Steaming Tarp
nodes.brief: You hide beneath a steaming tarp as patrols pass by, risking a nervous cough to avoid detection by the armed guards.
nodes.page:
Heavy canvas, stiffened with layers of dried coal-tar and greasy soot, droops low over the skeletal frame of an open mineral wagon. Sliding beneath the coarse folds brings an immediate choking wave of hot sulphur and damp wool, pressing you flat against the cold iron floor. Outside the coarse barrier, hobnailed boots crunch rhythmically over the ballast as the Rail Baron patrol halts just inches from your hiding place.

The fabric radiates the dull, lingering warmth of a banked boiler, masking your silhouette and keeping the drifting ash off your coat. You hold your breath, listening to the murmurs of the guards debating their shift rotation above the hissing steam.

exits.label: Slide out beneath the opposite buffer

nodes.title: The Guarded Spur
nodes.brief: You hide beneath a steaming tarp as patrols pass by, risking a nervous cough to avoid detection by the armed guards.
nodes.page:
Creeping past the dangling brake-hoses of the mineral wagon, you emerge into a narrow alley between two stalled coal tenders. The air here tastes faintly of copper and stale vinegar, stirred only by the draft whistling through the high iron girders of the viaduct. Armed sentries pace the overhead gantry above, their long coats billowing in the bitter wind blowing off the ash-steppes.

Keeping low to the rusted floorplates, you scurry from shadow to shadow as the lantern light sweeps across the corrugated walls of the depot.

exits.label: Skirt the edge of the coal tender

nodes.title: The Suppressed Cough
nodes.brief: You hide beneath a steaming tarp as patrols pass by, risking a nervous cough to avoid detection by the armed guards.
nodes.page:
Fine soot particles lodge deep in your windpipe, triggering a sudden, violent spasm that threatens to tear through your tight-lipped resolve. Pressing a gloved hand hard across your mouth, you fight the tickle with sheer force of will while the patrol commander pauses his patrol not three paces away. Every muscle in your neck strains against the urge to hack, your chest burning for want of clean air beneath the suffocating canvas.

You bite down hard on the inside of your cheek until the metallic taste of blood floods your tongue, holding the cough back at the very edge of failure.

nodes.title: The Raucous Hack
nodes.brief: You hide beneath a steaming tarp as patrols pass by, risking a nervous cough to avoid detection by the armed guards.
nodes.page:
A sudden, irrepressible cough tears through your clenched teeth, echoing loudly against the hollow iron floor of the mineral wagon. Heavy boots halt abruptly on the gravel outside, followed by the sharp click of a rifle bolt being drawn back in the gloom. You scramble out from under the tarp just as a bayonet rips through the coarse canvas where your shoulder had rested an instant before.

Scrambling away on hands and knees into the choking soot-smoke, you leave behind a stray leather strap and a ragged breath, nursing a raw throat as you flee the immediate sector.

nodes.title: The Steaming Tarp
nodes.brief: You hide beneath a steaming tarp as patrols pass by, risking a nervous cough to avoid detection by the armed guards.
nodes.page:
Damp canvas reeking of machine oil draws tight over your chest while iron-shod boots of the Baron patrol ring against the gangway rivets just inches away. A sharp hiss from a weeping valve overhead masks your shallow breath, though the stinging heat of the escaping steam makes your skin prickle with cold sweat. When the footsteps finally fade into the clatter of distant machinery, your fingers brush against a forgotten leather pouch wedged beneath the floor ribbing, containing a stamped iron pass signed by a junior inspector.

Pocketing the heavy token with cautious deliberation, you slide silently from beneath the tarpaulin into the shadow of a water-column, your muscles stiff but your path ahead momentarily cleared of immediate pursuers.

exits.label: Slip into the maze of boxcars

nodes.title: Waiting in the Rust
nodes.brief: You resist the temptation to bolt prematurely from cover, risking a loss of nerve to time your dash past the searchlights.
nodes.page: Cold iron presses against your ribs as the Baronial patrol passes with a rhythmic trudge of boots. You stay motionless beneath the greasy canvas, letting the acrid smell of burnt coal fill your mouth rather than risk a premature movement. The searchlights sweep low across the corrugated iron siding, washing the darkness in sharp amber before clicking away. Every muscle in your legs aches from the static tension, coiled like a rusted spring waiting for the precise heartbeat to release. When the last boot-heel fades into the din of distant machinery, you slide silently from beneath the cover, slipping into the narrow shadow of the gantry staircase.

nodes.title: Climbing the Iron Spine
nodes.brief: You resist the temptation to bolt prematurely from cover, risking a loss of nerve to time your dash past the searchlights.
nodes.page: Iron rungs bite into your palms as you haul yourself upward into the skeletal superstructure of the viaduct. Below you, the vast expanse of the Brasswind yards stretches out like a grid of dormant black teeth under a low, bruised sky. Steam hisses from an overhead valve, pluming white against the soot-stained girders and smelling of hot grease. You pause on the narrow maintenance grating, steadying your breathing while a pair of inspectors chat idly fifty feet below. They toss a cigarette butt into the ash-drift, its tiny red ember dying instantly in the grit.

nodes.title: The Sweeping Beam
nodes.brief: You resist the temptation to bolt prematurely from cover, risking a loss of nerve to time your dash past the searchlights.
nodes.page: A sudden white glare cuts across the open grating just three strides ahead of your boots. The searchlight from the high tower pivots with an ominous whine, slicing the darkness and hunting for any unauthorized shift in the shadows. Your pulse hammers against your throat, threatening to break your concentration as the beam crawls closer toward your hiding place behind the water pipe. You clamp your teeth together, forcing your breathing to slow to a crawl, and gather your nerve to time the precise gap between sweeps.

nodes.title: Caught in the White
nodes.brief: You resist the temptation to bolt prematurely from cover, risking a loss of nerve to time your dash past the searchlights.
nodes.page: A sharp clatter betrays your foot against a loose rivet just as the beam snaps back across the iron floor. Shouts ring out from the gantry above, and heavy boots scramble toward your ledge with alarming speed. You scramble backward into a rusted junction box, taking a jagged scrape across your forearm that stains your sleeve with hot blood. They do not find you in the dark, but the delay costs you dearly in precious minutes, leaving your nerves frayed and your breath burning with raw ash.

nodes.title: Slipping the Beam
nodes.brief: You resist the temptation to bolt prematurely from cover, risking a loss of nerve to time your dash past the searchlights.
nodes.page: The glaring white light sweeps past your shoulder by a hair's breadth and catches only the drifting motes of soot in the air. You time the return stroke with quiet precision, darting across the exposed iron plate just as the lens clicks toward the opposite rail. The danger recedes into the hum of the dynamos, leaving you tucked safely within the recess of an unused signal cabin. Your fingers close around a small, grease-stained brass token dropped by a fleeing gager, cold metal that hints at safe passage through the lower checkpoint.

nodes.title: The Signalman's Threshold
nodes.page: Heavy oak doors banded in blackened iron block the entrance to the viaduct's central switching nexus. Inside, the rhythmic ticking of a thousand mechanical clocks fills the air, accompanied by the low, subterranean thrum of the regional telegraph lines. A row of brass speaking tubes runs along the back wall, hissing softly with whispered orders from the Baronial dispatchers upstairs. You keep your head down, moving with the measured confidence of someone who belongs among the machinery, blending into the background noise of ticking gears and drifting coal dust. The path splits ahead between the central administrative chutes and the lower maintenance tunnels leading directly toward the Hollow Cut.

nodes.title: The Junction of Cogs
nodes.page: Brass dials gleam under the greasy glow of enclosed gas lamps in the heart of the viaduct's control gallery. Overhead, the main cable trays pulse with mechanical life, transmitting signals across the entire span of the rail bridge. Every route away from this chamber offers a different hazard, from the automated security puzzles of the upper signal towers to the heavily guarded master logs where a forged signature might buy you permanent clearance. Down below, the distant shrieks of alarm sirens begin to echo through the stone canyons as the runaway engine draws the full wrath of the Baronial patrols.

exits.label: Enter the gear-chamber for manual override
Forge an override signature on the master log
Retreat toward the lower escape ladders

nodes.title: Within the Clockwork Heart
nodes.brief: You recode the brass gear cylinders inside the master clock, risking a shredded thumb to unlock all outbound rail switches.
nodes.page: Thousands of brass teeth mesh in endless rotation inside the towering master clock housing, grinding out the rigid schedule of the Rail Barons. You crouch behind the main pendulum case, sheltered from the view of the floor inspectors by swinging brass weights and hanging wire harnesses. The air here tastes heavily of ozone and warm oil, thick enough to coat your tongue with a metallic bitterness. You reach into the intricate maze of levers and rods, searching for the primary cylinder that controls the outbound rail switches for the lower line.

nodes.title: The Rotating Drum
nodes.brief: You recode the brass gear cylinders inside the master clock, risking a shredded thumb to unlock all outbound rail switches.
nodes.page: Heavy brass drums rotate slowly on their steel axles, clicking with every rotation as they log the passage of every train on the line. You trace the grooves with the tip of your thumb, feeling the precise notches where the emergency switches are held in place by mechanical pins. The room smells of hot tallow and old iron, quiet except for the deep, resonant heartbeat of the viaduct's master chronometer overhead. A cluster of warning wires snakes across the casing, pulsing with low-voltage current that demands absolute steadiness in every move you make.

nodes.title: The Delicate Tooth
nodes.brief: You recode the brass gear cylinders inside the master clock, risking a shredded thumb to unlock all outbound rail switches.
nodes.page: Fine steel tweezers tremble slightly in your gloved hand as you ease them between two interlocking brass cogs under extreme tension. A single slip will jam the primary time-drum, locking every outbound signal red across the entire viaduct and bringing the full weight of the garrison down upon your position. You lean in close, squinting through the dim gaslight to align the micro-lever with the escape notch on the main cylinder. The iron teeth grind together with a menacing groan, waiting for the final push that will either unlock the route or shear the mechanism clean off.

nodes.title: The Broken Tooth
nodes.brief: You recode the brass gear cylinders inside the master clock, risking a shredded thumb to unlock all outbound rail switches.
nodes.page: A sickening snap echoes inside the brass casing as the gear teeth jam hard against the unyielding steel frame. Sparks shower across your knuckles, searing your skin and leaving a jagged, bleeding gash across your thumb that throbs with immediate pain. The master clock stutters, its rhythmic ticking skipping a beat before resuming with a harsh, uneven rattle that immediately draws the attention of the floor guards. You snatch your hand back from the machinery, nursing your injured thumb as you dive behind a stack of spare iron plates to avoid the sweeping beam of a pocket lantern.

exits.label: Retreat into the shadow of the boilers

nodes.title: The Clean Engagement
nodes.brief: You recode the brass gear cylinders inside the master clock, risking a shredded thumb to unlock all outbound rail switches.
nodes.page: The brass lever slips smoothly into its new groove with a satisfying, muffled click that resonates through the entire frame. Across the gantry, a dozen distant signal arms drop simultaneously into the clear position, green glass eyes blinking open against the grey ash-sky. You withdraw your hand cleanly, your thumb intact save for a smear of black machine grease and the adrenaline still hammering in your chest. A small, notched brass key pops free from the liberated tumbler, falling neatly into your open palm as proof of your quiet mastery over the iron.

exits.label: Flee toward the lower escape ladders

nodes.title: The Signal Box
nodes.brief: You outwit the tower's mechanical security puzzles, risking a logical trap to reprogram the automated signal horns.
nodes.page: Copper wires hum with a low, parasitic frequency beneath the floorboards of the upper gantry. You trace the lead-sheathed bundle past the rusted terminal blocks where the Rail Barons keep their automated pulse. Every chime on the brass horns outside depends upon these delicate copper veins carrying the correct electrical resistance. A wrong turn here will flood the viaduct with false departure bells.

exits.label: Trace the heavy copper wire upward

nodes.title: Reversing the Current
nodes.brief: You outwit the tower's mechanical security puzzles, risking a logical trap to reprogram the automated signal horns.
nodes.page: Sweat cools quickly in the drafty iron chamber as you nudge the magnetic relays into alignment with a bone-handled screwdriver. The metal cylinders click cold against your palm, smelling of ozone and old oil. Outside the dirty window, the signal horns lean out over the yawning drop like gargoyles waiting for a change in the wind. You must trick the mechanical memory before the patrol clock reaches its next chime.

nodes.title: The Logical Trap
nodes.brief: You outwit the tower's mechanical security puzzles, risking a logical trap to reprogram the automated signal horns.
nodes.page: A secondary safety tumbler drops into place with a sharp metallic clack, blocking the master drum just as you reach for the primary override switch. If you force the tumbler, the logic circuit will snap shut and sound an alarm across the entire viaduct. You study the sequence of notched brass wheels, looking for the tiny flaw in the Baronial pattern where hesitation might buy you a fraction of a second.

nodes.title: A Costly Bypass
nodes.brief: You outwit the tower's mechanical security puzzles, risking a logical trap to reprogram the automated signal horns.
nodes.page: A sudden spark leaps from the ungrounded terminal, scorching your knuckle and fusing the delicate return spring into a lump of useless slag. The security lock shrieks in protest, jams the mechanism, and forces you to rip the housing open with an iron pinch-bar. You leave the box behind with a smoking sleeve and a deep, stinging burn across your hand, but the horns fall silent just as the watchman passes below.

nodes.title: The Silenced Horns
nodes.brief: You outwit the tower's mechanical security puzzles, risking a logical trap to reprogram the automated signal horns.
nodes.page: Silence settles over the brass gantries like falling ash as the automated horns click shut, their iron lungs choked before they can scream. Whether through flawless calculation or sheer desperate luck, the security drum spins free and leaves the line clear for your approach. You pocket a brass bypass key the duty clerk dropped, cold against your palm.

nodes.title: The Ledger Room
nodes.brief: You forge an override signature on the master log roll, risking detection by rival clerks to grant yourself permanent clearance.
nodes.page: Ledger leaves flutter in the dry draft of the office above the sorting platforms, smelling of dried ink and stale tallow. Clerk desks stretch in long, dreary rows under green-shaded gas lamps that hiss with sulphurous vapour. You lean over the high mahogany counter where the master clearance log lies open, its heavy hide binding stamped with the triple-eagle seal of the Rail Barons.

nodes.title: Ink and Iron
nodes.brief: You forge an override signature on the master log roll, risking detection by rival clerks to grant yourself permanent clearance.
nodes.page: Your fingers twitch over the stiff parchment page, matching the slanting copperplate strokes of the chief inspector with painstaking care. Every pen-scratch echoes in the silent office while the night watchman's heavy boots scrape against the iron grating outside the door. A single blot of ink could ruin the entire forgery and bring half a battalion of gangers down on your neck.

nodes.title: The Clerk's Eye
nodes.brief: You forge an override signature on the master log roll, risking detection by rival clerks to grant yourself permanent clearance.
nodes.page: A sharp rap sounds against the frosted glass panel just as you lift the pen from the drying sand. Through the blurred pane, the silhouette of a senior clerk pauses, head tilted as if noticing an unfamiliar hand in the registry. You hold your breath, hovering your hand over the inkpot while the shadow fingers the handle of the office door.

nodes.title: Caught in the Margin
nodes.brief: You forge an override signature on the master log roll, risking detection by rival clerks to grant yourself permanent clearance.
nodes.page: The door swings open with a dry squeak, and an alarmed shout cuts through the stale air before you can slide the ledger back into its rack. You shove the clerk aside against the iron coat-rack and vault the mahogany counter, leaving behind a torn sleeve and a valuable tin of grease. The alarm bell behind the desk begins to toll, but you are already sprinting down the gantry stairs into the smoke.

exits.label: Drop through the gantry floor grating

nodes.title: The Permanent Stamp
nodes.brief: You forge an override signature on the master log roll, risking detection by rival clerks to grant yourself permanent clearance.
nodes.page: The purple inspection seal dries hard and flat across the master page, indistinguishable from the thousands of orders issued by the Board before you. Whether through bold deception or a blind stroke of fortune, the clerks remain oblivious while you tuck the signed manifest safely inside your greasy waistcoat. You walk out into the cooling air with a stolen transit pass that opens every gate on the line.

nodes.title: The Alarms of Brasswind
nodes.brief: Alarm sirens shriek across the entire viaduct structure as Baronial searchlights sweep the ash-choked canyons for the runaway engine.
nodes.page: Sirens shriek across the entire viaduct structure, their brass throats tearing the soot-laden air with mechanical fury. Baronial searchlights sweep the ash-choked canyons, cutting amber paths through the gathering dusk to find the runaway engine. Every gantry and rivet on the great iron bridge trembles as the defense batteries spin on their mountings and lock onto the vibration of your steel wheels against the frozen rails.

exits.label: Dive deeper into the engine cab

nodes.title: The Siren Station
nodes.brief: The Siren Station: You man the locomotive controls through a blinding storm of flashing red lights and blaring steam sirens.
nodes.page: Steam hisses from the manifold while red lights flash against the soot-greased walls of the cabin. The throttle bars vibrate beneath your palms, hot and demanding in the din of the alarms. Outside the thick glass, the iron road splits into several distinct paths through the gantries, each offering its own desperate hazard against the closing net of the Rail Barons.

nodes.title: Sparks in the Conduit
nodes.brief: You repair the severed throttle cable amid blinding sparks, risking electrocution to regain full speed before guards close in.
nodes.page:
Hot sparks spit from the severed throttle cable as you wedge yourself into the cramped maintenance well behind the boiler plate. The smell of burning rubber and ozone fills your throat, sharp against the constant taste of ash. Outside, heavy boots clang against the iron plating of the viaduct roof, drawing closer with every beat of your hammering pulse.

You strip back the frayed insulation with shaking fingers, desperate to reconnect the copper core before the searchlights swing back toward your position.

nodes.title: The Live Connection
nodes.brief: You repair the severed throttle cable amid blinding sparks, risking electrocution to regain full speed before guards close in.
nodes.page:
Copper wire stings your raw palms as you twist the broken ends together in the dark, slick with sweat and machine oil. The metal pulses with stray current, humming a low, dangerous note that vibrates straight up your forearms. Every shift of the engine beneath you threatens to tear the fragile repair apart before the circuit can hold steady.

You brace your shoulder against the bulkhead and reach for the secondary housing screw.

nodes.title: The Conduit Bridge
nodes.brief: You repair the severed throttle cable amid blinding sparks, risking electrocution to regain full speed before guards close in.
nodes.page: With a breath of cold air, you press the bare copper ends into their brass sleeve while the current surges violently against your knuckles. A blinding white flash throws your shadow hard against the iron wall, and the smell of singed skin mixes with the thick coal-smoke. You clamp the connection against the bucking vibration of the engine and the searing voltage.

nodes.title: Burned Fingers
nodes.brief: You repair the severed throttle cable amid blinding sparks, risking electrocution to regain full speed before guards close in.
nodes.page: A vicious jolt throws you backward against the coal tender, leaving your right hand throbbing and blackened at the fingertips. The repair holds, but the cost is an ugly blistered burn that flares with every movement of your wrist. You clutch your arm against your chest, gasping for air in the sulfurous gloom as the Marrowbone surges forward into the shadows.

nodes.title: The Repaired Line
nodes.brief: You repair the severed throttle cable amid blinding sparks, risking electrocution to regain full speed before guards close in.
nodes.page: The cable holds firm beneath your taped fingers, sending a clean, steady surge straight to the primary injectors. However narrowly, you have cheated the electrical bite and restored full mechanical response to the engine's iron heart. You wipe the grease from your brow, clutching a small piece of salvaged copper wire that hums faintly with residual current.

nodes.title: The Labyrinth of Iron
nodes.brief: You outmaneuver the pursuit engines through clever signal manipulation, risking a wrong switch to send your chasers into a siding.
nodes.page:
You throw yourself against the brass selector, driving the linkage through layers of old soot and hardened grease. The heavy iron rods groan beneath the floorboards as they shift the track switches far out in the ash-storm. Chasing locomotive whistles howl behind you in the gloom, trapped in the maze of sidings and dead-end spurs you have just unlocked.

You must guide the Marrowbone through this confusion before the pursuing guards unravel your pattern.

nodes.title: The Wrong Junction
nodes.brief: You outmaneuver the pursuit engines through clever signal manipulation, risking a wrong switch to send your chasers into a siding.
nodes.page: The track diagram flickers in the red glow of the firebox as you trace the tangled network of points with your eyes. You slam the heavy lever downward, gambling that the ancient mechanical memory of the line will confuse the pursuers behind you. A grinding screech rises from the lower switches as wheels cross the split. You hang between two diverging routes in the dark.

nodes.title: Tangled Tracks
nodes.brief: You outmaneuver the pursuit engines through clever signal manipulation, risking a wrong switch to send your chasers into a siding.
nodes.page: The switch catches halfway, jammed by a wedge of frozen slag in the guide-groove, and the Marrowbone shudders to a jarring halt across a maintenance spur. Boots pound on the gravel outside as Baronial guards converge on your stranded position, and you crank the reverse gear with all your strength. You break free with a scream of tortured iron, though you have lost precious minutes and earned a deep, aching bruise along your ribs.

nodes.title: The Clear Switch
nodes.brief: You outmaneuver the pursuit engines through clever signal manipulation, risking a wrong switch to send your chasers into a siding.
nodes.page: The heavy lever locks home with a satisfying metallic thud, and the switch points click true in the dark. However narrowly, you have sent the pursuing engines howling down an empty siding of rusted freight cars while your own path remains clear. You pull the regulator wide, clutching a notched brass turnout key dropped by the old line-keeper.

nodes.title: Smothered in White
nodes.brief: You maintain iron composure while searchlights sweep the cab, risking a panic attack to keep the engine hidden in steam.
nodes.page:
Thick white plumes hiss from the ruptured manifold, wrapping the iron ribs of the Marrowbone in a dense, artificial fog that smells of scorching oil and wet packing. Yellow searchlights sweep across the curved iron roof of the cab, casting long, frantic bars of light through the greasy windows. Your lungs feel tight and dry, threatening to close entirely under the weight of the sudden ambush, yet your fingers remain hooked around the brass regulator. You force your breathing down to a slow, deliberate rhythm, matching the steady thrum of the piston-rods beneath the floor plates.

Drop the side injector valve and drown the track in vapour before the Rail Barons spot your silhouette.

exits.label: Drown the track in thick steam

nodes.title: The Steady Hand
nodes.brief: You maintain iron composure while searchlights sweep the cab, risking a panic attack to keep the engine hidden in steam.
nodes.page: Outside the iron skin of the cab, heavy boots clatter against the gantry walkways of the viaduct, accompanied by the sharp metallic bark of a Rail Baron inspector shouting orders through a megaphone. A beam of white light pins the smoke-stack, washing the rolling white clouds in a harsh, clinical glare that threatens to expose your hiding spot to the entire yard. Sweat stings your eyes, and an old terror of small, dark spaces claws up the back of your throat, urging you to throw open the regulator and bolt blindly into the night. Instead, you stare into the glowing heart of the firebox and clamp your jaw shut, keeping your pulse from racing while the searchlight slowly sweeps past the dripping tender.

check.label: Keep your pulse steady in the glare

nodes.title: Cost of the Gaze
nodes.brief: You maintain iron composure while searchlights sweep the cab, risking a panic attack to keep the engine hidden in steam.
nodes.page: The searchlight lingers a fraction too long, catching the glint of the brass water-key on the bench and forcing you to duck behind the coal bunker with a sharp intake of breath. An iron rivet strikes the cab side with a deafening ring, and a splinter of hot metal grazes your forearm. A jagged line of red opens across your skin. You gasp, nearly dropping your grip on the fire-iron as the sudden panic spike leaves your ribs aching and your head spinning with cold sweat. The engine shudders beneath you with a ragged cough from the exhaust, yet the shifting shadows of the viaduct swallow your retreat just as boots tramp past your bunker.

nodes.title: Through the Glare
nodes.brief: You maintain iron composure while searchlights sweep the cab, risking a panic attack to keep the engine hidden in steam.
nodes.page: Shifting shadows swallow the bulk of the locomotive as the searchlight swings away toward an empty freight car, leaving only the steady, rhythmic groan of stressed iron in the night air. You draw a long, shuddering breath, tasting the familiar metallic tang of soot and coal-dust on your tongue as your nerves settle back into their customary granite hardness. On the metal floor beside your boot lies a heavy brass spanner dropped by a fleeing track-walker, bearing the notched crest of the Gangers' Union on its worn handle. Pocketing the tool, you nudge the throttle forward and let the engine slip quietly into the darkness beyond the toll-station.

exits.label: Man the controls through the red storm

nodes.title: Smoke and Iron
nodes.brief: You trick the pursuers with a decoy steam release, risking a failed deception to buy precious minutes for your escape.
nodes.page:
Cunning requires a delicate touch when dealing with men who live by the schedule and die by the ledger. You yank the auxiliary whistle chain twice, sending a sharp, defiant shriek echoing off the rusted corrugated roofs of the toll-city. Instantly, a secondary steam-release valve under the footplate opens wide, dumping a massive cloud of grey vapor directly across the parallel maintenance line where the pursuers' handcar waits. The decoy plume billows thick and false, smelling fiercely of wet lime and scorched tallow to trick the watchers into firing their signal flares at empty track.

Wheel the steering gear hard over and dive into the labyrinth of side-tracks.

nodes.title: The False Scent
nodes.brief: You trick the pursuers with a decoy steam release, risking a failed deception to buy precious minutes for your escape.
nodes.page: Iron wheels grind against the rail-heads on the adjacent spur as the Rail Barons' patrol engine reacts to the sudden hiss of steam and roars blindly into the artificial fog you left behind. You lean over the side of the cab, peering into the swirling grey murk to judge the exact moment your pursuers will realize they are chasing nothing more substantial than hot water and old soot. Your fingers hover over the secondary bypass valve, ready to either drop a smoke-pot into the ash-pan or cut the headlights entirely before the beam catches your cab number. Every second counts against the schedule now, and a single mistimed toggle will paint the Marrowbone in a target-glow for every sniper on the gantries.

check.label: Trick the pursuers with a false steam trail

nodes.title: Caught in the Vent
nodes.brief: You trick the pursuers with a decoy steam release, risking a failed deception to buy precious minutes for your escape.
nodes.page: The decoy plume thins too quickly in the crosswind, dissolving into the mountain draft before the pursuit engine commits to the wrong siding. A sharp clatter of iron teeth on the track signals the pursuit crew shifting their points back, catching your bluff and sending a load of hot slag splashing across the running board. You curse under your breath as a jagged piece of clinker strikes your shoulder, tearing your canvas jacket and leaving a dull, throbbing bruise that radiates down your spine. One hand shovels raw coal into the hopper while you wrestle the reversing lever against the jam, and aching muscles plus lost yards settle the bill for the failed trick.

nodes.title: Slipped Gears
nodes.brief: You trick the pursuers with a decoy steam release, risking a failed deception to buy precious minutes for your escape.
nodes.page: Grey vapor wraps around the boiler like a shroud, blinding the gantry guards just long enough for the Marrowbone to slide across the diamond crossing without a whistle. Pursuers shout curses at an empty stretch of rusted iron while your engine picks up speed toward the dark cliffs. Resting on the wooden tool-box is a slip of grease-stained paper left behind by a friendly grease-monkey, detailing the exact blind spots in the viaduct signal system. You tuck the crumpled schedule into your waistcoat pocket and let the steam build for the final descent.

exits.label: Man the controls through the red storm

nodes.title: The Iron Mouth
nodes.brief: The Marrowbone smashes through the final toll-barrier, plunging off Brasswind Viaduct and into the yawning mouth of the Hollow Cut.
nodes.page:
Brasswind Viaduct falls away behind the tender like a broken spine of iron and rusted girders, its toll-gates left shuttered and silent in the rising ash-storm. The Marrowbone gathers a terrifying, unstoppable momentum down the steep incline, her boiler screaming a high, iron-throated song as the gradient tilts sharply toward the jagged roots of the range. Ahead of the pilot wheel lies only the dark, wet maw of the Hollow Cut, where the tunnel walls drip with ancient mineral rot and the signal lamps burn a sickly, stagnant green. You brace your boots against the ribbed floor-plate, one hand locked hard on the brass regulator and the other gripping the whistle-cord as the daylight dies completely into the tunnel's throat.

Plunge straight into the blackness before the tracking signals shift against you.

nodes.title: The Wrong Lever
nodes.brief: You outmaneuver the pursuit engines through clever signal manipulation, risking a wrong switch to send your chasers into a siding.
nodes.page:
Iron points groan beneath the heavy steel wheels as you haul the brass-headed lever toward the maintenance siding, feeding the Marrowbone just enough steam to jump the gap. The pursuing engine roars past on the main line, its searchlights slicing through the soot-laden air to illuminate empty track and rising ash-dunes where you should have been. A faint smirk touches your lips at the clean execution of the diversion, though you know the Rail Barons will reset their traps before the next shift changes at the junction.

Follow the tangled network of points back into the deep cuttings.

nodes.title: Beneath the Steaming Tarp
nodes.brief: You hide beneath a steaming tarp as patrols pass by, risking a nervous cough to avoid detection by the armed guards.
nodes.page: Canvas gives off the stale heat of a boiler room while thick grey vapor rolls across the gantry floor. You pull the rough wool of your collar high against your chin and wait for the patrol's boots to clatter past the coupling. A sudden tickle builds behind your ribs, sharp and insistent, threatening to give away your hiding place in the shadows of the tender. You swallow hard, biting the inside of your cheek until the copper taste of blood chases the cough away. When the lanterns swing past without pausing, you slide quietly from beneath the protective canvas and slip into the narrow corridor beyond.

exits.label: Crawl beneath the grey canvas curtain

nodes.title: The Sealed Carriage Door
nodes.brief: You pick the rusty padlock on a sealed carriage door, risking a jammed pick to find a hidden cache of heavy lubricants.
nodes.page: Thick grime coats the iron latch of the compartment door, hiding decades of weather and neglect from casual view. You wedge the hooked tip of your steel tool into the frozen mechanism and press on while the rusted tumblers refuse to yield. A sharp ping echoes in the quiet siding as the metal pick bends slightly under the strain, threatening to wedge permanently in the lock. One final twist of your wrist, and the rusted iron bar gives way with a blunt thud, sliding back to show a dark interior stacked high with grease-sealed wooden crates.

exits.label: Pry open the stubborn iron latch

nodes.title: The Heavy Crane Release
nodes.brief: You shoulder a jammed emergency release lever, risking a crushed shoulder to free the locked crane cables manually.
nodes.page: Rusted chains groan under the immense weight of the suspended loading arm, locked fast in a tangle of frozen links. You throw your whole weight against the jammed emergency handle, feeling the rusted iron bite deep into the muscle of your upper arm. A sharp pop of cartilage sounds through the ringing silence of the yard, shooting a line of pure agony down your side as the mechanism shudders. The tension snaps, and the crane arm swings wide with a long metallic screech, clearing the tracks for the engine to edge forward.

exits.label: Heave against the stubborn release bar

nodes.title: The Master Clock Cylinders
nodes.brief: You recode the brass gear cylinders inside the master clock, risking a shredded thumb to unlock all outbound rail switches.
nodes.page: Brass cogs click and grind inside the glass-fronted housing of the junction regulator, keeping time to the rhythm of the distant ash-falls. You slide your bare fingers into the tight space between the rotating plates, adjusting the notched pins to bypass the automated blockade. The sharp edge of a brass tooth catches the meat of your thumb and slices a thin red line across the skin while the cylinder continues its relentless turn. You ignore the warm sting, securing the final pin just as the indicator needle jumps smoothly to green.

nodes.title: Bluffing the Rival Driver
nodes.brief: You trick the rival driver into reversing too early, risking a failed bluff to cause a harmless collision that disables their locomotive.
nodes.page: The opposing locomotive hisses loudly on the parallel line, its firebox glowing a dull, angry orange through the soot-stained cab window. You lean out from the footplate, shouting a false warning about a broken axle just ahead on the main crossover. For a tense heartbeat, the rival driver hesitates, staring across the intervening space while their hand hovers uncertainly over the regulator valve. Then they haul their reversing lever back in a panic, locking their own wheels in a cloud of burning brake-linings and steam.

nodes.title: Restarting the Auxiliary Pump
nodes.brief: You steady your nerves against the terrifying screech of failing metal, risking a panic attack to restart the auxiliary pump.
nodes.page: A high-pitched shriek rises from the pit beneath the deckplates as the water pump rattles itself loose from its mounting bolts. Panic knots your stomach as the steam pressure gauge ticks toward the red line and your limbs threaten to lock. You close your eyes for a single breath, forcing the cold ash out of your lungs until your hands stop shaking against the valve wheel. Gripping the cold metal with both palms, you force the auxiliary pump back into its stroke, steadying the rhythm of the beating iron heart.

nodes.title: The Pressure-Gauge Housing
nodes.brief: You dismantle the pressure-gauge housing to hide extra fuel cells, risking discovery by suspicious clerks to earn a hidden brass token.
nodes.page: Brass thumb-screws turn with a dry, grating scrape as you lift the heavy dial face away from the steam manifold. You slide a pair of spare fuel blocks deep into the cramped cavity behind the needle mechanism, praying the night shift clerks have already finished their rounds. Boots ring on the iron grating outside the cab door, then pause long enough for a clipboard to slap a wooden post. You hold your breath in the dark, replacing the gauge face with trembling fingers as the footsteps fade back into the gloom.

exits.label: Conceal the fuel within the dial

nodes.title: Clearing the Access Hatch
nodes.brief: You heave a massive iron sleeper to clear a blocked access hatch, risking a strained spine to discover a stash of rations.
nodes.page: Thick layers of slag and fallen masonry block the iron-plated door set flush into the cinder ballast of the track bed. You wedge a six-foot iron sleeper beneath the lip of the hatch, pressing your boots against the gravel and straining until your spine pops. A sharp twinge of pain shoots down your lower back, nearly buckling your knees before the heavy plate finally breaks its seal with a sucking gasp of stale air. You kick the debris aside, peering down into the dark shaft where a crate of emergency rations sits untouched in the dust.

exits.label: Pry open the buried floor hatch

nodes.title: The Pitch-Black Maw
nodes.brief: Locomotive No. 9 plunges into the pitch-black maw of the Hollow Cut where the tunnel walls drip with mineral rot and ancient soot.
nodes.page: Locomotive No. 9 plunges headlong into the pitch-black maw of the Hollow Cut, leaving the grey light of the viaduct far behind in the choking ash. Mineral rot drips from the low brick vaulting above the stack, hissing softly as it strikes the hot boiler plates and fills the cramped cab with the smell of old damp and sulfur. The rhythmic pounding of the cylinders echoes off the stone walls like the heartbeat of an iron beast waking from a century-long sleep. Ahead in the absolute dark, only the faint, greenish glow of a distant signal box hints at what waits beneath the mountain.

exits.label: Drive deeper into the dark tunnel

nodes.title: The Soot-Locker
nodes.brief: The Soot-Locker: Stalled baggage trucks block the tracks while oil-lamp smoke clings to the low brick vaulting.
nodes.page: Stalled baggage trucks block the tracks with rusted iron wheels while thick oil-lamp smoke clings to the low, weeping brick vaulting of the subterranean hall. The air tastes of wet coal-dust and forgotten years, heavy with the quiet melancholy of a station that time passed by. Every shadowed alcove holds the promise of hidden salvage or ancient hazard, tempting you to leave the safety of the footplate and explore the damp recesses of the mountain. Faint sounds drift down the converging maintenance shafts, offering various paths through the heart of the stone labyrinth.

exits.label: Clear the jammed axle-box with leverage
Wait beside the phantom semaphore arm
Trace the hidden grease-runs along the footing
Heave the splintered cargo crate aside
Face the pale figure swinging from the rafters

nodes.title: The Jammed Bearing
nodes.brief: You clear a jammed axle-box using brute leverage against the stone floor, earning an iron wedge and a strained wrist.
nodes.page: Beneath the weeping vault of the tunnel, the forward journal-box groans with a dry, metallic scream that cuts through the hiss of the boiler. You wedge a pinch-bar between the chassis frame and the scorching iron housing and throw your weight against the cold stone floor to force the seized roller back into alignment. Sweat burns your eyes through the thick soot as the metal yields with a sharp, echoing crack. Your wrist aches, and an iron wedge sits jammed securely into the gap.

nodes.title: The Resilient Metal
nodes.brief: You clear a jammed axle-box using brute leverage against the stone floor, earning an iron wedge and a strained wrist.
nodes.page: Steam hisses from a leaky gasket nearby, filling the damp air with the taste of sulfur and boiled oil while you work the rusted screw-jacks into the ballast. Every muscle in your back knots against the strain as you lift the dead weight of the engine's lead axle just enough to clear the fouled brake-shoe. The stone beneath your boots is slick with coal-dust and ancient moisture, but the persistent screech finally subsides into a low, rhythmic hum that satisfies the ear. You retrieve your grease-stained tools and steady your breathing in the dark.

nodes.title: Realigning the Valve Gear
nodes.brief: You clear a jammed axle-box using brute leverage against the stone floor, earning an iron wedge and a strained wrist.
nodes.page: The eccentric rod on the port side has slipped its keeper, rattling wildly against the motion plate with every labored pulse of the pistons. You crouch in the narrow clearance between the churning machinery and the damp brickwork, fingers slick with grease as you fumble for the adjusting screw in the pitch-dark shadows. The engine bucks beneath your boots, threatening to crush your knuckles against the iron framing if the timing slips another fraction of an inch while you tighten the locking nut by feel alone.

check.label: Tighten the eccentric rod under strain

nodes.title: A Wrenched Wrist
nodes.brief: You clear a jammed axle-box using brute leverage against the stone floor, earning an iron wedge and a strained wrist.
nodes.page: The wrench slips from the greasy bolt head with a sharp ring, throwing your hand violently against the jagged edge of the valve chest and sending a white-hot line of pain up your forearm. You draw in a ragged, cursing breath, clutching your bruised wrist against your chest as the engine stutters through another heavy stroke. The slip costs precious minutes and leaves a swelling knot of skin that will ache for days, but the bolt is somehow caught well enough to keep the valve from throwing its rod completely.

exits.label: Press onward with a throbbing arm

nodes.title: The Wedge Secured
nodes.brief: You clear a jammed axle-box using brute leverage against the stone floor, earning an iron wedge and a strained wrist.
nodes.page: Your fingers find the precise bite of the thread, spinning the locking nut home just as the cylinder head lets out a sharp, definitive hiss of sealed pressure. The repair holds against the beat of the pistons, and the locomotive's iron heart finds an even rhythm again. You rest on the running board to catch your breath, and your fingers brush an iron wedge left by some long-dead gander crew, notched and scarred by decades of ballast-work.

nodes.title: The Phantom Semaphore
nodes.brief: You stand motionless while a phantom semaphore arm drops right beside your ear, gaining the confidence of the stone-dust echoes.
nodes.page: Absolute silence settles over this abandoned siding, broken only by the slow, rhythmic drip of water from the mortar joints overhead. You stand perfectly still beside the rusted iron pillar, letting your breathing slow until it matches the hum of the stone-dust echoes whispering along the curved ceiling. Without warning, a rusted semaphore arm high up in the shadow-draped vault snaps downward with a loud metallic clatter, welcoming you into the hollow domain of the invisible watchers.

nodes.title: Listening to the Dark
nodes.brief: You stand motionless while a phantom semaphore arm drops right beside your ear, gaining the confidence of the stone-dust echoes.
nodes.page: Whispers drift through the soot-laden air from unseen alcoves, speaking in the clipped, technical shorthand of signalmen who vanished long before the Long Fire burned the steppe. You close your eyes against the suffocating blackness, trying to filter out the frantic beating of your own heart so you can catch the hidden rhythm in the clicking relays overhead. A sudden rush of freezing air sweeps down the cutting, carrying a chorus of phantom bell-codes that threaten to break your concentration and lure you into a blind panic.

check.label: Stand firm against the whispering dark

nodes.title: A Shaken Resolve
nodes.brief: You stand motionless while a phantom semaphore arm drops right beside your ear, gaining the confidence of the stone-dust echoes.
nodes.page: The sudden clang of an unseen junction bell hits your ears like a physical blow, shattering your focus and sending you stumbling backward against the sharp edge of a coal bunker. A cold sweat breaks across your shoulders as phantom footsteps march past in the dark, leaving you gasping for air in the sulfurous gloom. Though you regain your footing before the echoes fade, the encounter leaves a lingering tremor in your hands and a dull ache behind your temples that takes a long time to shake.

exits.label: Drag yourself toward the tunnel exit

nodes.title: The Dropped Arm
nodes.brief: You stand motionless while a phantom semaphore arm drops right beside your ear, gaining the confidence of the stone-dust echoes.
nodes.page:
Quiet settles over the damp stone once the final clank of counterweights fades into the masonry, and only lime-water drips from the vaulted ceiling above. Right beside your ear, a rusted semaphore blade of grey iron shivers once and drops cleanly into the clear position, its signal-glass catching the pale flare of your inspection lamp. This phantom clearance grants you an undisturbed passage through the dead junction, leaving a small measure of spectral favor clinging to your sleeve.

You pocket a brass signal-token, smooth-edged from a century of thumb-rubbing, before stepping back toward the idling tender.

exits.label: Inspect the stalled baggage trucks again

nodes.title: The Grease-Run Bypass
nodes.brief: You trace the hidden grease-runs along the tunnel footing to bypass the blockade, securing an old railway ledger full of toll-receipts.
nodes.page: Blocked by a tangle of rusted luggage trucks across the main track, you drop to your hands and knees to inspect the narrow drainage channel running alongside the tunnel wall. Thick layers of dark, ancient grease still coat the brick invert where previous crews dragged heavy cables through the dark. You crawl through the soot and oily sludge, using the recessed trough to worm your way past the metal barricade without touching the unstable wreckage, and emerge beside a leather pouch dropped by a fleeing clerk.

nodes.title: Navigating the Toll Archive
nodes.brief: You trace the hidden grease-runs along the tunnel footing to bypass the blockade, securing an old railway ledger full of toll-receipts.
nodes.page: Piling through the clutter of abandoned ledgers and water-damaged manifest sheets, you search for the emergency clearance code that might unlock the bulkhead ahead. The air is thick with the scent of rotting paper and dry rot, making your throat scratch with every intake of breath while the faint ticking of a hidden clock echoes through the masonry. Every instinct warns you that pulling the wrong ledger from the stacked archive could trigger a trip-wire connected to an old warning flare or a fallen stack of iron plate.

nodes.title: The Ledger Collapse
nodes.brief: You trace the hidden grease-runs along the tunnel footing to bypass the blockade, securing an old railway ledger full of toll-receipts.
nodes.page: Your fingers catch on the corner of a rotting wooden crate, pulling it just an inch too far before the entire stack of heavy railway ledgers collapses into the muck with a dull, echoing thud. A cloud of black mold and choking ash billows into your face, sending you into a fit of violent coughing that leaves your ribs aching and your eyes watering in the dark. You manage to scramble clear before the remaining shelves give way, but the noise reverberates endlessly down the empty brick vault.

nodes.title: The Toll-Receipt Ledger
nodes.brief: You trace the hidden grease-runs along the tunnel footing to bypass the blockade, securing an old railway ledger full of toll-receipts.
nodes.page: With delicate precision, you slide the leather-bound book free from the damp stack without disturbing the precarious balance of the surrounding debris. Opening the brittle cover by the dim light of your pocket lamp, you reveal page after page of meticulous handwritten toll-receipts signed by the old Stationmaster-General's deputies. It is a useless stack of debt records to anyone else, but tucked inside the back cover is a handwritten routing slip detailing every hidden maintenance hatch through the upper ridge.

nodes.title: Clearing the Track
nodes.brief: You heave the splintered cargo crate out of the gauge with raw shoulder strength, keeping a brass pinch-bar for future leverage.
nodes.page: Wood-splinters and water-swollen pulp wedge tight beneath the iron rails where the ledger stack gave way. You plant your boots against the rusted sleeper-ends, hook your fingers into the grain of the largest crate, and heave with your whole back until the timbers groan in protest. The mass shifts grudgingly, dragging iron grit across the ballast with a sound like grinding teeth. Slipping a heavy brass pinch-bar into the widening gap, you lever the obstruction clear of the running edge just as the engine's firebox sighs in the dark.

nodes.title: Heaving the Heavy Crate
nodes.brief: You heave the splintered cargo crate out of the gauge with raw shoulder strength, keeping a brass pinch-bar for future leverage.
nodes.page: The jammed crate refuses a simple slide, wedged hard between the stock rail and the check-rail in a tangle of swollen cardboard and sodden paper. You drop your weight low, curling your biceps around the slippery timber and driving your boots deep into the grit to find purchase against the sleeper-bed. Muscles bunch across your shoulders and the blood roars in your ears as you haul upward with every ounce of raw strength left in your frame, straining to break the crate's stubborn grip on the track.

check.label: Wrench the timber from the gauge

nodes.title: Strained Sinews and Splinters
nodes.brief: You heave the splintered cargo crate out of the gauge with raw shoulder strength, keeping a brass pinch-bar for future leverage.
nodes.page: A hot stitch stabs deep into your shoulder-blade as the crate slips an inch, its jagged corner raking a raw red line across your forearm before dropping back into the muck with a heavy thud. You lean against the boiler casing, chest heaving and sweat stinging your eyes as you catch your breath against the dull, throbbing ache in your joints. The delay costs precious minutes against the storm clock, leaving you bruised and stiff, but the rail is clear enough now to let the iron wheels turn again.

nodes.title: The Unyielding Obstruction
nodes.brief: You heave the splintered cargo crate out of the gauge with raw shoulder strength, keeping a brass pinch-bar for future leverage.
nodes.page: Sinews strain to their absolute limit until the stubborn timber finally gives a sharp, dry crack and tears free from the grip of the rail. You stumble backward onto the ballast, clutching a heavy brass pinch-bar as your prize while the blocked gauge opens up before you. Whether through sheer brute force or stubborn luck, the way is clear at last, leaving you bruised in the shoulder but richer by one solid tool for the road ahead.

nodes.title: The Signalman's Descent
nodes.brief: The Marrowbone shudders to a halt as a pale, oil-soaked figure swings down from the ceiling rafters with a green signal lantern.
nodes.page: The Marrowbone shudders to a sudden halt as a pale, oil-soaked figure swings down from the low brick rafters with a green signal lantern in hand. The newcomer dangles just above the smokebox, legs wrapped in canvas bindings that trail greasy threads through the rising steam. A voice like dry parchment rustling in a draught asks if you carry the dispatch or merely the debt, and the lantern tips to show eyes milky with coal-smoke and centuries of underground watch.

nodes.title: The Lantern-Roost
nodes.brief: The Lantern-Roost: Hollow Signalmen hang suspended from iron chains above the boiler hatch, muttering timetables from forgotten decades.
nodes.page: Hollow Signalmen hang suspended from iron chains above the boiler hatch, muttering timetables from forgotten decades while their green lanterns cast sickly arcs across the vaulted ceiling. Lamp-oil, wet soot, and ancient iron scent the air, along with the ghost of unread manifests and phantom departures. Below their swinging boots, several dark paths branch off into the masonry, each one marked by a different flickering signal flame and the distant echo of dripping water.

nodes.title: Matching the Rhythm
nodes.brief: You adjust the regulator valve to match the ghostly signal's rhythmic pulse, winning a tin of machine tallow and a clear berth.
nodes.page: You reach up to adjust the brass regulator valve, turning the heavy wheel a fraction at a time until its hiss matches the rhythmic pulse of the signalman's lantern above. The engine settles into a steady, contented thrum as the steam pressure balances out against the damp tunnel air. A tin of thick machine tallow drops from the chains overhead as a silent nod of approval from the rafters, granting you a clear berth through the shadow-swamped junction.

nodes.title: Through the Iron Vaults
nodes.brief: You adjust the regulator valve to match the ghostly signal's rhythmic pulse, winning a tin of machine tallow and a clear berth.
nodes.page: Iron plates clank rhythmically beneath the wheels as the Marrowbone creeps deeper into the vaulted network of the Hollow Cut. The grease-smeared walls press close on either side, studded with rusted brackets and old signal wires that twitch every time a distant train passes through the rock. You keep one hand resting lightly on the brass regulator, watching the grey steam curl back from the cylinders and vanish into the gloom ahead.

nodes.title: Balancing the Valve
nodes.brief: You adjust the regulator valve to match the ghostly signal's rhythmic pulse, winning a tin of machine tallow and a clear berth.
nodes.page: The injector pipe begins to sputter, coughing white steam into the cab as a crust of mineral scale threatens to choke the feed-line entirely. You grab a slender copper wire and a small spanner, leaning out over the throbbing machinery to clear the valve-seat before the water level drops too low in the glass. Fingers working by touch alone in the dim amber light, you feel for the obstruction inside the narrow brass throat, praying the union nut holds against the rising pressure.

nodes.title: Choked and Scalded
nodes.brief: You adjust the regulator valve to match the ghostly signal's rhythmic pulse, winning a tin of machine tallow and a clear berth.
nodes.page: A sudden hiss of boiling spray spits past your knuckles, scalding the back of your hand and leaving a stinging red welt that throbs in time with the engine's beat. You jerk your arm back with a sharp intake of breath, dropping the spanner into the dark belly of the engine pit as the injector sputters and dies. Precious minutes slip away while you rig a temporary leather wrap to stop the hiss, losing a flask of fresh water and gaining a painful reminder of the boiler's temper.

nodes.title: The Clean Adjustment
nodes.brief: You adjust the regulator valve to match the ghostly signal's rhythmic pulse, winning a tin of machine tallow and a clear berth.
nodes.page: Fingers working with desperate, practiced speed, you tap the valve seat just right and feel the obstruction break apart beneath the wire. Cool water rushes back down the feed-pipe with a deep gulp and restores the boiler's pulse just before the gauge glass could empty. Whether by skill or sheer good fortune, you secure a tin of fresh machine tallow from the rack, leaving the engine humming smoothly as you return to the footplate.

nodes.title: The Lime Smudge
nodes.brief: You endure the vacant stare of a hanging keeper without flinching, earning a smudge of protective lime behind your collar.
nodes.page:
Hanging motionless from the soot-caked roof beams of the tunnel, a signal keeper stares down with eyes like boiled glass. You endure the vacant gaze without flinching, keeping your hand steady upon the brass handrail of the footplate as Marrowbone creeps through the sulfurous dark. A dry, powdery hand descends from the shadows to brush your collar, leaving a thick smudge of protective lime that smells of old mortar and damp stone.

The silent watcher retreats into the masonry overhead, and you are left alone with the rhythmic breathing of the boiler as the line dips deeper underground.

nodes.title: Staring Down The Keeper
nodes.brief: You endure the vacant stare of a hanging keeper without flinching, earning a smudge of protective lime behind your collar.
nodes.page:
More suspended figures emerge from the gloom ahead, their pale faces catching the amber glare of the firebox door as you rumble toward a junction of rusted switch-levers. A skeletal keeper swings directly into your path, dangling by a frayed harness right above the regulator handle, testing your nerve with a sudden, twitching jerk of its chin. Your gaze locks and you keep your pulse from betraying your dread before the figure drops.

Planting your boots firmly against the ribbed iron floor, you lock your eyes onto the hollow sockets above and reach out to steady the regulator.

check.label: Hold your nerve against the hanging watcher

nodes.title: A Slip in the Dark
nodes.brief: You endure the vacant stare of a hanging keeper without flinching, earning a smudge of protective lime behind your collar.
nodes.page:
Your nerve breaks for a fraction of a second as the dangling figure brushes hard against your shoulder, sending a jolt of cold sweat down your spine. In that momentary lapse, your boot slips on the grease-slicked deck of the footplate, and your forearm catches hard against the sharp iron lip of the coal bunker. A deep, ugly bruise blooms instantly beneath your sleeve, throbbing in time with the pistons.

You catch yourself against the brass manifold before falling, but precious seconds have ticked away while the engine drifted unchecked.

exits.label: Recover your footing and press on

nodes.title: The Smudge of Safety
