nodes.brief: You endure the vacant stare of a hanging keeper without flinching, earning a smudge of protective lime behind your collar.
nodes.page: Whether by steady grit or sheer desperate luck, you keep your breathing even and your hand locked to the controls as the swinging figure drifts harmlessly aside into the trailing smoke. The lime-smudge on your collar settles like a cold seal of approval from the vault-dwellers, and the hanging shapes part just enough to let Marrowbone rumble through. For your trouble, you pocket a scrap of chalk-marked canvas dropped from the harness above.

exits.label: Follow the rails into the lantern-roost

nodes.title: Recalling the Rails
nodes.brief: You negotiate a passage by quoting the 1894 working timetable back to the rafters, securing a map of hidden bypass sidings.
nodes.page:
Damp air currents swirl out from a narrow side-tunnel, carrying the faint, metallic scent of stagnant water and old grease. You negotiate a passage through the echoing archway by quoting the 1894 working timetable back to the unseen rafters, reciting train numbers and coal allowances until the stone walls seem to hum in agreement. A folded paper drops from a cleft in the brickwork, landing softly upon the coal shovel.

Unfolding it reveals a detailed map of hidden bypass sidings that loop around the main blockade.

nodes.title: The Working Timetable
nodes.brief: You negotiate a passage by quoting the 1894 working timetable back to the rafters, securing a map of hidden bypass sidings.
nodes.page:
The tunnel splits into three identical iron-plated bores, each vanishing into absolute blackness with no signal lamps to guide your choice. Only your memory of the old timetables and the subtle pitch of the subterranean drafts can tell you which line leads to the Cinderfall approach without plunging you into a collapsed gallery. You lean out past the cab side, listening for the faint whistle of distant steam that marks the correct passage.

Narrowing your eyes against the acrid drift, you weigh the gradients and reach for the reverser lever.

check.label: Decode the junction by memory and draft

nodes.title: A Wrong Turning
nodes.brief: You negotiate a passage by quoting the 1894 working timetable back to the rafters, securing a map of hidden bypass sidings.
nodes.page:
You misread the subtle drift of the air, mistaking a dead ventilation shaft for the main branch, and Marrowbone noses heavily into a choked dead-end of fallen masonry. Reversing out takes frantic minutes of sweat and cursing, burning precious coal while the engine's firebox coughs a cloud of bitter dust back into your face. The delay leaves a coating of grey ash inside your throat that makes every breath taste of old cinders.

You haul the lever over and guide the engine back to the proper junction, bruised in pride and short on time.

exits.label: Back out and take the correct branch

nodes.title: The Working Timetable
nodes.brief: You negotiate a passage by quoting the 1894 working timetable back to the rafters, securing a map of hidden bypass sidings.
nodes.page: By reciting the 1894 working timetable from memory, your voice echoing off the soot-stained rafters where the Hollow Signalmen crouch like crows, you earn a begrudging nod from the shadows. A folded slip of grease-stained vellum drops into your palm, bearing the ink-stamped seal of the line's forgotten chief engineer. It details every hidden bypass siding and auxiliary shunt tucked away behind the masonry, offering a clear run through the dark labyrinth ahead.

exits.label: Step through into the water-choked grotto

nodes.title: Clearing the Feed
nodes.brief: You purge a choked injector line with frantic wire-work before the gauge glass shatters, saving a spare pressure valve.
nodes.page:
White steam hisses angrily from beneath the lagging as mineral scale builds inside the feed-pipe, threatening to choke the water supply to the boiler entirely. You purge the choked injector line with frantic wire-work, scraping away the crust of lime just before the glass gauge shatters from the mounting pressure. A sigh of relief escapes your lips as the water level stabilizes in the column.

You pocket a spare pressure valve retrieved from the tool locker before checking the steam gauge again.

exits.label: Watch the steady steam pressure rise

nodes.title: Through the Damp Arch
nodes.brief: You purge a choked injector line with frantic wire-work before the gauge glass shatters, saving a spare pressure valve.
nodes.page:
The low roof of the cutting presses down upon the cab, dripping condensation onto the brass fittings and the deck plates below. You keep your rag moving across the instrument faces, wiping away the grey grime so the dials remain legible in the gloom. Marrowbone labors against the upward gradient, its exhaust thumping rhythmically against the stone ceiling in a steady, reassuring cadence.

Ahead, the tunnel opens slightly where an old telegraph alcove gapes empty in the brickwork.

exits.label: Roll past the empty telegraph alcove

nodes.title: The Pressure Spike
nodes.brief: You purge a choked injector line with frantic wire-work before the gauge glass shatters, saving a spare pressure valve.
nodes.page:
The needle on the boiler pressure gauge creeps past the red line, trembling violently as the safety valve sticks fast against its seat in the searing heat. If you cannot tap the valve spindle with precisely the right force using your brass mallet, the copper vessel will rupture in the confined space of the tunnel. You take the tool in both hands and lean over the hot boiler jacket, squinting through the shimmering air toward the jammed housing.

Raising the mallet, you measure the distance and prepare to strike the trembling brass casing.

check.label: Strike the jammed valve housing true

nodes.title: A Burned Knuckle
nodes.brief: You purge a choked injector line with frantic wire-work before the gauge glass shatters, saving a spare pressure valve.
nodes.page:
Your mallet blow lands an inch off target, glancing harmlessly off the thick iron lagging and sending a sharp vibration straight up your wrist. A jet of scalding steam spits sideways from the housing, searing the skin across your knuckles and leaving a painful, blistering red welt that throbs with every beat of the engine. You drop the mallet onto the deck with a metallic clatter.

You manage to jam a wooden wedge into the linkage with your other hand just in time, but the pain remains a sharp reminder of the narrow margin.

exits.label: Tend the burn and push forward

nodes.title: The Spared Valve
nodes.brief: You purge a choked injector line with frantic wire-work before the gauge glass shatters, saving a spare pressure valve.
nodes.page: With a sharp crack of tempered metal, your precise tap unseats the jammed valve, and a deafening roar fills the cab as excess steam discharges safely up the chimney. The pressure needle drops back into the green zone while the boiler settles into a steady, rhythmic thrum. You wipe the sweat from your brow with a soot-stained sleeve, richer by a sturdy spare component salvaged from the repair shelf.

nodes.title: The Sealing Gland
nodes.brief: You reseal the leaking steam gland under a barrage of dripping condensation, retaining a heavy copper gasket for repairs.
nodes.page:
Scalding droplets spit from the failing packing ring, stinging your bare forearm every time the piston rod thrusts through the bulkhead. Condensation slicks the iron floorplates beneath your boots, turning every step into a cautious slide above the roaring pit. Wrapping a thick rag around your palm, you lean into the heat to reach the rusted securing bolts.

The heavy copper gasket comes free with a sharp metallic screech, leaving behind a scarred seating that demands immediate attention before the cylinder pressure drops entirely away.

exits.label: Reach for the spanner and fresh packing

nodes.title: Beneath the Condensation
nodes.brief: You reseal the leaking steam gland under a barrage of dripping condensation, retaining a heavy copper gasket for repairs.
nodes.page:
Hissing plumes of white vapour curl around your shoulders, obscuring the dim amber glow of the cab lamp and coating your cheeks in greasy moisture. You work entirely by touch in the deafening roar, fingers searching for the exact angle to seat the replacement ring without barking your knuckles against the hot casting. The engine shudders beneath you as it shoulders another heavy grade in the deep dark.

You hook the thick copper gasket into position, feeling the stubborn metal conform at last to the worn contours of the gland.

exits.label: Tighten the retaining bolts by hand

nodes.title: The Sealing Torque
nodes.brief: You reseal the leaking steam gland under a barrage of dripping condensation, retaining a heavy copper gasket for repairs.
nodes.page: Sweat runs down your spine. You seat a box spanner on the final retaining nut and brace your boots against the vibrating floorplate. The threads bind hard against rust and old scale, threatening to strip entirely if you apply an ounce too much force, yet leaving them loose invites a catastrophic blow-out under full boiler load. You draw a slow breath of sulphurous air, plant your shoulder against the bulkhead, and throw your weight onto the wrench handle.

check.label: Wrench the rusted gland bolt home

nodes.title: A Wrenched Wrist
nodes.brief: You reseal the leaking steam gland under a barrage of dripping condensation, retaining a heavy copper gasket for repairs.
nodes.page:
A vicious crack echoes through the cramped housing as the spanner slips from the rounded nut, sending your knuckles smashing hard into the sharp edge of the cylinder casing. A hot bolt of pain shoots straight up your forearm, leaving you gasping against the iron bulkhead while steam hisses angrily from the imperfect seal. You clutch your throbbing hand to your chest, tasting copper and ash in the damp air.

Although the leak continues to weep a thin, stubborn stream of grey condensation across your boots, the engine chugs onward through the darkness.

exits.label: Wipe the blood and press on

nodes.title: The Copper Gasket
nodes.brief: You reseal the leaking steam gland under a barrage of dripping condensation, retaining a heavy copper gasket for repairs.
nodes.page:
Your knuckles take a bruising against the iron lagging, but the final turn holds true as the stubborn nut bites deep into the fresh metal. The angry hissing settles into a rhythmic sigh. The cylinder housing stays dry and secure against the creeping damp of the tunnels. You pry the old, flattened ring from its seat and toss it into your tool chest as a heavy memento of the subterranean struggle.

The Marrowbone rolls rhythmically deeper into the gloom, carrying its warm brass and steady fires toward the heart of the range.

nodes.title: The Subterranean Grotto
nodes.brief: The tunnel opens into a vast subterranean grotto where stagnant black water laps against the rusted chassis of derailed coal tenders.
nodes.page:
Darkness swallows the headlight beam as the tunnel walls peel away into a cavernous vault where stagnant black water laps against the rusted chassis of derailed coal tenders. Ribs of rotting timber arch overhead like the skeleton of some iron-bellied leviathan, dripping greasy moisture into the sump below. Far across the mirrored surface, pale lanterns swing in a slow, mournful rhythm from unseen gantries.

The air smells of wet slate and old grease, thick enough to chew, carrying the faint, rhythmic chime of a distant bell that marks no earthly hour.

exits.label: Pick a path toward the swinging lights

nodes.title: The Sump Basin
nodes.brief: The Sump Basin: A subterranean lock-gate stands locked across the permanent way while oily black water rises toward the firebox.
nodes.page: A subterranean lock-gate stands locked across the permanent way while oily black water rises steadily toward the glowing ashpan of the firebox. Iron catwalks stretch away into the Stygian gloom, hung with rusted chains and the pale, silent shapes of the Hollow Signalmen peering down from their perches. Every shadow seems to reach toward the warmth of the boiler, whispering old timetables and forgotten debts from the days before the ash-storms.

exits.label: Wade through the rising bilge water
Haul the heavy sluice chain taut
Wrestle the jammed drainage wheel around
Rig a makeshift telegraph wire bridge
Steady the primary bypass valve handle
Pick a narrow cleft in the limestone

nodes.title: The Sinking Track
nodes.brief: You drag a heavy timber baulk across the mire to shore up the sinking track-bed, securing a dry sack of dry oak kindling.
nodes.page:
Black water laps greedily at the lower rungs of your ladder as you drag a heavy timber baulk across the shifting mire to shore up the sinking track-bed. The ooze sucks at your boots with every strained step, smelling of old coal-dust and dead sulfur from decades of stagnant flood. Overhead, the low brick vaulting weeps gray condensation down upon your shoulders like cold sweat.

You wedge the squared timber firmly beneath the sagging rail chair, securing a dry sack of oak kindling salvaged from a rotting crate wedged in the muck.

exits.label: Push deeper into the flooded cutting

nodes.title: The Waterlogged Crib
nodes.brief: You drag a heavy timber baulk across the mire to shore up the sinking track-bed, securing a dry sack of dry oak kindling.
nodes.page:
Stagnant ripples spread from your shins as you wade the knee-deep sump and guide the timber toward the washout beneath the rail. Damp chill soaks your trousers, yet the engine's distant boiler pulses a reassuring warmth into your back. You wedge the dry wood tight into the ballast gap, feeling the iron rails settle just an inch above the dark water.

A cluster of rusted signal levers leans drunkenly from the sludge nearby, their glazed porcelain weights cracked and blank.

exits.label: Climb up to the rusted catwalk

nodes.title: The Mire Heave
nodes.brief: You drag a heavy timber baulk across the mire to shore up the sinking track-bed, securing a dry sack of dry oak kindling.
nodes.page: A massive timber balk jams fast in the sucking mud just as the water surges higher against the ashpan doors, threatening to douse the vital coals. You brace your boots against the submerged chassis of an overturned coal tub, grabbing the rough, splintered oak with both hands. Veins stand out on your neck as you pit your muscles against the dead weight of the mire and the pressing tide.

check.label: Heave the timber from the muck

nodes.title: The Sucking Mire
nodes.brief: You drag a heavy timber baulk across the mire to shore up the sinking track-bed, securing a dry sack of dry oak kindling.
nodes.page:
The mud refuses to yield, giving way with a sickening suction that yanks you off balance and sends you sprawling chest-deep into the oily, freezing sump. Water floods your pockets and coats your skin in a gritty film of coal-wash, knocking the wind from your lungs with a sharp gasp. You drag yourself upright by a dangling signal wire, shivering violently in the damp gloom.

Although the timber remains wedged at an awkward angle, the Marrowbone holds its steam and waits for you to return to the footplate.

exits.label: Climb back aboard the slippery deck

nodes.title: The Oak Kindling
nodes.brief: You drag a heavy timber baulk across the mire to shore up the sinking track-bed, securing a dry sack of dry oak kindling.
nodes.page:
With a mighty heave of your back and shoulders, you wrench the heavy timber clear of the sucking mire and slam it home beneath the sinking rail joint. The track holds firm against the weight of the locomotive, keeping the firebox high and dry above the black water. You salvage a dry canvas sack of seasoned oak kindling from the ledge above, shaking the grey dust from its folds.

The Marrowbone hums appreciatively as you toss a handful of the dry wood into the open furnace door.

exits.label: Return to the central sump basin

nodes.title: The Sluice Chains
nodes.brief: You haul the sluice chains against a surging tide of bilge-water, keeping a greasy iron shackle and a bruised shoulder.
nodes.page: Heavy drops of condensation patter against your neck like cold grease as you grope along the dripping masonry of the culvert. Beneath the floorboards, the black water surges with a rhythmic, throat-deep roar, smelling strongly of old oil and drowned lime. Your fingers find the salted iron of the primary sluice chain, slick with slime and crusted with decades of mineral scale. Every fiber in your shoulders aches from the preceding heave, but the level of the sump continues to inch upward toward the trembling ashpan doors of the engine. Pulling this line asks for every ounce you have left and firm footing on the slime-slick duckboards. You loop the cold links twice around your raw palms, brace your boots against a stanchion of rusted angle-iron, and throw your entire weight backward into the dark.

exits.label: Haul upon the slimy chain links

nodes.title: Dragging the Iron
nodes.brief: You haul the sluice chains against a surging tide of bilge-water, keeping a greasy iron shackle and a bruised shoulder.
nodes.page: Iron groans against stone as the links slip through your bleeding grip, yielding inches of grudging progress against the immense hydrostatic weight pressing from beyond the bulkhead. The cold air inside the tunnel vibrates with the low-frequency thrum of the Marrowbone idling in the gloom behind you. Somewhere up in the vaulted brickwork, a single green signal lamp flickers erratically, casting long, wavering shadows across the greasy surface of the rising flood. You take another turn of the chain around your forearm, ignoring the sharp bite of the metal against bruised skin, and strain for the critical notch where the dog-catch finally seats itself. The water laps eagerly at your boot-tops, carrying flecks of gray ash and oily scum that cling to your trousers like a shroud.

exits.label: Force the dog into its notch

nodes.title: The Sluice Gate Leap
nodes.brief: You haul the sluice chains against a surging tide of bilge-water, keeping a greasy iron shackle and a bruised shoulder.
nodes.page: Water boils up around your thighs with the force of a small mill-race, threatening to sweep your footing away from the narrow drainage ledge altogether. The heavy cast-iron dog-catch hovers just an inch shy of its retaining slot, vibrating with the immense strain of the backed-up bilge. If the bolt slips now, the surge will slam back into the pit with enough force to swamp the firebox and leave the Marrowbone dead in the water beneath the mountain. You bunch your muscles, grit your teeth against the raw pain in your shoulder, and launch your entire body weight upward to drive the stubborn locking pin home into its rusted socket before the current rips the chain from your grasp.

check.label: Heave the stubborn sluice pin home

nodes.title: Slips in the Sump
nodes.brief: You haul the sluice chains against a surging tide of bilge-water, keeping a greasy iron shackle and a bruised shoulder.
nodes.page: Slip and splash, the metal bar kicks back with a vicious clatter that rings off the wet brick vaulting, tearing the skin clean from your palm and sending you sprawling backward into the freezing, oily sump. The black water closes over your head for a breathless second, tasting of sulphur and ancient coal-dust, before you thrash upward, gasping and shivering in the dark. Your shoulder flares with a hot, tearing pain where it struck the projecting stone corner of the culvert, leaving a purple-black bruise that will throb for days. The sluice gate stays only half-drawn, so dirty water hisses into the lower trench in a thin trickle that costs you precious minutes and burns away the last of your dry matches.

nodes.title: The Greasy Shackle
nodes.brief: You haul the sluice chains against a surging tide of bilge-water, keeping a greasy iron shackle and a bruised shoulder.
nodes.page: Your shoulder muscle holds against the sudden hydraulic backlash, and the iron dog-catch drops into its retaining notch with a dull, satisfying thud. The surging tide immediately loses its frantic momentum, gurgling away down the secondary drainage pipes with a long, exhausted sigh that clears the ashpan doors just in time. As you straighten up, rubbing your bruised arm and wiping black slime from your eyes, your fingers brush against a stray piece of salvage wedged behind the iron bracket - a stout, grease-stained shackle forged from good Ashgate steel that has never seen a flaw. You pocket the heavy piece of metal, knowing its worth in a place where nothing manufactured ever stays whole for long.

nodes.title: The Rusted Wheel
nodes.brief: You wrestle the jammed sluice wheel past its rusted seat until the flood drains away, earning a brass drainage cock.
nodes.page: Turning the brass drainage wheel demands a slow, agonizing rotation against decades of accumulated lime-scale and dried boiler compound. Your knuckles scrape raw against the damp limestone wall as you apply every ounce of leverage you possess, coaxing the stubborn mechanism around one millimeter at a time. A thin, high-pitched squeal rises from the packing-gland, turning into a wet gurgle as stagnant water finally begins to weep past the valve seat and trickle away into the dark below. The air clears slightly of the worst sulphur stench, replaced by the clean, metallic tang of cold brass and wet stone. You take a ragged breath, letting the chill subterranean damp settle deep into your woolen waistcoat while you wait for the pressure to equalize.

nodes.title: The Valve Seat
nodes.brief: You wrestle the jammed sluice wheel past its rusted seat until the flood drains away, earning a brass drainage cock.
nodes.page: The brass wheel sticks hard at the three-quarter mark, jammed immovably by a grit-encrusted thread that refuses to yield to ordinary persuasion. Beyond the partition, the water level taps a steady, menacing tattoo against the lower boiler plating, warning that time has nearly run out for the engine's draft. You grab a short length of rusted iron pipe from the debris at your feet, slip it over the spoke of the wheel to gain extra leverage, and lean your full weight into the improvised extension with your eyes fixed on the stubborn seating. The metal of the wheel shudders under the strain, balanced precisely between stripping the ancient threads entirely or clearing the obstruction with one sudden snap.

nodes.title: Stripped Threads
nodes.brief: You wrestle the jammed sluice wheel past its rusted seat until the flood drains away, earning a brass drainage cock.
nodes.page: A dry, metallic crack splits the damp silence of the tunnel as the internal threads shear clean away under your sudden exertion. The wheel spins wildly out of control, wrapping your knuckles painfully against the rough stone wall and leaving you empty-handed as the valve drops shut again. Dirty water sloshes over your boots once more, cold and indifferent to your efforts, while a dull ache settles deep into your bruised wrist. You are forced to spend a grueling quarter-hour hacking away at the jammed packing with a pocket-knife, losing precious minutes and gathering a long, stinging scratch across your forearm before the drainage flow is finally established by hand.

exits.label: Climb back to the engine deck

nodes.title: The Drainage Cock
nodes.brief: You wrestle the jammed sluice wheel past its rusted seat until the flood drains away, earning a brass drainage cock.
nodes.page: However narrowly, the wheel breaks past its rusted seat with a sharp report, and the blocked channel opens wide to vent the accumulated filth into the deep sumps. As the water level drops away from the lower stays, your hand encounters a loose fitting in the debris - an intact, heavy brass drainage cock with its ground-glass core still bright and unblemished beneath the grime. You pocket the small prize, recognizing the fine work of the old Ashgate shops before the Rail Barons standardized everything to cheap cast iron. As you pocket it, an old signalman sitting in the recess of the archway nods approvingly, recognizing the care you take with machinery and noting your respect for the old timetables.

nodes.title: The Telegraph Wire
nodes.brief: You rig a system of block and tackle using discarded telegraph wire, securing an intact block and a dry dry-cell battery.
nodes.page: Scraps of discarded telegraph wire litter the ballast here like the silver entrails of some metal beast long since gutted by scavengers. You kneel beside the tangled heap, your fingers sorting through the cold copper strands until you find a length that retains its gutta-percha insulation without serious cracking. Beside it lies an intact porcelain block, smooth and cold, and a heavy dry-cell battery that still shows a faint trace of chemical life when you test its terminals against your tongue. You bind the materials with greasy twine into a makeshift hoist line that can drag gear across the treacherous mud-sumps without another plunge into the mire.

exits.label: Rig the line across the gap

nodes.title: The Rigging
nodes.brief: You rig a system of block and tackle using discarded telegraph wire, securing an intact block and a dry dry-cell battery.
nodes.page: Threading the insulated wire through the porcelain block requires stiff, freezing fingers and absolute concentration in the dim, flickering light of your oil lantern. The distant rumble of the engine's blower echoes down the tunnel, reminding you that the fire on the grate must not be neglected for too long if steam pressure is to be maintained against the mountain grade. You anchor one end of the line around a stout granite pillar embedded in the tunnel wall, testing the tension with a sharp tug that sets the porcelain humming softly in the damp air. It is a neat, seamanlike job born of long hours on the permanent way, designed to span the black water without asking favors of the broken tracks.

nodes.title: The Wire Hoist
nodes.brief: You rig a system of block and tackle using discarded telegraph wire, securing an intact block and a dry dry-cell battery.
nodes.page: The heavy gear basket hangs suspended from your improvised copper line, swinging slowly above the black, oil-slicked waters of the inner sump. If the salvaged wire holds its splice under the sudden dead weight of the iron jacks, you can swing the entire kit across the gap in a single smooth pull; if the old insulation parts where it rubs against the sharp granite edge, everything will plunge irrevocably into the deep silt below. You gather the slack into your mittened hands, plant your boots firmly against the uneven sleepers, and give the hauling line a sharp, testing tug to commit the cargo to the air.

check.label: Haul the gear across the sump

nodes.title: The Snapped Splice
nodes.brief: You rig a system of block and tackle using discarded telegraph wire, securing an intact block and a dry dry-cell battery.
nodes.page: The copper splice parts with a sharp, singing snap that echoes off the curved brickwork like a pistol shot. The gear basket drops at once, hits the black sump with a sucking splash, and throws a foul-smelling spray of oily mud across your chest and face. You haul back the frayed end of the line before it whips out of reach, but the block and the dry-cell battery are gone, swallowed by the shifting mire below. The loss leaves your pockets lighter and your temper frayed, forcing you to wade the remaining distance through the freezing muck on foot with your lantern held high above your head.

nodes.title: The Rigged Wire
nodes.brief: You rig a system of block and tackle using discarded telegraph wire, securing an intact block and a dry dry-cell battery.
nodes.page: Coiling the discarded telegraph wire with methodical care, you lash the intact porcelain block to the iron stanchion above the sump. The dry-cell battery slips snugly into its leather sling; its terminals hiss against a stray bead of moisture, then catch and hold a clean current. That salvaged charge bridges the gap, lighting your way through the slick dark.

exits.label: Climb back down to the sump basin

nodes.title: The Scalding Room
nodes.brief: You hold your breath in the rising vapor while steadying the primary bypass valve, winning a waterproof oilskin map case.
nodes.page: Steam hisses from the rusted manifold, filling the cramped cabin with a dense, blinding fog that tastes of copper and boiled tallow. You keep your footing on the slick deck plates, sliding your fingers along the primary bypass valve until the wheel stops its juddering rattle. The pressure gauge settles into a safe mid-mark. On a shelf you find a dry oilskin case.

exits.label: Slip the waterproof case into your tunic

nodes.title: The Steaming Valve
nodes.brief: You hold your breath in the rising vapor while steadying the primary bypass valve, winning a waterproof oilskin map case.
nodes.page: Condensation drips from the copper ceiling, striking your shoulders like cold needles as you navigate the narrow walkway beside the boiler. The air is thick enough to chew, smelling sharply of heated grease and mineral scale. Moving with deliberate caution, you secure the loose coupling on the pressure line before the temperature climbs any higher in the enclosed space.

exits.label: Advance deeper into the tunnel mist

nodes.title: The Scalding Bypass
nodes.brief: You hold your breath in the rising vapor while steadying the primary bypass valve, winning a waterproof oilskin map case.
nodes.page: Scald-heat rolls off the brass housing in heavy, suffocating waves, fogging your goggles and slicking the deck plates with greasy condensate. Your hands hover over the screaming valve while the pressure needle pins itself hard against the red sector, threatening to split the copper elbow wide open. You slow your breathing against the roar of the boiler and reach out your fingers to catch the spinning wheel.

nodes.title: The Scald-Burn
nodes.brief: You hold your breath in the rising vapor while steadying the primary bypass valve, winning a waterproof oilskin map case.
nodes.page: Boiling vapor bites through your canvas sleeve with a sharp hiss, leaving a red, stinging welt across your forearm that throbs with every beat of your pulse. You lose your grip on the spinning wheel as the pressure slams the metal casing, venting a hot cloud that leaves you coughing and groping blindly in the grey gloom. The engine stutters, burning precious time and leaving you bruised.

exits.label: Gather your breath and press forward

nodes.title: The Sealed Case
nodes.brief: You hold your breath in the rising vapor while steadying the primary bypass valve, winning a waterproof oilskin map case.
nodes.page: Through the haze of steam and scalding water, your fingers find the toggle and lock the bypass valve into its proper groove with a satisfying metallic click. The pressure drops back into the green and stays low. On the bracket beside the manifold rests a dry, oilskin map case untouched by the damp. You slide it free of the clips, your thumb testing the sealed brass clasp.

exits.label: Return to the main sump basin

nodes.title: The Limestone Cleft
nodes.brief: Locomotive No. 9 wheezes through a cleft in the limestone where the air tastes sharply of old copper and burnt sage.
nodes.page: Locomotive No. 9 wheezes through a narrow cleft in the limestone where the air tastes sharply of old copper and burnt sage. The engine's wheels grind against stone walls that weep rusty moisture, and the headlight paints long pale arcs across ancient timber shoring. Every rivet in the iron chassis rattles in rhythm with the subterranean draft, answering some hidden pulse buried deep beneath the mountain root.

exits.label: Follow the rails into the dark

nodes.title: The Whisper Vault
nodes.brief: The Whisper-Vault: Archways carved into the cave walls echo with the recorded voices of every driver who perished here.
nodes.page: Archways carved into the cave walls echo with the recorded voices of every driver who perished here, their ghostly words blending into a continuous, murmuring tide of soot-stained gossip. The damp air smells of cold coal dust and old iron, carrying fragments of vanished timetables through the dark. Ahead, the cavern splits into several distinct paths, each marked by flickering signal lamps hung from rusted brackets.

exits.label: Press onward through the echoing arch
Listen closely to the acoustic stone
Shoulder through the rotten timber partition
Approach the barricade of iron sleepers

nodes.title: The Familiar Cadence
nodes.brief: You listen to the whispering wall until you catch the cadence of Hesper Quill's familiar voice, gaining a warning about poisoned rails.
nodes.page: You listen to the whispering wall until you catch the cadence of Hesper Quill's familiar voice repeating a warning about poisoned rails buried beneath the ash. The stone gives up its secrets in a dry, rattling whisper that sounds precisely like grease sliding down a cold piston. You pocket the advice, your fingers brushing the cold metal of the Water Key at your belt.

exits.label: Follow the warning toward the junction

nodes.title: The Acoustic Echo
nodes.brief: You listen to the whispering wall until you catch the cadence of Hesper Quill's familiar voice, gaining a warning about poisoned rails.
nodes.page: Voices overlap in the limestone corridor, rising from a murmur to a frantic clamor of past engine failures and warning bells. You press your palms against the vibrating rock face, trying to isolate Hesper Quill's distinct register from the howling subterranean draft. The stone grows unnaturally cold beneath your skin as a specific sentence detaches itself from the babble, demanding your full attention.

nodes.title: The Deafening Babble
nodes.brief: You listen to the whispering wall until you catch the cadence of Hesper Quill's familiar voice, gaining a warning about poisoned rails.
nodes.page: A sudden surge of competing voices strikes your ears like a physical blow, driving a spike of sharp pain behind your temples and leaving you dizzy on the ballast. You stumble against the damp limestone wall, shaking your head to clear the ringing confusion while precious minutes slip away in the dark. The acoustic shock leaves you drained, but the worst of the howling fades into a dull ache.

exits.label: Shake off the dizziness and advance

nodes.title: The Cadence of Hesper
nodes.brief: You listen to the whispering wall until you catch the cadence of Hesper Quill's familiar voice, gaining a warning about poisoned rails.
nodes.page: The babble subsides into a rhythmic drop of water against limestone. Your head clears, and your boots press into the grit. You catch the distinct, clipped cadence of Hesper Quill's voice echoing from a salt-crusted seam in the rock, mapping out the precise stretch of poisoned rails where the sleeper-spikes have been treated with green vitriol to rot the gauge. That secret warning stays with you, a sharp piece of practical knowledge earned through sheer endurance in the dark.

exits.label: Follow the voice toward the damp draught

nodes.title: The Stone Sieve
nodes.brief: You decipher the acoustic reverberations to map the hidden fissures in the rock, earning a small pouch of sparkling pyrite.
nodes.page:
Moisture beads along the limestone ribs overhead and drops with a hollow rhythm into the oily puddles between the ties. You press your palms against the damp masonry of the drift, feeling the subterranean pulse where the cold rock meets the iron frame of the Cutting. A pale seam of quartz snakes through the grey shale, humming faintly with the draft of distant air-shafts. By leaning your ear against the partition, you can trace the hollow resonance of unseen chambers branching off into the dark.

Following this acoustic thread leads you past a forgotten inspection nook where the strata fracture cleanly into natural shelves. You reach out to test the integrity of the stone face, probing the deep clefts with a pocket-knife until the shale yields to your touch.

exits.label: Trace the quartz seam deeper into the dark

nodes.title: Veins of Slate
nodes.brief: You decipher the acoustic reverberations to map the hidden fissures in the rock, earning a small pouch of sparkling pyrite.
nodes.page:
Silence settles over the tunnel floor save for the crunch of shattered slate beneath your boots. The lantern light catches a glimmer of mineral crust clinging to the roof-timbers, weeping reddish water that leaves bitter stains on the wood. You crouch low to examine the way the sedimentary layers shift against the iron plates, mapping the stress points where the mountain leans its weight upon the track. The vibration in the ballast tells you of a large pocket hollowed out just behind the partition.

Reaching into a narrow crevice, your fingers brush against loose gravel and metallic dust that coats the stone like flour. You begin to clear away the debris with steady strokes, uncovering the narrow mouth of a secondary gallery lined with sparkling mineral flakes.

exits.label: Clear the gravel from the hidden alcove

nodes.title: Reading the Fault
nodes.brief: You decipher the acoustic reverberations to map the hidden fissures in the rock, earning a small pouch of sparkling pyrite.
nodes.page:
Sound carries differently through compressed slate than through soft earth, and you tilt your head to catch the returning whistle of air currents threading through the blind fractures. Every stone shelf behaves like a tuning fork, ringing with the pressure of the overburden above the line. You close your eyes to shut out the flicker of the oil lamp, letting the low thrum of the mountain guide your fingertips across the damp face of the rock. A subtle change in pitch shows where the fault-line splits, and a hidden vein of ore opens behind the partition.

You wedge your iron pry-bar into the primary fissure, testing the resistance of the stubborn strata with a calculated twist of wrist and shoulder while the ceiling groans in response.

check.label: Read the fault lines in the dark

nodes.title: The Slipping Shard
nodes.brief: You decipher the acoustic reverberations to map the hidden fissures in the rock, earning a small pouch of sparkling pyrite.
nodes.page: A sudden shift in the mountain sends a cascade of razor-sharp shale rattling down the rock face, biting deep into your knuckles and showering your shoulders with grey grit. You stumble backward off the ballast as a slab of slate shears from the wall and crashes onto the ties with a blunt thud that shakes dust from the timbers. Your palm is raw and bleeding where the sharp stone caught you, and the spilled oil from your lantern leaves a dark, wasted stain among the rubble. You catch your breath in the acrid dark, binding the torn skin with a strip of greasy rag while the tunnel settles back into its sullen silence.

exits.label: Gather your tools and limp onward

nodes.title: The Glittering Seam
nodes.brief: You decipher the acoustic reverberations to map the hidden fissures in the rock, earning a small pouch of sparkling pyrite.
nodes.page:
Your fingers trace the exact line where the vibration falters, finding the hidden toggle of stone that releases the stubborn wedge with a dull metallic click. The shelf gives way inward, spilling a small, heavy sack of sparkling pyrite into your waiting hands. The mineral dust coats your palms with a fine golden film that glimmers faintly in the yellow lantern light. As you heft the pouch, an old inscription carved into the lintel catches your eye, warning of the catastrophic deluge that follows when the Cinderfall sluices are wrenched open before the pressure drops.

You tuck the little sack into your coat pocket alongside your rations, carrying the ruined reservoir's design with you into the deeper shadows.

exits.label: Return to the whispering stone archways

nodes.title: The Rotten Wall
nodes.brief: You shoulder through a partition of rotten timber blocking a secondary adit, securing a leather-bound logbook of old accidents.
nodes.page:
Timbers shored up during the old administration have swollen with dampness, their wood turning to sodden sponge that smells of ancient rot and dry-rot fungus. You plant your boot against the base of a warped prop and lean your weight into the barrier until the iron nails shriek in their rusty beds. The partition groans, shedding flakes of grey fungus like ash before giving way with a hollow, splintering crash that echoes down the empty adit.

Beyond the wreckage lies a dry alcove untouched by the general seepage, containing a low bench and a leather-bound logbook resting upon a rusted bracket. You brush the mildew from the cover, revealing the faded gold lettering of the old Line Maintenance records.

exits.label: Inspect the leather logbook on the bracket

nodes.title: Breaking the Timber
nodes.brief: You shoulder through a partition of rotten timber blocking a secondary adit, securing a leather-bound logbook of old accidents.
nodes.page: The heavy oak stanchions blocking the secondary drift have swollen tight against the roof-arch, wedging themselves into the stone until they form a solid wall of stubborn grain. You wedge your shoulder firmly against the damp wood, feeling the cold moisture soak through your canvas coat while you brace your boots against the loose ballast. The timber frame resists with all the dead weight of the mountain pressing down upon the ceiling. You gather your breath, tensing every muscle in your back and legs to heave the rotted barrier off its iron seat in one sustained, groaning effort.

check.label: Shoulder through the rotted timber bulkhead

nodes.title: The Splintered Trap
nodes.brief: You shoulder through a partition of rotten timber blocking a secondary adit, securing a leather-bound logbook of old accidents.
nodes.page: The rotted beam collapses too suddenly, catching your shoulder a glancing blow and spilling you hard onto the jagged granite ballast. A sharp splinter of oak tears through your sleeve, leaving a long, stinging scratch across your arm that begins to well with dark blood. Your lantern goes out in the scuffle, plunging the narrow drift into absolute ink-blackness while the dust settles in your throat like dry sand. You spend precious minutes fumbling in the dark for your flint and steel, nursing a bruised shoulder and a torn coat before the wick catches once more.

exits.label: Pick up the lantern and crawl through

nodes.title: The Ledger of Wrecks
nodes.brief: You shoulder through a partition of rotten timber blocking a secondary adit, securing a leather-bound logbook of old accidents.
nodes.page: Rotting timber yields to your shoulder with a dry, splintering groan, parting just enough for you to squeeze into a dry auxiliary adit choked with soot. Here, half-buried in a drift of grey dust, lies a thick leather-bound logbook detailing decades of forgotten derailments and mechanical post-mortems. As you brush the soot from its stamped brass corners, you slide the heavy volume into your tunic, securing a valuable record of every past disaster on this treacherous grade.

nodes.title: The Iron Barricade
nodes.brief: The engine's headlight cuts across a makeshift barricade of iron rail sleepers piled high by unseen hands across the track.
nodes.page:
The tunnel widens abruptly into a broad switching basin where the tracks fan out toward the old maintenance sidings. Cutting straight across the parallel rails stands a massive barricade built from surplus iron sleepers stacked four high and bound together with heavy gauge telegraph wire. Unseen hands have wedged jagged chunks of slag between the iron bars, turning the junction into a formidable breastwork that blocks the entire width of the bore. A faint blue glow flickers behind the barrier from several improvised sulphur braziers, casting long, wavering shadows against the soot-blackened roof.

No sound comes from the dark side of the wall save for the steady hiss of escaping gas and the muffled scrape of a shovel on stone. You slow the Marrowbone to a gentle idle, letting the boiler breathe while you measure the height of the obstruction.

exits.label: Approach the barricade camp in the dark

nodes.title: The Barricade Camp
nodes.brief: The Barricade Camp: Abandoned sleeping quarters of the early gangers flicker with the blue glow of sulphur braziers.
nodes.page:
Abandoned sleeping quarters of the early gangers flicker with the blue glow of sulphur braziers, casting long, shivering shadows across rusted iron bunks and frosted glass lanterns. Piles of discarded oilskins smell faintly of stagnant damp and old grease, while overhead, water drips with a dull, rhythmic echo against the arched stone ceiling.

You stand in the centre of this forgotten habitation where five distinct routes branch off into the dark tunnels, each promising its own peril or advantage under the low vaulting. You weigh the damp air and listen to the distant hum of the rails before choosing your path through the subterranean gloom.

exits.label: Pry open the heavy sleeper wall

nodes.title: Clearing the Rails
nodes.brief: You dismantle the blockade by unbolting the fishplates in correct sequence, securing a box of hardened steel track bolts.
nodes.page:
You crouch beside the heavy iron track, working a notched spanner against rusted nuts that protest with a shrill, metallic shriek. Cold grease smears your knuckles as each bolt finally yields, allowing you to slide the hardened steel fishplates free from the rail joints one by one.

A small wooden box containing spare track bolts rattles as you lift it from the ballast, its contents promising structural integrity for the miles ahead. You slide the prize into your canvas satchel and stand, wiping your brow with a soot-stained sleeve before pushing onward into the tunnel.

nodes.title: The Fishplate Bolts
nodes.brief: You dismantle the blockade by unbolting the fishplates in correct sequence, securing a box of hardened steel track bolts.
nodes.page:
Rust has fused the joint-plates into a stubborn, scabby ridge that defies the wrench until you tap the shanks with a cold chisel, sending up tiny sparks of sulfur. One by one, the square-headed bolts yield with a dry, metallic shriek, clattering into the palm of your hand still greased with old graphite. You lift the fishplate away, setting it aside on the ballast, and slide a fresh box of hardened steel track bolts from the wedge-trench into your canvas kit, feeling the cold metal settle in your palm.

The line ahead lies clear of the iron barricade, presenting a narrow corridor of light between the soot-stained retaining walls.

exits.label: Haul the kit aboard and push forward into the cut.

nodes.title: The Tangled Wiring
nodes.brief: You dismantle the blockade by unbolting the fishplates in correct sequence, securing a box of hardened steel track bolts.
nodes.page:
Frayed copper cables hang from the damp vault ceiling like dead serpents, sparking intermittently against the masonry with sharp, violet snaps of current. You must trace the live line through the tangled mass without triggering the trip-wire linked to the old maintenance gongs overhead.

Your fingers hover above the copper core while the air grows thick with the smell of ozone and scorched rubber, testing every ounce of your wit to separate the safe strand from the trap.

nodes.title: A Shock to the System
nodes.brief: You dismantle the blockade by unbolting the fishplates in correct sequence, securing a box of hardened steel track bolts.
nodes.page:
A sudden sharp crack echoes through the tunnel as your thumb brushes the wrong terminal, sending a vicious jolt of white-hot current straight up your arm. You stagger backward against the rough stone wall with a sharp intake of breath, your left hand throbbing with a persistent, dull numbness.

The minor burn leaves your palm red and blistered, a stinging reminder to respect the hidden wiring of the old signalmen. You shake out your aching fingers and press forward despite the lingering pain.

exits.label: Press deeper into the damp cutting

nodes.title: The Cunning Twist
nodes.brief: You dismantle the blockade by unbolting the fishplates in correct sequence, securing a box of hardened steel track bolts.
nodes.page:
Fingers moving with deliberate precision, you tease the delicate copper strand free from the sparking terminal just as the relay switch clicks harmlessly into place. Sudden darkness swallows the violet sparks. Only water dripping and your own measured breathing remain in the cool subterranean air.

A small brass continuity tag falls into your palm from the junction box, bearing the stamped initials of an old line inspector. You slip the token into your pocket as a silent voucher of your success.

nodes.title: The Secret Log
nodes.brief: You find the secret camp log detailing the exact night Hesper Quill passed through, winning a signed dispatch chit.
nodes.page:
Leather-bound and stiff with damp, the old camp log rests atop a discarded grease-tin on a crate table, its pages swelling from the subterranean moisture. You flip carefully through brittle sheets filled with faded pencil tallies until a familiar scrawl catches your eye under the lamplight.

Hesper Quill signed the margin here just weeks ago, noting a hurried change in engine pressure and a midnight departure toward the upper passes. You tear the signed dispatch chit free from the binding and tuck it safely inside your waistcoat.

nodes.title: Reading the Signs
nodes.brief: You find the secret camp log detailing the exact night Hesper Quill passed through, winning a signed dispatch chit.
nodes.page:
Strange scratch marks score the wooden desk surface beneath the ledger, forming an intricate cipher left by the wandering signal crews who once manned this post. You squint through the gloom, trying to decode the sequence of directional notches before the flickering sulphur brazier sputters out entirely.

Your mind races across the overlapping lines, balancing the old rail codes against the irregular patterns carved into the rotting timber.

nodes.title: The Faded Cipher
nodes.brief: You find the secret camp log detailing the exact night Hesper Quill passed through, winning a signed dispatch chit.
nodes.page:
A sudden gust of sulfurous wind sweeps through the ruined quarters. Soot blows across the desk and blurs the pencil marks just as you reach for them. You stumble against the edge of the iron bunk, grazing your hip sharply on a rusted bed-post as you struggle to keep your footing in the sudden gloom.

The bruise wakes under your woolen trousers and brings back the careless second you lost to the draft. You gather your breath and push away from the iron frame.

nodes.title: The Deciphered Track
nodes.brief: You find the secret camp log detailing the exact night Hesper Quill passed through, winning a signed dispatch chit.
nodes.page:
Eyes narrowing against the stinging smoke, you trace the final interlocking groove with a blackened fingernail and unlock the hidden meaning of the cipher. The cryptic directions map out the forgotten bypass route used by the night crews during the great ash-storms.

A neat handwritten slip falls from the carved wood into your palm, detailing the secret clearance codes for the upper signal boxes. You pocket the paper tightly, knowing its value on this desolate line.

exits.label: Head back to the central junction

nodes.title: The Signal Wire
nodes.brief: You trace the wire to a dead-man's switch connected to an old detonator, pocketing a length of insulated copper wire.
nodes.page: Copper threads gleam in the dim lantern-light where the cable runs beneath the rotting floorboards. Following the insulated line with careful fingers, you uncover a heavy dead-man's switch bolted firmly to an old explosive detonator. The mechanism is rusted with age yet remains fully wired into the track circuit. Slipping a sturdy length of insulated copper wire from the terminals into your pocket, you leave the dangerous trigger behind in the shadows.

exits.label: Trace the remaining cable into the dark

nodes.title: Testing the Line
nodes.brief: You trace the wire to a dead-man's switch connected to an old detonator, pocketing a length of insulated copper wire.
nodes.page: A sudden metallic click echoes through the subterranean chamber as your boot grazes a hidden trip-wire connected to the detonator. The spring-loaded striker begins to pivot with alarming speed toward the percussion cap. Your hand darts toward the sensitive wiring harness in an instant attempt to rip the live connection free before the spark catches the charge.

nodes.title: A Close Shave
nodes.brief: You trace the wire to a dead-man's switch connected to an old detonator, pocketing a length of insulated copper wire.
nodes.page: The spark leaps an instant too soon, setting off a muffled detonation that sends a shower of hot grit and jagged splinters across your shoulders. A sharp piece of shrapnel grazes your forearm, leaving a jagged red line that begins to seep dark blood onto your sleeve. Coughing in the dense, sulfurous haze, you drag yourself clear of the wreckage and press onward through the gloom.

nodes.title: Insulated Prize
nodes.brief: You trace the wire to a dead-man's switch connected to an old detonator, pocketing a length of insulated copper wire.
nodes.page: Quick fingers catch the live wire and snap the copper strands just as the striker hammers against empty iron. Breathing hard in the acrid air, you pocket the severed length of shielded cable, knowing its rubber jacket will prove invaluable for emergency repairs. The narrow escape leaves your heart pounding, but the prize is secured safely in your coat.

nodes.title: The Iron Barrier
nodes.brief: You tear down the heavy steel sleeper wall with sheer brute lifting, keeping a heavy claw-bar for emergency work.
nodes.page: Steel sleepers lie piled across the permanent way in a jagged barricade that blocks all further progress down the cutting. Gripping the cold metal with both hands, you wedge a heavy claw-bar beneath the baseplate and throw your full weight into the leverage. The rusty bolts groan in protest before the steel wall gives way with a resounding crash.

exits.label: Haul the claw-bar through the breach

nodes.title: The Iron Obstruction
nodes.brief: You tear down the heavy steel sleeper wall with sheer brute lifting, keeping a heavy claw-bar for emergency work.
nodes.page: Heavy iron rails and warped steel sleepers pile three men high across the mouth of the tunnel, sealing the dark like a set of broken teeth. You wedge the hooked bill of your claw-bar beneath the lowest girder, planting your boots hard against the loose ballast and sulfur-stained tie-plates. Every muscle in your back hums and twitches under the strain as you lean your full weight into the iron shaft, feeling the dead weight of the barricade groan and shift against the bedrock. The air tastes of dry copper and old sweat while the metal bites deep into your palms.

nodes.title: Crushed Ambition
nodes.brief: You tear down the heavy steel sleeper wall with sheer brute lifting, keeping a heavy claw-bar for emergency work.
nodes.page: The steel beam slips from your aching grasp and pins your left leg beneath its jagged edge in the choking dark. Freeing yourself requires a frantic, painful struggle that leaves your shins bruised and your uniform torn to shreds. You limp away from the collapsed heap with a fresh ache in your bones and precious minutes lost to the shadows.

nodes.title: The Iron Barricade
nodes.brief: You tear down the heavy steel sleeper wall with sheer brute lifting, keeping a heavy claw-bar for emergency work.
nodes.page:
Iron splinters scream against your leather gloves as you heave the warped rails upward, your muscles singing with the strain of old steel and ancient soot. You wrench the final beam clear of the mouth, tossing it aside to ring hollowly against the ballast. Slipping a heavy claw-bar from the rack, you secure it at your belt for whatever waits in the gloom ahead.

The tunnel breathes a lungful of damp grease and coal-gas against your face, welcoming you into the dark.

nodes.title: The Maintenance Spur
nodes.brief: A towering stack of discarded coal-scuttles rattles violently as Locomotive No. 9 approaches the old maintenance spur.
nodes.page: A towering stack of discarded coal-scuttles rattles violently as Locomotive No. 9 approaches the old maintenance spur. The rusted metal vessels begin to slide down the embankment in a noisy cascade, threatening to foul the pistons and block the track entirely. You scramble along the running board with a heavy iron poker, batting away bouncing buckets before they can wedge themselves beneath the driving wheels. The engine pants softly in the confined space, its brass fittings gleaming under the soot as you clear the final obstacle from the rails.

nodes.title: The Cinder Silo
nodes.brief: The Cinder-Silo: A mountain of damp slack blocks the side-loading chute while a mechanical counter clicks away in the dark.
nodes.page:
Mountains of damp slack choke the side-loading chute while a mechanical counter clicks away like a nervous beetle in the dark. Sulphur and old money flavor the air around the unburned fuel resting against the rusted iron plates. Every surface is coated in a greasy sheen of grey dust that settles over your boots and quietens the scrape of your shovel.

A dull rhythmic thumping vibrates through the basalt floor from somewhere deeper in the network, offering three distinct paths through the shadow while the single narrow rail beckons straight ahead.

exits.label: Strike the jammed hopper gate with the hammer
Stand firm against the shifting avalanche of slag
Calculate the balance of the coal-chute carefully
Follow the narrow rib of basalt-flanked steel

nodes.title: The Coal Depot Spur
nodes.brief: You free the jammed hopper gate with a precise hammer blow to the release pawl, securing three buckets of clean Welsh steam-coal.
nodes.page: Soot settles thick across the iron ribs of the tender as you peer into the rusted maw of the storage bin. Dim red embers from the firebox cast long, wavering shadows against the damp brickwork of the tunnel wall. You grasp the heavy steel hammer, feeling its cold grain bite into your palm, and line up the rusted pin of the hopper gate. A single well-placed blow might clear the blockage and feed the starved furnace before the steam pressure drops too low.

nodes.title: Echoes in the Dark
nodes.brief: You free the jammed hopper gate with a precise hammer blow to the release pawl, securing three buckets of clean Welsh steam-coal.
nodes.page: Metal rings against metal with a dull, hollow thud that reverberates down the damp masonry of the Hollow Cut. Dust flakes from the curved ceiling, settling like grey snow over your shoulders and cap. The jammed mechanism groans, iron teeth shifting within their grease-clotted housing as the weight of the fuel above begins to settle. You lean your weight against the timber frame, waiting to see whether the chute will yield its contents or stay frozen shut.

nodes.title: Freeing the Chute
nodes.brief: You free the jammed hopper gate with a precise hammer blow to the release pawl, securing three buckets of clean Welsh steam-coal.
nodes.page: Sweat cuts pale channels through the grime on your forehead as you brace your shoulder against the vibrating iron gate. The release pawl hangs by a fraction of an inch, wedged tight by decades of accumulated slag and mineral crust. With the hammer poised in your right hand and your fingers hooked beneath the rusted lip, you prepare to strike the exact stress point that will clear the feed.

nodes.title: A Heavy Toll
nodes.brief: You free the jammed hopper gate with a precise hammer blow to the release pawl, securing three buckets of clean Welsh steam-coal.
nodes.page: The jammed iron snaps too violently, catching your knuckles against the sharp edge of the hopper and sending a sharp spasm of pain up your forearm. Coal spills too fast, burying your boots in a heavy avalanche of black dust and bruising your shins against the iron plating. You stagger back with a bruised hand and a torn coat sleeve, sucking air that tastes of sulfur and old damp earth.

nodes.title: Clean Fuel Secured
nodes.brief: You free the jammed hopper gate with a precise hammer blow to the release pawl, securing three buckets of clean Welsh steam-coal.
nodes.page: The stubborn pin gives way with a sharp crack and slides home into its oiled slot as three deep buckets of clean Welsh steam-coal pour out in a rewarding cascade. The dark fuel gleams with a rich, oily luster, free of the grey dust and clinkers that choke the common bunkers. You heave the vessels onto the footplate one by one; your muscles ache, but your firebox is fed with proper grade.

nodes.title: The Slag Avalanche
nodes.brief: You stand your ground against the shifting avalanche of rattling slag, earning a heavy iron fender-plate.
nodes.page: Heavy grey slag shifts along the tunnel shoulder with a dry, rattling hiss like a nest of disturbed adders. Dust billows into the lantern light, stinging your eyes and coating your tongue in the dry taste of old cinders. You wedge your boots firmly between the wooden ties of the track and keep your balance as the sliding debris beats a tattoo against the side of the tender.

exits.label: Hold fast against the sliding debris

nodes.title: Bracing Against the Fall
nodes.brief: You stand your ground against the shifting avalanche of rattling slag, earning a heavy iron fender-plate.
nodes.page: Loose shale and jagged clinkers cascade down from the embankment, threatening to sweep your footing out from under the running board. You square your shoulders and drop your center of gravity, gripping a riveted stanchion with both hands while the grey tide surges around your shins. The iron fender-plate shudders under the impact, testing your nerve against the crushing weight of the shifting heap.

nodes.title: Battered by the Slide
nodes.brief: You stand your ground against the shifting avalanche of rattling slag, earning a heavy iron fender-plate.
nodes.page: The weight of the falling slag proves too great for your stance, slamming the heavy iron fender-plate against your knee and knocking the wind from your ribs. You hit the ballast hard, scraping your palms against the sharp ballast stones while dust fills the air around you. It takes long, agonizing moments to drag yourself upright, nursing a deep bruise that will throb with every step of the road.

nodes.title: The Iron Shield
nodes.brief: You stand your ground against the shifting avalanche of rattling slag, earning a heavy iron fender-plate.
nodes.page: You stand your ground with absolute resolve, letting the cascade of heavy slag spend its force harmlessly against your braced boots and the sturdy hull of the locomotive. When the dust finally clears, a thick iron fender-plate lies dislodged at your feet, shaped to reinforce the front cowcatcher against whatever waits further down the line. You lift the salvage onto the deck, grateful for the unexpected armor.

nodes.title: The Coal Chute
nodes.brief: You calculate the exact center of gravity to tip the coal-chute without spilling the load, gaining an accurate coal-rake.
nodes.page:
Iron dust clings to your palms as you test the balance of the suspended hopper above the tender deck. By shifting your weight and bracing the iron lever against the rusted ratchet-tooth, you find the exact pivot-point where the heavy chute yields without spilling a single nugget of coal into the ballast. The balance settles with a satisfying metallic chime, leaving you with a straight, true coal-rake whose tip is worn bright by years of honest service.

Stepping back onto the footplate, you secure the implement against the bulkhead where it belongs.

exits.label: Pull the coal-rake free and climb back to the deck

nodes.title: Measuring the Balance
nodes.brief: You calculate the exact center of gravity to tip the coal-chute without spilling the load, gaining an accurate coal-rake.
nodes.page: You trace the angle of the loading arm against the dim bulkhead, calculating how much weight the rusted pivot can bear before the whole structure groans out of alignment. Every movement in this tunnel has its price, measured in grease, sweat, and the quiet creak of stressed metal. The engine breathes softly beneath you, a low, patient thrumming in the dark.

nodes.title: Tipping the Balance
nodes.brief: You calculate the exact center of gravity to tip the coal-chute without spilling the load, gaining an accurate coal-rake.
nodes.page: You eye the exact center of gravity where the pivot meets the overhead hopper and balance the iron rake against the lip of the chute. One wrong twitch will send the entire stack crashing down into the ballast, while a precise touch will swing the load clean across the tender lip. You take a slow breath, steadying your hand against the wooden shaft before making the final push.

nodes.title: A Spilled Measure
nodes.brief: You calculate the exact center of gravity to tip the coal-chute without spilling the load, gaining an accurate coal-rake.
nodes.page: The pivot catches on a warped rivet, swinging wide at the last second and sending half a load of coal rattling uselessly into the dark ballast below. You bite back a curse, wiping soot from your brow with the back of your wrist as you survey the scattered black diamonds among the ties. It costs you precious minutes and extra sweat to shovel the spilled fuel back where it belongs.

nodes.title: The Balanced Hopper
nodes.brief: You calculate the exact center of gravity to tip the coal-chute without spilling the load, gaining an accurate coal-rake.
nodes.page: Settling the heavy iron rake into the pivot's groove, you throw your weight against the timber handle with measured, practiced calm. The overhead hopper groans as the balance shifts precisely on its fulcrum, tipping the damp slack in a smooth, cascading arc that settles deep within the tender without spilling a single grain onto the ballast below. The mechanism holds firm and leaves you a forged coal-rake free of rust and warp.

exits.label: Shovel the slack into the firebox

nodes.title: The Basalt Wall
nodes.brief: The tracks narrow into a single glistening rib of steel flanked by walls of pure, unyielding black basalt.
nodes.page: The trackbed narrows sharply into a single glistening rib of steel, wedged tight between towering walls of pure, unyielding black basalt that sweat a bitter, mineral damp onto the boiler casing. Every rivet on the Marrowbone screams against the compressed air of the corridor, and the headlight beam catches only slick, weeping stone where no signal-lantern has burned for years. You keep your hand on the brass regulator, feeling the heavy thrum of the pistons vibrating straight through the floorboards as the engine plunges deeper into the mountain's throat.

nodes.title: The Basalt Narrows
nodes.brief: The Basalt Narrows: The rock presses inward so tightly that the cab roof scrapes against jagged outcroppings of ancient stone.
nodes.page: The rock presses inward so tightly that the cab roof scrapes against jagged outcroppings of ancient stone, showering sparks over the running board whenever the boiler lists to port. Ahead, the dark corridor splinters into several distinct paths through the living mountain, each marked by faint, ghostly glimmers of oil lamps or the distant echo of steam hissing through unseen valves. You can nurse the regulator straight ahead into the tightest cleft, risk the higher ledge where the iron rails look dangerously thin, or scout the lower maintenance spurs where the air smells faintly of old grease and forgotten grease-traps.

nodes.title: The Narrow Ledge
nodes.brief: You wedge your shoulder against the rock face to fend off a scraping overhang, securing a jagged chunk of black lodestone.
nodes.page: Bracing your boots against the shivering floorplates, you wedge your shoulder firmly against the cold rock face to fend off a sharp, protruding overhang that threatens to shear away the whistle-valve. The stone grinds heavily against your leather coat, leaving a smear of grey dust and grease, but you manage to ease the engine past the obstruction without denting the lagging. Reaching down into the ballast where the rock split open under the pressure, your fingers brush against a heavy, dense chunk of natural lodestone that pulls strongly against your belt buckle.

exits.label: Pocket the heavy stone and proceed

nodes.title: Scraping the Overhang
nodes.brief: You wedge your shoulder against the rock face to fend off a scraping overhang, securing a jagged chunk of black lodestone.
nodes.page:
Gritting your teeth against the mounting strain, you throw your full weight against the cab pillar just as another jagged spur of basalt lurches toward the boiler cladding. The engine groans. Wheels slip briefly on the slick rails as you shove the machine clear of the unyielding stone wall before it tears open the steam dome.

Sweat stings your eyes in the oppressive heat of the cab while the iron screeches a high, protesting note against the mountain.

check.label: Shove the engine clear of the rock face

nodes.title: A Heavy Scraping
nodes.brief: You wedge your shoulder against the rock face to fend off a scraping overhang, securing a jagged chunk of black lodestone.
nodes.page: A sickening screech of torn iron fills the narrow cut as the rock face bites deep into the engine's side-plating, jarring you off your footing and sending you sprawling hard against the coal bunker. The Marrowbone shudders to a groaning halt, trapped by a stubborn outcrop of basalt that refuses to yield an inch. It costs you precious minutes of boiler pressure and leaves a long, ugly raw scar down the steel plating before you manage to reverse off, pry the obstacle free with a pinch-bar, and get the wheels rolling once more.

exits.label: Resume the crawl through the dark

nodes.title: Clearance Gained
nodes.brief: You wedge your shoulder against the rock face to fend off a scraping overhang, securing a jagged chunk of black lodestone.
nodes.page: With a sudden, jarring lurch, the engine clears the stubborn stone protrusion, sliding back into the center of the rail-bed as the basalt walls widen into a low subterranean cavern. The Marrowbone steams forward with only a dented running board to show for the trial. Among the fallen debris scattered across the sleepers by the engine's flank, you spot a sturdy iron pinch-bar left behind by an old track-crew, its claw end still bright and clean.

nodes.title: The Condensate Drain
nodes.brief: You tap out the cylinder condensate to squeeze every ounce of power from the pistons, earning an intact pressure gauge.
nodes.page: Bending low beneath the gleaming cylinders, you reach for the brass petcocks and twist them sharply to clear out the accumulated water before it can choke the stroke. A blistering cloud of white steam and greasy grey condensation roars out into the cramped space, smelling strongly of burnt tallow and old machine oil. The pistons immediately take up a smoother, more rhythmic beat, freeing every ounce of raw power from the chambers and leaving behind a clean, dry hiss.

exits.label: Climb back to the driving deck

nodes.title: The Steam-Worm Spur
nodes.brief: You tap out the cylinder condensate to squeeze every ounce of power from the pistons, earning an intact pressure gauge.
nodes.page: The track dips sharply beneath a low brick-arched culvert where weeping mortar drips rhythmically onto the coal tender like cold sweat. You lean out from the gangway, watching the grey shadows stretch across the tender as the single headlight cuts through the damp air, illuminating faint chalk marks left by the Hollow Signalmen. Nothing stirs in the gloom save the slow, rhythmic dripping of the roof-springs and the steady, comforting thrum of the firebox drawing draft.

nodes.title: Tapping the Cylinders
nodes.brief: You tap out the cylinder condensate to squeeze every ounce of power from the pistons, earning an intact pressure gauge.
nodes.page:
Kneeling on the slick timber sleepers beside the driving gear, you tap the jammed slide-valve cover sharply with a brass-headed mallet, listening for the clear ring that signals proper seating. The engine trembles violently as full boiler pressure surges against the valve chest, threatening to blow the packing rings if the alignment is off by even a fraction of a hair.

You hold your breath, hand poised on the regulator linkage, waiting to see whether the assembly holds under the sudden, brutal spike of heat.

check.label: Tap the slide-valve into true alignment

nodes.title: Blown Packing
nodes.brief: You tap out the cylinder condensate to squeeze every ounce of power from the pistons, earning an intact pressure gauge.
nodes.page: A sharp, violent crack splits the air beneath the boiler as the dry packing ring shatters under the pressure, venting a blinding plume of scalding white vapor directly into your face. You scramble backward coughing and wiping hot grease from your brow, losing precious minutes and a good measure of boiler head before you can isolate the line. The repair takes time and leaves your hands blistered and stained with dark graphite paste, but you manage to wire the housing shut with copper strand.

exits.label: Crawl back to the regulator and drive on

nodes.title: The True Ring
nodes.brief: You tap out the cylinder condensate to squeeze every ounce of power from the pistons, earning an intact pressure gauge.
nodes.page: The valve housing gives a deep, musical chime under the mallet and settles smoothly into its bed with a satisfying hiss of released pressure. However narrowly you timed the adjustment, the cylinders now fire in perfect, synchronized harmony, driving the Marrowbone forward with renewed vigor through the dark rock. Half-buried in the grease-pan beneath the assembly lies an intact pressure gauge, glass face unblemished, needle resting true at zero.

nodes.title: Wall Reflections
nodes.brief: You guide the engine through the hairpin squeeze by watching the wall reflections, winning a pocket brass plumb-line.
nodes.page: Black basalt walls press close against the boiler plates as the Marrowbone creeps through the narrowest throat of the Hollow Cut. Instead of looking ahead into the coal-smoke, you watch the polished brass of the running gear cast sliding arcs of yellow illumination across the wet stone. Every contour of the rock reveals itself through these drifting reflections, guiding your hand on the regulator with absolute precision.

exits.label: Steer by the sliding brass lights

nodes.title: Squeezing the Throat
nodes.brief: You guide the engine through the hairpin squeeze by watching the wall reflections, winning a pocket brass plumb-line.
nodes.page: Jagged teeth of ancient granite loom out of the dark, threatening to shear the tender's corner-irons away if you misjudge the drift by a single inch. You squint past the trembling pressure gauge, trying to match the engine's rhythmic sway to the subtle slant of the wall shadows while the wheels screech against the ungreased rail.

check.label: Read the stone shadows to steer

nodes.title: Scraping the Ribs
nodes.brief: You guide the engine through the hairpin squeeze by watching the wall reflections, winning a pocket brass plumb-line.
nodes.page: A sickening screech of torn steel echoes off the vaulted ceiling as a jutting shoulder of granite catches the tender's side, denting the water tank and showering the cab floor with grit. You slam the reverse lever halfway, fighting the swinging deck until the engine clears the obstruction with a shudder that leaves your shoulder bruised against the brass manifold.

exits.label: Clear the granite and press onward

nodes.title: The Plumb Line
nodes.brief: You guide the engine through the hairpin squeeze by watching the wall reflections, winning a pocket brass plumb-line.
nodes.page: Smooth stone walls slide past the running board at last, leaving behind only the smell of hot oil and the memory of that razor-thin clearance in the dark. Resting on a narrow wooden bracket near the grease-box, you spot an old brass plumb-line left behind by some forgotten track-gang, its finely spun cord and heavy metal bob intact.

exits.label: Return to the narrow rock passage

nodes.title: Scents of the Inner Gate
nodes.brief: The air grows heavy with the scent of lavender oil and burning tallow as you approach the inner gatehouse.
nodes.page: Thick coils of lavender oil and burning tallow drift down the stone-lined corridor as the Marrowbone rolls past the rusted iron brackets of the inner gatehouse. The air grows warm and close, carrying the distant knock of machinery and the muffled scratching of pens behind thick oak panels. Hollow Signalmen in grey coats stand sentinel beside the tracks, their lanterns flickering with a pale, steady blue flame that reveals no shadows. You slow the engine to a crawl and let the tread of the drive wheels announce your arrival to whatever authority waits behind the massive threshold.

nodes.title: The General's Keep
nodes.brief: The Keep of the General: The massive oak doors of the Stationmaster-General's subterranean keep bar the rails ahead.
nodes.page: Massive oak doors barred with strap-iron block the rails ahead, standing before the subterranean domain of the Stationmaster-General like a mountain cliff. A single pale lamp casts its light across several narrow side passages and small wicket gates cut into the heavy timber. To the left, a low wicket stands ajar with a dusting of grey ash on the stone sill; straight ahead, the great doors await some token of passage; to the right, a shadowy side-arch leads toward the filing rooms and the tribunal chambers. Every option calls out with its own promise of entry into the deep heart of Cinderfall's defenses.

exits.label: Push through the warped oak post
Batter the small iron wicket gate
Face the tribunal of silent porters
Approach the heavy oak panels directly

nodes.title: Silence Before the Portrait
nodes.brief: You maintain absolute silence before the portrait of the ancient administrator, earning an ivory-handled carriage key.
nodes.page: Dust motes dance in the amber glow of a wall-bracket as you step down onto the stone flags before a towering oil painting of an ancient, severe-looking administrator. The eyes in the canvas seem to track your movements through the damp air, demanding complete stillness and absolute respect from anyone seeking passage through these sealed tunnels. You stand straight, keep your breathing slow, and hold your hands still at your sides while the distant drip of water echoes down the corridor.

exits.label: Stand quietly before the painted frame

nodes.title: The Painted Silence
nodes.brief: You maintain absolute silence before the portrait of the ancient administrator, earning an ivory-handled carriage key.
nodes.page:
Oil paint cracks like dried mud across the cheekbones of the Stationmaster-General's portrait. The enormous canvas hangs where the tunnel narrows to a choke-point and the soot settles thickest. Her painted gaze fixes upon the brass pressure gauge on your hip with an unyielding, bureaucratic scrutiny that seems to measure the very air in your lungs. You clamp your jaws together, biting back the reflex cough that rises against the sulphur-grit in the dark, and lock your knees against the vibration of the idling firebox.
