Every muscle in your throat strains to remain motionless while the grey shadows of the Hollow Signalmen flicker through the coal-dust at the edge of your vision, whispering names you used to know.

The pressure in your ears builds to a dull roar, and you must hold this absolute stone-still quiet before the canvas eye or let your nerves crack entirely.

check.label: Hold your breath against the canvas gaze

nodes.title: A Cough in the Dust
nodes.brief: You maintain absolute silence before the portrait of the ancient administrator, earning an ivory-handled carriage key.
nodes.page: A sudden rattle in your chest betrays you, and the cough bursts out like a dry coal-shot, cracking the tunnel's silence open. The oil portrait seems to lean from its frame as the failure catches in your throat. You gasp for air while a sharp flake of falling slate slices a long, clean line across the back of your hand. Blood mixes with the grey soot on your knuckles, a small and stinging reminder that the old administration exacts its toll in slow measures even when you try to stand like a pillar. You wipe the salt from your lip, poorer by a drop of blood and a vital breath of time, but the tunnel ahead remains open for the iron wheels to turn.

exits.label: Step past the frame into the lower siding

nodes.title: The Ivory Key
nodes.brief: You maintain absolute silence before the portrait of the ancient administrator, earning an ivory-handled carriage key.
nodes.page: You hold your breath until the red sparks behind your eyelids fade to a dull charcoal grey, matching the ancient administrator's painted stare with an iron stillness that brooks no argument from the dark. The canvas does not shift, yet a small click behind the wainscot announces that the test has been met, and the debt of silence is paid in full. From a greasy brass peg beneath the frame, you lift a heavy, yellowed key carved from old whale-ivory with a grip shaped like a carriage door-latch. It fits nowhere upon the Marrowbone itself, but it carries the unmistakable weight of a pass that opens doors closed to ordinary gangers.

exits.label: Approach the great oak doors of the keep

nodes.title: The Grease-Gun Lever
nodes.brief: You force the warped oak post back into its stone socket with a heavy iron lever, securing a brass grease-gun.
nodes.page: Black oil beads along the cold basalt ribs of the tunnel, smelling faintly of stale tallow and old coal-gas. You wedge the thick timber post back into its dry stone socket, using every ounce of leverage the iron bar affords against the stubborn ground. Grime cakes your palms as the wood groans, settling into alignment with a dull, echoing thud that rattles through the sleepers. A brass grease-gun hangs from a rusted peg nearby, dripping amber fluid into the dark.

exits.label: Push deeper into the narrow maintenance drift

nodes.title: Slipping the Fastening
nodes.brief: You force the warped oak post back into its stone socket with a heavy iron lever, securing a brass grease-gun.
nodes.page: Shadows stretch long and crooked across the tunnel floor as your lantern flame flickers against a damp draft from the ventilation shafts. You secure the brass grease-gun to your belt loop, its brass barrel cold against your hip, while your fingers test the stability of the braced timber. The silence here is heavy, broken only by the distant, rhythmic dripping of subterranean water somewhere beyond the partition walls.

nodes.title: Strain Against the Oak
nodes.brief: You force the warped oak post back into its stone socket with a heavy iron lever, securing a brass grease-gun.
nodes.page: A sudden lateral shift in the tunnel wall sends a cascade of loose shale rattling down across the tracks, threatening to jam the entire frame. You brace your boots against the rotting sleeper-ends, throw your shoulder against the warped timber post, and heave with all your might to force the jammed joint home before the masonry buckles entirely.

check.label: Shove the warped timber post home

nodes.title: The Cost of the Shift
nodes.brief: You force the warped oak post back into its stone socket with a heavy iron lever, securing a brass grease-gun.
nodes.page: The timber gives way with a vicious snap, catching your forearm a sharp blow that leaves a purple welt beneath your soot-stained sleeve. Loose ash and sharp fragments of stone shower over your shoulders, filling your collar and grinding painfully against your skin. You stumble backward onto the ballasted gravel, coughing violently as the dust settles, poorer by a wrench slipped from your pocket and lost forever in the dark ballast.

exits.label: Pick yourself up and press onward

nodes.title: The Signalman's Token
nodes.brief: You force the warped oak post back into its stone socket with a heavy iron lever, securing a brass grease-gun.
nodes.page: The warped timber finally slides into its iron seat with a clear ring that quiets the shifting earth. A small figure in a braided cap steps from the murky alcove, pressing a cold, grease-stained brass token into your palm without a word of greeting. It is an old signalman's pass, notched with the private sigil of the night-shift crews, offering an unspoken berth among the ghostly watchers of the line whenever the final siding is reached.

exits.label: Walk toward the circular chamber ahead

nodes.title: The Wicket Gate
nodes.brief: You battering-ram the small wicket gate until the iron latch gives way, keeping a brass-bound clerk's ledger.
nodes.page: Rusted wire mesh rattles within its iron frame as you square your shoulders before the small barrier blocking the side-passage. The air tastes sharply of old paper and dry vinegar, remnants of some forgotten dispatch office long abandoned by the company clerks. You adjust the heavy brass-bound ledger tucked beneath your arm, keeping your footing secure upon the greasy ties.

exits.label: Strike the wicket frame with your shoulder

nodes.title: Beyond the Broken Latch
nodes.brief: You battering-ram the small wicket gate until the iron latch gives way, keeping a brass-bound clerk's ledger.
nodes.page: Dust billows up in a thick yellow cloud as the iron latch shatters under your impact, showering the ballast with flakes of rusted paint. You step through the splintered opening into a narrow office lit only by the amber glow of your hand-lamp. Yellowed waybills and unread manifests carpet the floor like autumn leaves and whisper under your boots.

exits.label: Follow the paper-strewn track toward the keep

nodes.title: Breaching the Barrier
nodes.brief: You battering-ram the small wicket gate until the iron latch gives way, keeping a brass-bound clerk's ledger.
nodes.page: Splintering wood groans under the sudden, brutal impact of your charge, but the stubborn iron latch holds fast against the first blow, biting deep into your shoulder. You pull back for a second, harder rush, tightening your grip on the leather spine of the clerk's ledger tucked securely at your side while the tunnel walls seem to lean inward.

check.label: Smash through the stubborn wicket gate

nodes.title: The Ledger's Cost
nodes.brief: You battering-ram the small wicket gate until the iron latch gives way, keeping a brass-bound clerk's ledger.
nodes.page: Oak from the wicket gate splinters into your shoulder with a dry, vicious crack, and your left arm hangs numb and useless in your greasy coat sleeve. You stumble through the dust into the cramped clerk's booth, clutching the brass-bound ledger to your ribs while a sharp, stinging pain flares across your collarbone where a rusted hinge bit deep through wool and skin. Every breath smells of stale mutton-tallow and damp coal-dust, and the storm clock outside ticks with an unhurried malice that reminds you how much precious time has bled into the floorboards.

exits.label: Scramble through the records room with your aching shoulder

nodes.title: The Ledger's Secret
nodes.brief: You battering-ram the small wicket gate until the iron latch gives way, keeping a brass-bound clerk's ledger.
nodes.page: The small gate swings wide and shows the vaulted corridor that runs straight to the heart of the subterranean domain. Tucked safely inside the heavy leather cover of the clerk's ledger is a handwritten margin note detailing the secret release mechanism of the inner freight doors, signed with the initials of a clerk who vanished decades ago.

exits.label: Approach the massive oak doors of the keep

nodes.grant: A margin note on secret door releases

nodes.title: The Tribunal of Porters
nodes.brief: You swallow your rising panic while facing the tribunal of silent porters, winning a sealed clearance stamp.
nodes.page:
Silence fills the vaulted chamber where the grey-faced porters stand in rigid rows, their lantern-jaws set like iron wedges against intruders. Every breath smells of damp ballast and old grease, thick enough to chew, while your bruised shoulder throbs in rhythm with the distant dripping of subterranean water. You force your boots to stay flat upon the flags, refusing to let the trembling in your knees betray the panic clawing at your throat.

One of the senior examiners steps forward, peering past your soot-stained coat with eyes like cold rivets, waiting for a permit that was never issued.

exits.label: Face the silent porters without flinching

nodes.title: Waiting the Inspection
nodes.brief: You swallow your rising panic while facing the tribunal of silent porters, winning a sealed clearance stamp.
nodes.page:
Cold sweat traces a slow line down your temple, mixing with the grime of the coal-scuttle and the grease of the engine deck. The porters do not speak among themselves, communicating only through the sharp clicking of brass pocket-watches and the subtle shifts of their lantern-poles against the flagstones. You keep your good hand resting casually near your pocket where the heavy brass valve-key rests, feeling its cold contour bite reassuringly through the canvas lining.

The lead examiner taps a thick iron ledger twice with a stubby finger, demanding your clearance without uttering a single syllable above the hiss of steam.

exits.label: Step closer to the waiting ledger

nodes.title: Holding Your Ground
nodes.brief: You swallow your rising panic while facing the tribunal of silent porters, winning a sealed clearance stamp.
nodes.page: A bead of dark sweat rolls into your eye as the tribunal leans forward in unison, their scrutiny pressing down upon you like the weight of a loaded coal-tender on a steep grade. You breathe in the stale, underground air, tasting the copper tang of fear, and force your jaw to lock tight against the urge to stammer or step backward into the gloom. Every muscle in your torso aches from the earlier breach, yet you force your hands still while the senior examiner reaches for the red ink-stamp and the wooden handle of the seal.

check.label: Maintain steady nerve before the tribunal

nodes.title: The Cost of Hesitation
nodes.brief: You swallow your rising panic while facing the tribunal of silent porters, winning a sealed clearance stamp.
nodes.page: Your nerve cracks under the relentless, silent weight of their gaze, and a sudden flinch of your shoulder betrays the pain of your torn coat. The lead examiner notices the microscopic shudder, a cynical twitch of a grey mustache marking your weakness before the ink hits the pad. They stamp your waybill with a crooked strike, smudging the red wax and scrawling a punitive surcharge across the margin that will cost you half your remaining rations of dry biscuit. You stagger back a half-pace, nursing your throbbing arm while the porters slowly part to let you pass deeper into the vaults.

exits.label: Accept the flawed pass and move onward

nodes.title: The Stamped Clearance
nodes.brief: You swallow your rising panic while facing the tribunal of silent porters, winning a sealed clearance stamp.
nodes.page: The brass stamp falls with a dull final thud that echoes off the limestone arches. The ink is wet and smells of bitter vinegar, but the red emblem of passage is unmistakably complete across the face of your waybill. The lead examiner grunts once - a sound more like a bellows clearing its throat than human speech - and shoves the paper back across the greasy mahogany. You snatch it up before the drying ink can smear, slipping the precious authorization into your breast pocket alongside the warmth of the boiler-iron.

nodes.title: The Stationmaster General
nodes.brief: Inside the circular chamber beyond the gate, a tiny woman in a braided coat sits behind a mahogany ticket counter.
nodes.page:
Beyond the vaulted corridor lies a circular chamber lit by a single sputtering arc-lamp suspended from a rusted iron chain. Inside sits a tiny woman wrapped in layers of braided wool and an ancient stationmaster coat that swallows her frail frame entirely. Her desk is a fortress of leather-bound ledgers, brass telegraph keys, and half-burned tallow candles that cast long, dancing shadows across the damp walls. She does not look up as you approach, her dry fingers steadily turning yellowed pages filled with microscopic timetables written in violet ink.

The air here smells of very old paper, peppermint tea, and the sweet, heavy scent of burning tallow, completely removed from the soot and iron of the tracks outside.

nodes.title: The Bureaucrat's Domain
nodes.brief: The Tribunal Desk: The Stationmaster-General awaits your arrival with an ink-stained ledger and a cold, measuring eye.
nodes.page: The Stationmaster-General's desk occupies the exact center of the stone rotunda, surrounded by silent tunnels that branch off into the black heart of the mountain. Every surface is buried under drifts of railway warrants, unclaimed baggage tags, and dead chronometers ticking at different speeds. The old woman finally raises her chin, revealing eyes milky with age but sharp enough to pin you like a butterfly specimen to a cork board.

exits.label: Stare down the ancient bureaucrat without blinking
Forge an appropriate entry in the margin
Claim the Water Key from the counter

nodes.title: The Chronometer's Heart
nodes.brief: You adjust the clockwork mechanism of her massive desk chronometer until it chimes true, gaining an official timetable pass.
nodes.page:
You reach across the cluttered mahogany and slide your fingers into the open brass housing of the master clock that governs the chamber's sluggish pulse. Its gears are fouled with dried oil and fine grey ash that drifted down through the ventilation grates from the surface steppes. With delicate care, you nudge the eccentric cam back into alignment, listening as the erratic rhythm smooths out into a steady, authoritative tick-tock that vibrates through the floorboards. The Stationmaster-General watches your hands with a look of grudging respect, her thin lips parting slightly as the brass works finally strike the true hour.

She slides an official timetable pass across the blotter, nodding once to acknowledge your handiwork.

exits.label: Return to the central desk hub

nodes.title: Tuning the Master Clock
nodes.brief: You adjust the clockwork mechanism of her massive desk chronometer until it chimes true, gaining an official timetable pass.
nodes.page: The main balance wheel shudders violently beneath your fingertips as you try to catch the timing pin while the heavy drive-spring remains under full tension. A single slip will strip the bronze teeth or send a shower of hot mainspring shrapnel into your knuckles, leaving you crippled in the dark beneath the mountains. You hold your breath, squinting through the gloom at the grease-blackened cogs, and time your push against the backlash of the vibrating escapement. The metal groans under your touch as you ease the regulator lever toward the true mark.

nodes.title: A Broken Tooth
nodes.brief: You adjust the clockwork mechanism of her massive desk chronometer until it chimes true, gaining an official timetable pass.
nodes.page: The escape wheel skips a tooth with a sharp, metallic ping that rings like a pistol shot in the small vault. A stinging graze across your knuckles draws a dark line of blood that drips directly onto the brass casing, fouling the delicate mechanism even further with sticky warmth. The Stationmaster-General lets out a dry, rattling sigh of disappointment and slides a repair chit across the desk that you will honor later with an hour of coal-shoveling. You suck your bleeding knuckle, cursing the sudden backlash under your breath while the clock stumbles on in its uneven rhythm.

exits.label: Gather your tools and return to the desk

nodes.title: The Timetable Pass
nodes.brief: You adjust the clockwork mechanism of her massive desk chronometer until it chimes true, gaining an official timetable pass.
nodes.page: Tick by tick the chronometer settles into a deep even beat that meets the subterranean keeper's exacting standards. As she hands over the stamped timetable pass, a folded slip of blue dispatch paper falls from between her ledger leaves and flutters onto your sleeve. It bears Hesper Quill's unmistakable cramped handwriting, noting a coal-loading requisition logged only three hours ago at the abandoned siding further down the line. You pocket the scrap quickly before she notices, realizing with a start that your missing driver is still somewhere ahead of you in the dark.

exits.label: Return to the central desk hub

nodes.title: The Paper-Ruler's Desk
nodes.brief: You stare down the ancient bureaucrat without blinking until she stamps your waybill, earning a cup of hot chicory.
nodes.page:
Parchment dust hangs thick in the air of the sub-vault, smelling faintly of dried ink and old damp mortar. Behind an enormous kneehole desk of scarred mahogany sits the clerk of the registry, her spectacles pinned to the tip of her nose by a brass screw-bridge. She does not look up as you approach, her quill scratching a dry, rhythmic dirge against ledger paper that has yellowed since the Long Fire. You lay your travel warrants upon the blotter, the edges charred and smelling of coal gas.

Without breaking the scrape of her nib, she taps the corner of a document with her thumbnail and demands proof of clearance through the lower bypass. You stare down the ancient bureaucrat without blinking until she stamps your waybill, earning a cup of hot chicory.

exits.label: Take the warm mug and proceed onward

nodes.title: Bitter Brew and Ink
nodes.brief: You stare down the ancient bureaucrat without blinking until she stamps your waybill, earning a cup of hot chicory.
nodes.page:
The chicory is thick, dark, and tastes overwhelmingly of roasted root and iron filings, scalding the tongue just enough to cut through the subterranean chill. Across the narrow iron table, the old clerk dips her steel pen once more into a horn inkwell, the greenish fluid catching the pale light of an acetylene lamp. She watches you over the rims of her thick lenses with eyes like two dried sloes, weighing whether your presence here is a nuisance or a breach of protocol. You set the heavy tin cup down upon the grease-stained wood with a faint clink.

The steam from the mug curls toward the low brick ceiling, dissolving into the greasy soot that coats every surface down in the Hollow Cut. She folds her hands over the ledger and nods toward the narrow service hatch cut into the rear stone wall.

exits.label: Step through the low service hatch

nodes.title: Staring Down the Ledger
nodes.brief: You stare down the ancient bureaucrat without blinking until she stamps your waybill, earning a cup of hot chicory.
nodes.page: The silence in the vaulted office stretches thin enough to snap, broken only by the distant, rhythmic throb of subterranean water pumps somewhere deep beneath the floorboards. Her gaze is rusted iron, testing every ounce of your resolve to see if you will flinch first under the scrutiny of the line's eternal accountants. Shoulders square, jaw locked, you fight the urge to fidget with the brass valve-key resting inside your coat pocket. Every tick of the wall clock sounds like a hammer striking an anvil as you hold her stare across the ink-stained grain of the mahogany desk.

nodes.title: The Price of a Staredown
nodes.brief: You stare down the ancient bureaucrat without blinking until she stamps your waybill, earning a cup of hot chicory.
nodes.page:
Your eyelids flutter against your will, a microscopic betrayal that the ancient clerk catches instantly with a triumphant twitch of her thin mouth. She marks a sharp red cross across your travel papers with a vicious stroke of her nib, declaring your credentials insufficient for passage through the lower conduits. The reprimand costs you precious minutes and leaves a dull, throbbing ache behind your temples as she forces you to wait while she painstakingly re-logs every entry from scratch. You bite back the hot retort rising in your throat, knowing that anger here only feeds the bureaucratic machinery.

By the time she finally shoves the papers back across the blotter, your nerves are frayed and your uniform jacket smells heavily of stale soot and defeat. You gather your gear with stiff fingers and turn away from the desk into the damp gloom of the corridor.

nodes.title: The Stamp of Approval
nodes.brief: You stare down the ancient bureaucrat without blinking until she stamps your waybill, earning a cup of hot chicory.
nodes.page:
The heavy rubber stamp descends with a resounding thud that makes the inkpot jump, leaving a crisp, violet seal squarely across your transit manifest. A dry papery sigh escapes the ancient clerk as she slides the authorized papers back into your palm. She reaches beneath the ledger and pushes a small, grease-stained brass token across the wood toward your knuckles, her expression remaining as unreadable as a slab of basalt. It is a quiet concession from a system that rarely gives anything away for free.

You tuck the token into your breast pocket beside your watch, feeling its cold metal weight settle against your ribs as a silent shield against future disputes. The path ahead opens up between two rows of dormant signal levers, waiting for your boots.

exits.label: Follow the corridor to the junction

nodes.title: Marginalia and Conspiracies
nodes.brief: You forge an appropriate entry in the margin of the station log to match her rules, securing a master telegraph code-card.
nodes.page:
The margin of the station log is wide and yellowed, offering a convenient blank strip of paper just beneath an outdated regulation regarding boiler pressures. You dip a stubby steel pen into the dark ink and carefully mimic the spidery, looping hand of the chief dispatcher, adding a brief annotation that validates your unscheduled stop. Every stroke must match the old ink's dull grey fade so the falsification passes muster under the dim light of the corridor lamps. You blot the fresh script with a scrap of flannel, blowing gently across the page until the wet sheen vanishes into the coarse grain.

With the altered register safely closed and returned to its proper rack, you lift a master telegraph code-card from the sorter and slip it into your palm. The printed dots and dashes outline the secret bypass frequencies used only by the old guard before the Barons took the line.

exits.label: Carry the code-card toward the platform

nodes.title: Falsifying the Dispatch
nodes.brief: You forge an appropriate entry in the margin of the station log to match her rules, securing a master telegraph code-card.
nodes.page: The nib scratches nervously against the dry parchment as you attempt to replicate the precise, looping flourish of the long-dead stationmaster's signature. A single drop of ink threatens to pool too heavily in the crook of an uppercase letter, menacing the entire fabrication with one black smudge. You hold your breath, steadying your hand while the distant rumble of an approaching coal train vibrates through the damp masonry of the wall. If the stroke looks too fresh or the angle of the crossbar misses its mark, the entire logbook will be flagged before the shift ends.

nodes.title: Smudged Ink and Scrutiny
nodes.brief: You forge an appropriate entry in the margin of the station log to match her rules, securing a master telegraph code-card.
nodes.page:
The pen slips at the final loop, leaving an ugly, blotched tail that smears across the official seal like a crushed beetle. The clerk spots the error immediately, her nose wrinkling in disgust as she pulls the ledger back toward her chest with a sharp snap of her wrists. You spend the next hour standing in the damp draft of the sorting room while she drafts a formal reprimand, docking your supply rations and leaving you with a stinging ink-stain on your thumb that will not scrub out. The delay eats deep into your dwindling margin against the approaching ash-storm season.

When she finally waves you away with the back of her hand, your patience is worn paper-thin and your fingers ache from the chill. You slip out of the wicket before she can change her mind again, nursing your bruised pride down the tracks.

exits.label: Push onward through the damp archway

nodes.title: A Forger's Margin
nodes.brief: You forge an appropriate entry in the margin of the station log to match her rules, securing a master telegraph code-card.
nodes.page:
The stroke holds true, drying into an indistinguishable match with the decades-old ink around it, blending seamlessly into the bureaucratic history of the line. The altered register sits innocently upon the rack and guards your passage without raising a single alarm among the clerks. You slide the master telegraph code-card into your pocket alongside your pocket-watch, feeling its stiff pasteboard edges reassure your confidence. It is a subtle tool, granting you the ability to speak in the dead language of the old signalmen.

You leave the small office behind without looking back, your boots striking the iron plates of the floorboards with a clear, steady rhythm. The way ahead is clear of immediate obstruction, drawing you deeper into the subterranean heart of the Cut.

exits.label: Step out toward the main tracks

nodes.title: The Keep of the General
nodes.brief: The Stationmaster-General slides the Water Key across the counter and points toward the final bulkhead doors.
nodes.page:
Beyond the final set of iron swing-doors lies the private sanctum of the Stationmaster-General, a vast octagonal vault where hundreds of pocket-watches tick in unison against the stone walls. In the centre of the chamber stands the ancient woman herself, draped in grease-stained velvet and propped on a brass conductor's staff. She watches your approach with cloudy, cataract-filmed eyes that have seen every engine that ever ran the Iron Road since the first rail was spiked. She offers no greeting, reaches beneath her skirts, and lifts the brass valve-key from its velvet recess on a mahogany pedestal.

The Stationmaster-General slides the Water Key across the counter and points toward the final bulkhead doors with the tip of her staff. The metal chatters against the polished wood and stops inches from your knuckles, cold brass for the locked city ahead. She offers no explanation for Hesper's disappearance, only a low, rattling wheeze that sounds remarkably like a steam valve blowing off pressure.

exits.label: Take the key and approach the bulkhead

nodes.title: The Final Siding
nodes.brief: The Final Siding: A battery of steam winches and control levers lines the wall beneath a colossal iron bulkhead door.
nodes.page:
Iron swing-doors rise above the tracks, flanked by steam winches and thick brass control levers that hiss in the gloom. The massive bulkhead door bears deep scoring marks where decades of heavy chains have dragged across its face. Steam hangs low in the vaulted chamber, smelling faintly of sulfur and stale machine oil. Every path forward demands a firm hand on the machinery or a sharp eye for the hidden latches that bar the way to Cinderfall.

Several options present themselves along the stone wall, each promising a different method to clear the barrier before the storm clock runs down.

nodes.title: Winch Motor Overhaul
nodes.brief: You overhaul the winch motor until the heavy steel gears mesh with smooth precision, securing a can of fine clock-oil.
nodes.page:
Thick grease coats your fingers as you strip away the inspection plate of the primary winch motor, revealing rows of cogs choked with fine grey ash. A soft metallic rattling echoes from deep within the iron casing whenever the secondary shaft turns. You set to work with a brass-bristled brush, scrubbing away the grime until the teeth gleam in the dim lamplight. The steel gears mesh with smooth precision once more and purr like a caged animal as the internal tension winds taut.

Satisfied with the alignment, you reach for a small tin of fine clock-oil tucked behind the housing, lubricating the bronze bearings until they spin silently. A cool draft from the upper ventilation shafts stirs the hair at the back of your neck, reminding you that time is slipping away. You stow the oil can in your pocket and turn your attention toward the next junction in the cold stone passage.

exits.label: Advance down the narrow side passage

nodes.title: The Greased Cogs
nodes.brief: You overhaul the winch motor until the heavy steel gears mesh with smooth precision, securing a can of fine clock-oil.
nodes.page:
Narrow iron steps lead upward alongside the secondary winch housing, slick with a film of condensation and fine coal dust. Every movement means you keep one hand locked on the cold handrail to avoid slipping against the jagged masonry of the tunnel wall. Below you, the great brass gears continue their rhythmic turning, throwing long, skeletal shadows across the arched ceiling. The air grows warmer here, carrying the sharp tang of hot axle-grease and burning friction tape from some hidden circuit overhead.

You pause on the landing to wipe your palms on your trousers, listening to the muffled ticking of pocket-watches echoing from the Stationmaster-General's distant sanctum. The metalwork here is older, riveted plates bolted together by hands that have long since turned to dust in the ash-dunes. A faint click resonates through the floorboards, signaling that the machinery ahead is waiting for your touch.

nodes.title: Tuning the Governor
nodes.brief: You overhaul the winch motor until the heavy steel gears mesh with smooth precision, securing a can of fine clock-oil.
nodes.page: Delicate brass counterweights hang from the governor arms like tiny pendulums, swaying erratically as the steam pressure surges through the supply pipes. A slight misalignment in the linkage threatens to throw the entire winch assembly into a destructive spin that could shear the main drive teeth. You press your thumb against the vibrating rocker arm, trying to gauge the precise tension required to bring the governor back into harmony with the engine rhythm. The metal grows scorching hot beneath your skin, stinging sharply, but you keep your focus fixed on the tiny adjustment screw.

nodes.title: A Scorched Slip
nodes.brief: You overhaul the winch motor until the heavy steel gears mesh with smooth precision, securing a can of fine clock-oil.
nodes.page: A sudden surge of scalding steam spits from the loose gasket, forcing your hand back with a sharp hiss of pain that leaves your palm red and throbbing. The governor arm whips sideways with a metallic shriek, striking the stone wall and showering the floor with sparks. You bite back a curse, cradling your injured hand against your chest while the winch motor grinds to a noisy, uneven halt. Valuable time slips through your fingers like dry ash, and the lingering ache in your skin will remind you of this careless slip for days to come.

exits.label: Gather your tools and press on

nodes.title: The Well-Oiled Cogs
nodes.brief: You overhaul the winch motor until the heavy steel gears mesh with smooth precision, securing a can of fine clock-oil.
nodes.page: The stubborn valve finally gives way with a deep, resonant click, settling into a perfect equilibrium as the steam pressure stabilizes throughout the mechanism. The machinery now ticks with an even reliable rhythm that eases your tired nerves. You wipe the sweat from your forehead, leaving a dark smudge across your brow, and pocket the small prize left behind by the repair.

exits.label: Return to the main siding hub

nodes.title: The Hissing Pipe
nodes.brief: You bear the biting lash of escaping high-pressure steam without flinching, winning a thick leather asbestos mitten.
nodes.page:
White plumes of high-pressure steam erupt from a fractured union joint, filling the narrow corridor with a blinding, roaring fog. You crouch low against the damp stone floor, letting the worst of the scalding blast pass overhead while the smell of hot iron fills your lungs. The fierce heat radiates outward from the rupture, baking the moisture from your skin and turning the air dense and hard to breathe. Through the swirling white haze, the outline of the secondary control valve gleams dimly like a drowned moon.

Moving with deliberate care, you inch forward through the dense vapor, keeping your shoulder pressed against the cold rock to maintain your bearings. The steady thrum of the engine vibrates through the soles of your boots, grounding you against the disorienting hiss of the leak. You reach out blindly into the damp heat, feeling for the cold metal wheel of the safety shut-off.

nodes.title: Beyond the Valve
nodes.brief: You bear the biting lash of escaping high-pressure steam without flinching, winning a thick leather asbestos mitten.
nodes.page:
The steam thins into a wet drizzle as your fingers close around the ribbed rim of the shut-off valve, turning it through stubborn layers of rust and scale. A final, shuddering gasp echoes through the pipework as the pressure drops, leaving behind an eerie, dripping silence in the tunnel. You shake the moisture from your sleeves and peer into the gloomy alcove revealed by the clearing fog. An abandoned worker's station sits half-buried in grey ash, its wooden desktop cluttered with discarded ledgers and broken tallow candles.

You pause to examine the faded ink marks on the nearest page, wondering what hurried hand abandoned the logbook mid-sentence. The silence of the Hollow Cut presses down heavily, broken only by the distant, rhythmic ticking of the Stationmaster-General's watches. You pocket a thick leather asbestos mitten left hanging on a rusted peg before turning back toward the main junction.

nodes.title: Facing the Blast
nodes.brief: You bear the biting lash of escaping high-pressure steam without flinching, winning a thick leather asbestos mitten.
nodes.page: The ruptured joint blows wide open with a deafening screech, unleashing a solid wall of searing vapor that threatens to engulf your head and shoulders. Panic claws at your throat, urging you to leap backward into the safety of the dark tunnel, but retreating now would leave the line crippled. You lock your jaw against the mounting heat, forcing your eyes to stay open through the blinding white glare as you reach directly into the heart of the scalding storm.

nodes.title: A Burned Palm
nodes.brief: You bear the biting lash of escaping high-pressure steam without flinching, winning a thick leather asbestos mitten.
nodes.page: The searing blast catches your unprotected wrist before you can wrench the valve shut, searing the skin with a bright, throbbing agony. You stumble backward into the gloom, clutching your scorched arm as the hot mist settles into a steady, mocking drip. The pain is a sharp, constant companion now, slowing your reactions and draining your reserves as you tend to the angry red welt. Though you survived the rush of pressure, the carelessness leaves you weaker for the trials still waiting down the line.

nodes.title: The Asbestos Guard
nodes.brief: You bear the biting lash of escaping high-pressure steam without flinching, winning a thick leather asbestos mitten.
nodes.page: Your gloved hand absorbs the worst of the punishing heat, allowing you to force the stubborn valve home with a single, brutal twist of your wrist. The steam line is sealed at last, and the corridor is safe to traverse. You peel off the stiff protective gear, finding a useful token left behind by the old maintenance crews.

exits.label: Head back to the control hub

nodes.title: The Bulkhead Markings
nodes.brief: You decode the secret sequence marked on the bulkhead wheel rims, earning the iron combination ring.
nodes.page:
Dim amber lamps flicker along the grease-slicked walls of the tunnel and cast long, wavering shadows across the steel doors. Fine soot settles on your collar as you lean close to inspect the rusted wheel rims of the bulkhead. Indented into the cold metal are tiny, interlocking notches and faint, hand-punched tallies left by generations of signalmen. Your fingers trace the worn grooves, feeling the distinct pattern of a forgotten lock sequence hidden within the soot.

The air tastes of stale iron and damp coal dust, pressing heavily against your eardrums as the distant rumble of the engine reverberates through the rock. You must interpret the code before the accumulating pressure forces a shift in the locking tumblers.

exits.label: Decipher the notched sequence on the wheel rims

nodes.title: Decoding the Tumblers
nodes.brief: You decode the secret sequence marked on the bulkhead wheel rims, earning the iron combination ring.
nodes.page: Cold sweat beads on your forehead as you align the rusted wheel rims, matching the sequence notched into the bulkhead against the fading memory of Hesper's logbook. A sudden tremor shakes the rock above, and a shower of grit rattles down your collar, threatening to throw your alignment out by a hair's breadth. With the heavy locking bar trembling under the immense weight of the water-works behind it, you must commit your weight and wits to the final adjustment.

check.label: Decipher the sequence on the wheel rims

nodes.title: A Slip of the Hand
nodes.brief: You decode the secret sequence marked on the bulkhead wheel rims, earning the iron combination ring.
nodes.page: The iron rim slips from your grease-slicked fingers with a sharp clang, bites into your palm, and opens a jagged, bleeding graze across the heel of your thumb. Time slips away as the lock jams tight with a protesting shriek of dry metal, and you hammer the stubborn pins back into place with the flat of a spanner. The delay costs you precious minutes and leaves your hand throbbing with a dull, persistent ache, but the mechanism finally yields to your persistence.

exits.label: Proceed through the jammed bulkhead doors

nodes.title: The Iron Combination Ring
nodes.brief: You decode the secret sequence marked on the bulkhead wheel rims, earning the iron combination ring.
nodes.page: Your fingers lock the final wheel rim into place with a satisfying, deep-throated click that echoes down the damp stone corridor. The iron mechanism yields at last and slides into its housing, showing a hidden recess that holds a stamped metal ring. You slip it into your pocket, feeling the cold weight of the tool as proof of your success.

exits.label: Approach the final siding and winches

nodes.title: The Tangled Cable
nodes.brief: You clear the jammed cable drum with a flurry of wrench-work and oily rags, keeping a length of braided steel cable.
nodes.page: Coils of rusted steel cable litter the damp floor around the auxiliary winch drum, snarled into a dense, unyielding bird's nest that blocks the line. You drop to your knees in the grit, wiping sweat and coal dust from your eyes as you examine the tangled strands. Every tug brings a shower of fine grey ash from the low ceiling, coating your sleeves and filling the air with the dry taste of the steppe.

exits.label: Clear the tangled cable from the drum

nodes.title: The Oily Rags
nodes.brief: You clear the jammed cable drum with a flurry of wrench-work and oily rags, keeping a length of braided steel cable.
nodes.page: Heavy canvas rags soaked in machine oil lie discarded near the rusted winch frame, smelling strongly of petroleum and old heat. You gather them up, using the slick fabric to scour the crusted grime from the rotating axle and the jammed gear teeth. The metal groans under your ministrations, shedding layers of black scale as the moving parts begin to slip free of their long confinement.

exits.label: Scour the rusted axle and gear teeth

nodes.title: Clearing the Jam
nodes.brief: You clear the jammed cable drum with a flurry of wrench-work and oily rags, keeping a length of braided steel cable.
nodes.page: You wedge the steel wrench into the stubborn gears while your other hand hauls the snarled cable free from the jammed drum. The rusted line groans under the sudden tension, threatening to whip back and shatter your knuckles against the stone wall if the teeth slip. With every muscle in your back corded against the strain, you throw your weight onto the lever.

check.label: Clear the jammed cable drum with tools

nodes.title: A Snapped Strand
nodes.brief: You clear the jammed cable drum with a flurry of wrench-work and oily rags, keeping a length of braided steel cable.
nodes.page: A sudden, vicious snap echoes through the chamber as the rusted cable gives way under the strain, whipping across your forearm and tearing a jagged line through your sleeve. Warm blood wells up through the torn wool, mixing with the greasy soot on your skin as you curse your haste. You are left with a stinging, superficial welt and a tangled mess of wire, but the drum is finally free to turn.

exits.label: Gather the remaining braided steel cable

nodes.title: Clearing the Cable Drum
nodes.brief: You clear the jammed cable drum with a flurry of wrench-work and oily rags, keeping a length of braided steel cable.
nodes.page: Working with frantic precision, you drive the stubborn wedge clear of the jammed cable drum, your knuckles scraping raw against the iron housing as grease and soot smear your forearms. The screeching machinery finally yields with a heavy, protesting sigh, freeing a length of braided steel cable that you coil carefully and tuck into your canvas kit as a hard-earned keepsake of the ordeal.

exits.label: Pull the heavy iron release lever

nodes.title: The Ticker Tape
nodes.brief: You decipher the telegraph ticker tape to find the safe operating pressure, securing a roll of insulation tape.
nodes.page: A narrow ribbon of paper spills endlessly from the brass housing of the telegraph ticker on the wall, covered in jagged dashes of blue ink. You catch the end of the tape, letting the dry paper slide between your thumb and forefinger as you decode the rhythmic pulse of the line. The numbers spell out the fluctuating steam pressures of the mountain locks ahead, warning of narrow margins and dangerous heat thresholds.

exits.label: Decipher the telegraph ticker tape sequence

nodes.title: The Insulating Roll
nodes.brief: You decipher the telegraph ticker tape to find the safe operating pressure, securing a roll of insulation tape.
nodes.page: Rusted pipes hiss softly in the gloom overhead, venting hot steam into the cramped stone passage and fogging your spectacles with greasy moisture. You reach into the wall-locker and pull out a thick, fibrous roll of treated fabric tape, smelling faintly of tar and old asbestos. It is designed to wrap leaking joints and shield delicate linkages from the biting corrosive draft of the tunnel.

exits.label: Secure the roll of insulation tape

nodes.title: Reading the Line
nodes.brief: You decipher the telegraph ticker tape to find the safe operating pressure, securing a roll of insulation tape.
nodes.page: Your eyes scan the rapidly advancing ink patterns on the paper tape, searching for the exact moment the pressure drops enough to risk opening the bypass valve. The telegraph key chatters frantically beside your ear, tapping out hurried warnings from the automated signal boxes deeper in the rock. You calculate the tolerance of the feed pipes, your fingers hovering over the control lever as the needle creeps toward the red line.

check.label: Decipher the ticker tape pressure warning

nodes.title: Scorched Fingers
nodes.brief: You decipher the telegraph ticker tape to find the safe operating pressure, securing a roll of insulation tape.
nodes.page: A sudden surge of scalding steam blasts from the nearby pipe joint just as your hand reaches for the valve, catching your fingers before you can jerk them back. The hot moisture leaves your skin pink and tender, throbbing with a sharp, stinging pain that makes it difficult to grip your tools. You press on regardless, binding the burn with a strip of cloth and keeping your eyes fixed on the dials.

exits.label: Proceed with the insulated pressure valves

nodes.title: The Insulating Roll
nodes.brief: You decipher the telegraph ticker tape to find the safe operating pressure, securing a roll of insulation tape.
nodes.page:
Cool digits unfurl the damp telegraph ticker tape until the ink patterns align into a coherent sequence of pressure readings. Relieved by the sudden drop in tension, your fingers wrap around a thick roll of asbestos insulation tape left behind on the brass shelf.

Tucking the prize securely beneath your heavy canvas belt, you turn away from the clacking machine and step back toward the main chamber.

nodes.title: The Final Gates
nodes.brief: Locomotive No. 9 bursts through the final iron gates into the roaring white glare of the Cinderfall approach.
nodes.page:
Locomotive No. 9 surges forward with a deafening roar, smashes through the iron perimeter gates, and showers the frozen platform in sparks and frost. White steam billows into the bitter air as the engine plunges directly into the cavernous approach of Cinderfall.

Massive grey stone walls tower above the tracks and cast long shadows across the trembling boiler while the storm clock tolls its warning overhead.

nodes.title: The Silent Portrait
nodes.brief: You maintain absolute silence before the portrait of the ancient administrator, earning an ivory-handled carriage key.
nodes.page:
Standing motionless before the austere portrait of the ancient administrator, you keep your breathing even and your gaze fixed firmly on the polished brass frame. The painted eyes seem to weigh every past debt and minor trespass before a hidden spring clicks within the mahogany wainscoting.

Sliding your hand into the newly opened recess, your fingers close around an ivory-handled carriage key just as the portrait's oil paint begins to flake in the draught.

nodes.title: Unbolting the Fishplates
nodes.brief: You dismantle the blockade by unbolting the fishplates in correct sequence, securing a box of hardened steel track bolts.
nodes.page:
Kneeling in the freezing ballast, your wrench grips the rusted fishplate bolts with stubborn persistence until the metal groans and gives way. Each rusted fastener is lifted free in precise sequence, allowing you to salvage a sturdy box of hardened steel track bolts without disturbing the surrounding rail.

You sweep soot from your brow, clamp the container against your hip, and ready yourself for the next stretch of line.

nodes.title: Terminus Breach
nodes.brief: Locomotive Nine smashes through the frost-rimed terminus gates, steam screaming from fractured valves as the grey walls of Cinderfall loom under the purple sky.
nodes.page:
Locomotive Nine slams violently against the frost-rimed terminus gates, sending a shockwave through the shivering chassis. Screaming valves vent blinding white plumes of steam into the dim air as the looming grey ramparts of Cinderfall close in under the bruised purple sky.

The iron buffers groan under the sudden impact, holding firm against the charging engine while the storm clock strikes a single, hollow note.

nodes.title: The Iron Basin
nodes.brief: The Iron Basin: The frozen terminus yard lies choked with rusted rolling stock, and the heavy brass levers of the bypass junction are rusted solid in their oily beds.
nodes.page:
Frozen rolling stock chokes the desolate terminus yard like skeletal ribs protruding from grey snow and soot. Brass levers of the bypass junction stand rooted in their icy beds, waiting for a desperate hand to force them.

A bitter wind sweeps across the tracks, rattling loose iron sheets and carrying the distant metallic clatter of approaching authority from the gantry bridges above.

nodes.title: Clearing the Switch
nodes.brief: You force the jammed switch with a heavy grease-bar, risking a scalded arm if the pressure backfires, and secure a spare copper gasket.
nodes.page:
Muscle and grease strain against the stubborn iron switch until the rusted joints finally yield with a sharp, protesting crack. A sudden hiss of backfiring steam licks dangerously close to your sleeve, but you pull back in time and snatch up a spare copper gasket from the ledge.

Pocketing the warm metal ring, you clear the mechanism and look ahead toward the darkening approach.

nodes.title: The Jammed Switch
nodes.brief: You force the jammed switch with a heavy grease-bar, risking a scalded arm if the pressure backfires, and secure a spare copper gasket.
nodes.page: Thick grease slicks your palms as you wedge an iron bar against the rusted pivot of the stubborn siding switch and lean hard into the metal while the steam-lines shriek a warning in your ears. Scalding condensate spits from the joint above, hissing sharply as it spatters against your leather sleeve and threatens to skin your forearm if the back-pressure suddenly snaps the lever. With your teeth clenched hard against the mounting heat, you heave upward once more to force the stubborn wedge home and snatch the spare copper gasket from the trembling groove before the toggle kicks back.

check.label: Heave the greasy iron bar against the jammed slide

nodes.title: Scalded Metal
nodes.brief: You force the jammed switch with a heavy grease-bar, risking a scalded arm if the pressure backfires, and secure a spare copper gasket.
nodes.page:
A blinding burst of superheated steam erupts from the failing joint, searing through your shirtsleeve and biting deep into your forearm with a fiery sting. You jerk your arm back with a sharp intake of breath, clutching the smoking burn as the pressure finally subsides with a sullen groan.

Nursing the throbbing ache, you press onward into the gloom with a fresh scar to remind you of the line's toll.

nodes.title: The Gasket Prize
nodes.brief: You force the jammed switch with a heavy grease-bar, risking a scalded arm if the pressure backfires, and secure a spare copper gasket.
nodes.page:
Despite the narrow margin and the heat licking at your skin, the stubborn iron switch yields at last with a resounding metallic thud. Your fingers close triumphantly around the spare copper gasket resting inside the oily housing, perfectly intact and ready for service.

Stowing the prize safely in your canvas pouch, you leave the steaming machinery behind and press toward the looming shadows.

nodes.title: The Frozen Crank
nodes.brief: You heave your weight against the frozen ballast-crank, straining shoulder-muscles until the mechanism yields, and claim a heavy iron pinch-bar.
nodes.page:
Frost jackets the heavy iron ballast-crank until it resembles an old bone half-buried in grey grit. You set your boot against the rusted sleeper, reach down with mittened fingers, and grip the handle with all your might. The cold seeps straight through the wool into your bones, biting sharply against your recent burns. You haul upward, gritting your teeth as the metal groans in protest against the decades of accumulated soot and ice.

Slowly, grudgingly, the stubborn joint shifts half an inch, showering frozen flakes into the ballast bed. You pull again, feeling the muscles in your shoulder bunch and strain until the stubborn mechanism surrenders with a sharp snap, releasing a cloud of stale vapor from the subsurface pipes.

nodes.title: The Iron Bar
nodes.brief: You heave your weight against the frozen ballast-crank, straining shoulder-muscles until the mechanism yields, and claim a heavy iron pinch-bar.
nodes.page:
Resting within the recess of the ballast-bed lies the prize you freed from the grip of the ice. You drop to one knee in the grit, sweeping away a drift of dry ash to reveal a heavy iron pinch-bar, scarred by slag and pitted with ancient rust. Your fingers close around the cold metal, testing its weight against the pull of gravity. It is thick enough to force any jammed latch or pry open a rusted bypass valve when the need arises.

You tuck the tool securely beneath your leather belt, feeling its solid, reassuring heft press against your hip as you stand back up. The low rumble of the approaching ash-storm hums through the steel rails beneath your boots, urging you onward toward the terminus.

nodes.title: Wrenching the Ballast-Lever
nodes.brief: You heave your weight against the frozen ballast-crank, straining shoulder-muscles until the mechanism yields, and claim a heavy iron pinch-bar.
nodes.page:
The main switch-box is completely choked with impacted slag and frozen condensation, refusing every gentle nudge you offer it. You wedge the heavy iron pinch-bar deep into the rusted fulcrum, bracing your boots against the warped iron ties of the track bed. Every muscle in your back tightens like a coiled spring as you throw your entire body weight against the bar, praying the rusted pin does not shear under the sudden stress.

The metal screams a high, thin note of protest, bending slightly under the strain while the stubborn pivot remains locked fast in its bed of frozen ash.

check.label: Haul hard against the iron bar

nodes.title: A Heavy Cost
nodes.brief: You heave your weight against the frozen ballast-crank, straining shoulder-muscles until the mechanism yields, and claim a heavy iron pinch-bar.
nodes.page: The rusted pin snaps with the crack of a pistol, sending you stumbling backward into the abrasive drifts of the ash-dune. A jagged corner of the broken lever catches your forearm, tearing a long, bleeding gash through your sleeve and staining the grey dust a dark, wet crimson. You pick yourself up from the ground, hissing through your teeth as the bitter cold instantly bites into the fresh wound. Time has slipped through your fingers like dry soot, and the rising shriek of the wind warns you that the storm is drawing closer still.

nodes.title: The Severed Link
nodes.brief: You heave your weight against the frozen ballast-crank, straining shoulder-muscles until the mechanism yields, and claim a heavy iron pinch-bar.
nodes.page:
You throw your weight into the pinch-bar one final time, and however narrowly, the stubborn assembly gives way with a metallic crash that echoes across the quiet yard. The wedge pops free, leaving you staggering slightly in the ash but holding firm to your prize. You wipe the greasy sweat from your brow, leaving a streak of black soot across your forehead as you pocket the tool.

For your trouble, you have pried loose more than just a rusted latch from the dead tracks.

exits.label: Push forward to the iron basin

nodes.title: The Trembling Regulator
nodes.brief: You steady your trembling hands against the chattering regulator, holding your breath through the steam-vent hiss, and recover a dry stub of tallow-wax.
nodes.page:
The cab air smells of scorched oil and stale water, thick enough to coat the back of your throat with a bitter film. You pin your trembling hands against the chattering brass regulator, and the boiler's violent shake runs straight through your palms. Outside the cracked window-glass, the grey world blurs beneath a low, bruised sky that threatens to break open at any second.

You take a slow breath and hold it deep in your chest while the steam-vent hisses a warning rhythm overhead.

nodes.title: The Tallow Stub
nodes.brief: You steady your trembling hands against the chattering regulator, holding your breath through the steam-vent hiss, and recover a dry stub of tallow-wax.
nodes.page:
Wedged behind the pressure gauge rests a dry stub of tallow-wax, forgotten by whoever fled this cab before you. You pick it up between your thumb and forefinger, noting how the grease is hardened by the relentless chill of the high-altitude air. It is not much, but in a world where friction can seize a piston block in minutes, a lump of fat is worth more than a drawer full of paper scrip.

You rub the wax between your palms to soften it slightly before pocketing it in your waistcoat lining, keeping your eyes fixed on the empty track ahead.

nodes.title: Calming the Iron Beast
nodes.brief: You steady your trembling hands against the chattering regulator, holding your breath through the steam-vent hiss, and recover a dry stub of tallow-wax.
nodes.page:
The needle on the primary steam-gauge dances wildly into the red sector, shivering as the pressure threatens to blow the cylinder-heads off the Marrowbone. You have to lock your knees against the rolling deck, reaching out with one hand to ease the main valve without letting the sudden drop starve the pistons. The heat rolls over your face in a suffocating wave, smelling of scorched packing and boiling scale.

Your heart hammers against your ribs like a loose eccentric rod as you inch your fingers toward the vibrating brass handle, waiting for the precise second to make your move.

nodes.title: Scalded Nerves
nodes.brief: You steady your trembling hands against the chattering regulator, holding your breath through the steam-vent hiss, and recover a dry stub of tallow-wax.
nodes.page: A sudden lurch of the engine throws your hand off-mark, and a jet of boiling condensation spits from the packing-gland directly across your knuckles. You pull back with a sharp cry, cradling your burning hand against your chest while the needle hovers dangerously near the pin. The pain flares hot and sharp, leaving you shaken and dizzy in the dim cab light. Valuable minutes tick away as you wait for the trembling in your fingers to subside enough to finish the work.

nodes.title: The Soot-Hardened Will
nodes.brief: You steady your trembling hands against the chattering regulator, holding your breath through the steam-vent hiss, and recover a dry stub of tallow-wax.
nodes.page:
You lock your jaw against the rising panic, and however narrowly, your fingers find the exact balance point on the brass handle. The wild rattling of the needle eases into a rhythmic knock as the pressure settles within safe margins. You let out a long, shuddering breath that clears the last of the foul air from your lungs.

Out here in the ash, cool nerve and focus have won you something worth more than mere time.

nodes.title: Oil in the Dark
nodes.brief: You ignore the screech of tearing iron in the dark sheds, keeping your breathing slow and deliberate, and pocket a small tin of watchmaker's oil.
nodes.page:
Shadows stretch long across the abandoned siding while the screech of tearing iron echoes from the dark sheds. You ignore the metallic shrieking entirely, keeping your breathing slow and deliberate as you reach into the recess of the maintenance locker. Your fingers find a small tin of watchmaker's oil, cold and full of lubricant, and slide it into your breast pocket.

Outside, the wind howls against the blackened chassis, carrying the biting tang of sulphur and stale coal-dust from the terminal yards.

exits.label: Step through to the trembling corridor

nodes.title: Steadying the Nerve
nodes.brief: You ignore the screech of tearing iron in the dark sheds, keeping your breathing slow and deliberate, and pocket a small tin of watchmaker's oil.
nodes.page: Cold sweat bead your forehead as the bulkhead groans under the relentless weight of the mounting steam pressure, threatening to blow the rusted rivets clean out of the frame. You force your trembling lungs to draw deep, quiet draughts of the foul air, centering your racing thoughts against the mounting roar of the furnace. Every instinct screams to leap clear of the scorching metal, but you fix your gaze entirely on the quivering bronze dial, reaching out with absolute stillness to grasp the emergency throttle.

nodes.title: The Price of Hesitation
nodes.brief: You ignore the screech of tearing iron in the dark sheds, keeping your breathing slow and deliberate, and pocket a small tin of watchmaker's oil.
nodes.page: A violent shudder rattles through the deckplates, ripping the grip from your fingers and sending you sprawling hard against the cast-iron firebox door. A jagged corner of the bracket catches your forearm, tearing a long, bleeding gash through your sleeve and leaving a hot smear of crimson across the soot. You pick yourself up from the iron plating with a grimace, nursing the raw wound as the engine settles into an uneven cough. Time has slipped through your fingers like dry ash, and the storm clock ticks closer to its reckoning.

nodes.title: Silence in the Gauge-Room
nodes.brief: You ignore the screech of tearing iron in the dark sheds, keeping your breathing slow and deliberate, and pocket a small tin of watchmaker's oil.
nodes.page: Your fingers find the exact balance point on the brass handle and ease the frantic pressure down until the needle settles back into the safe range. The engine sighs, its rhythmic breathing smoothing out against the cold rails as the danger passes without a major breach. Resting on the ledge beside the pressure gauge is a small, heavy brass washer stamped with the seal of the old Stationmaster-General, left behind by someone who passed this way long before the fires.

nodes.title: Hammer and Wick
nodes.brief: You tap the seized governor-valve with a brass hammer until the needle drops, averting a boiler blowout, and scavenge a bundle of braided wick.
nodes.page: Sharp metallic clangs echo through the cramped cab as you tap the seized governor-valve with a short brass hammer until the stubborn needle drops, averting an imminent boiler blowout. The hot hiss of escaping steam fades to a steady, manageable rumble, leaving the air thick with the smell of boiled grease and heated iron. Rummaging through the supply locker beneath the driver's seat, you scavenge a thick bundle of braided wick, stiff with old grease and ready for the dark miles ahead.

nodes.title: Coals of the Steppe
nodes.brief: You tap the seized governor-valve with a brass hammer until the needle drops, averting a boiler blowout, and scavenge a bundle of braided wick.
nodes.page: Cinders tap against the thick glass of the cab windows like dry fingers seeking entrance from the howling waste outside. You secure the bundle of braided wick in your belt-pouch, running a gloved hand over the damp brass of the instrument panel to test its readiness. The furnace bed glows with a dull, stubborn cherry light, casting long shadows across the deck as the heavy locomotive prepares for the final push toward the walled city.

nodes.title: Adjusting the Governor
nodes.brief: You tap the seized governor-valve with a brass hammer until the needle drops, averting a boiler blowout, and scavenge a bundle of braided wick.
nodes.page: Steam hisses angrily around the threaded joints of the main regulator, coating your knuckles in a film of scalding moisture that threatens to lock the mechanism completely. Both hands clamp the spanner's jaws on the stubborn brass nut while the entire bulkhead shudders under the immense strain of the reserve pressure. A fraction of a turn too far will crack the housing, but too little will leave the pistons starved of power as the engine climbs the final grade.

nodes.title: A Slip of the Spanner
nodes.brief: You tap the seized governor-valve with a brass hammer until the needle drops, averting a boiler blowout, and scavenge a bundle of braided wick.
nodes.page: The wrench slips suddenly with a sharp metallic crack, barking your knuckles against the iron bulkhead and venting a cloud of blinding, white-hot vapor into the cabin. You stumble backward, coughing violently as the stinging mist coats your throat and leaves a bitter taste of burnt oil on your tongue. Though the valve remains half-jammed and the engine labors heavily against its own internal friction, you manage to shut the main feeder before the pressure cuts completely.

nodes.title: The Unlocked Valve
nodes.brief: You tap the seized governor-valve with a brass hammer until the needle drops, averting a boiler blowout, and scavenge a bundle of braided wick.
nodes.page: However narrowly, the spanner bites into the worn thread, and the jammed valve gives way with a deep, shuddering groan that clears the choked lines in a single rush of clean power. The engine responds instantly, its pistons driving with a renewed and steady rhythm that shakes the soot from the roof ribs. Tucked into the recess of the valve-box, you discover a small, folded paper slip bearing a hurried route-code written in Hesper Quill's unmistakable hand.

nodes.title: The Gantry Ultimatum
nodes.brief: Armed rail-guards in grey greatcoats drop from the gantries, demanding the surrender of the Water Key under threat of immediate arrest.
nodes.page: Iron boots ring sharply against the overhead ironwork as armed rail-guards in grey greatcoats drop from the gantries, blocking every escape route from the platform. Their bayonets catch the dim, flickering light of the sulphur lamps, gleaming with a cold, unyielding menace that matches the iron authority of the Barons. They demand the immediate surrender of the Water Key under threat of instant arrest, hands poised near their signal-pistols while the storm clock ticks down above the archway.

nodes.title: The Gantry Watch
nodes.brief: The Gantry Watch: Heavily fortified blockhouses choke the high platforms above the water vaults, and the Baron's guards hold the lower stairs.
nodes.page:
Iron blockhouses loom above the vaulted waterworks and throw long shadows across the grease-slicked platforms where grey-coated guards pace with fixed bayonets. Smoke coils lazily from steam vents, smelling of sulphur and stale oil. Below these high metal terraces, the lower stairs remain choked with restless crowds and patrolled checkpoints, sealing the approaches to the reservoir. You measure the distance between the sentry posts, weighing your options against the ticking storm clock overhead.

Every shadow offers a potential route forward, though each path demands a different toll in nerve and muscle. An upper passage climbs into the dark, a side corridor hides behind a nervous clerk's desk, and the bulkhead doors wait for whoever will force them with iron and muscle.

nodes.title: The Nervous Clerk
nodes.brief: You stand firm under the cold stare of the patrol sergeant, keeping your voice level and polite, and secure a signed transit pass from a nervous clerk.
nodes.page:
Paperwork rustles nervously beneath trembling fingers as you approach the elevated station office tucked behind the main gantry. The patrol sergeant watches from ten paces away, his hand resting heavily on the pommel of an iron truncheon while the pale-faced clerk inside the booth fumbles with ink-stains and ledger books. You keep your expression flat, projecting the dull authority of a man who belongs in these restricted vaults by right of schedule and soot-stained coat.

A brief nod satisfies the younger desk-worker's immediate doubts, prompting him to reach for an official stamp and a blank transit pass. The ink pad clicks into place with a dry, hollow snap that echoes over the distant rumble of the approaching ash-storm.

exits.label: Slide the signed transit pass across the desk

nodes.title: Ink and Iron Nerves
nodes.brief: You stand firm under the cold stare of the patrol sergeant, keeping your voice level and polite, and secure a signed transit pass from a nervous clerk.
nodes.page: Cool air fills your lungs as the sergeant takes a slow step closer, his sharp eyes narrowing behind the tinted lenses of his watch-goggles to scrutinize the freshly stamped paper in your hand. Every muscle in your neck coils tight against the impulse to bolt or reach for a spanner, knowing that a single twitch will bring half a dozen grey-coats down upon your shoulders. You meet his suspicious stare without flinching, pitching your voice into a steady, flat drone that mimics the endless bureaucratic machinery of the Rail Barons. Time seems to stretch thin as the heavy silence hangs between you.

nodes.title: A Fracture of Calm
nodes.brief: You stand firm under the cold stare of the patrol sergeant, keeping your voice level and polite, and secure a signed transit pass from a nervous clerk.
nodes.page: Suspicion flares in the sergeant's eyes too late as a sudden draft catches the damp ink, smudging the forged seal across the bottom of the pass into a greasy purple smear. Heavy iron hands grab your shoulder with bone-crushing force, spinning you around against the steel bulkhead and bruising your ribs against a protruding rivet. They relieve you of the false papers with a sharp, mocking laugh, leaving you with a dull ache in your side and precious minutes squandered in the shadows of the watchtower. Still, the guards push you back toward the platform rather than the cells, giving you another chance to find a way through.

exits.label: Slip back into the shifting platform crowds

nodes.title: The Stamped Passage
nodes.brief: You stand firm under the cold stare of the patrol sergeant, keeping your voice level and polite, and secure a signed transit pass from a nervous clerk.
nodes.page: However narrowly, the sergeant's sharp gaze drifts away as a distant whistle blows from the lower yards, drawing his attention back toward a commotion near the freight hoists. The clerk hastily drops the stamped transit pass onto the wooden counter, eager to clear his desk of trouble before the storm hits. You snatch the paper up before second thoughts can take root, pocketing the official token of passage that clears your path through the inner checkpoints.

nodes.title: The Barricaded Stair
nodes.brief: You shoulder past the barricade before the guards can level their iron poles, absorbing a sharp blow to the ribs, and snatch a heavy key-ring.
nodes.page:
Your iron boots ring against the checkerplate steel as you charge the improvised barricade before the guards can bring their pikes to bear. A sentry lunges forward, catching you a glancing blow to the ribs that drives the breath from your lungs in a hot, ragged gasp. Ignoring the sharp ache in your side, you throw your weight against the timber-and-iron hurdle, sending crates of spare fittings clattering across the walkway.

In the sudden clatter and shouting, your hand brushes a brass key-ring dangling from an unattended hook on the bulkhead. You snatch the iron-ringed prize free just as boots scramble behind you.

nodes.title: Lifting the Iron Gate
nodes.brief: You shoulder past the barricade before the guards can level their iron poles, absorbing a sharp blow to the ribs, and snatch a heavy key-ring.
nodes.page: Thick iron bars block the low drainage tunnel leading directly beneath the main reservoir foundations, rusted solid into their stone sockets over decades of neglect. You wedge your shoulder beneath the lowest crossbar, planting your boots firmly against the greasy concrete floor while the distant thunder of the ash-storm vibrates through the bedrock. Every muscle in your back strains against the freezing cold of the metal, your tendons singing with taut, agonizing tension as you prepare to lift the dead weight of the gate.

check.label: Heave the rusted iron gate upward

nodes.title: The Crushed Hinge
nodes.brief: You shoulder past the barricade before the guards can level their iron poles, absorbing a sharp blow to the ribs, and snatch a heavy key-ring.
nodes.page: Heavy iron slips from your sweat-slicked palms with a sharp screech of grinding scale, dropping the thick gate back into its channel with a bone-jarring thud. The sudden rebound wrenches your shoulder fiercely, leaving a dull, throbbing ache that radiates down your arm as you stumble backward onto the grit-strewn floor. Dust and ancient soot fill the confined space, coating your throat in a dry, bitter taste while you struggle to catch your breath. You stagger to your feet, bruised and nursing a pulled muscle, but the passage remains clear enough to crawl through.

exits.label: Crawl through the low drainage gap

nodes.title: The Heavy Iron Key
nodes.brief: You shoulder past the barricade before the guards can level their iron poles, absorbing a sharp blow to the ribs, and snatch a heavy key-ring.
nodes.page: However narrowly, your muscles hold against the dead weight of the ironwork, and the rusted hinge yields with a sharp, echoing snap that shatters the silence of the dry culvert. The gate tilts upward just enough for you to squeeze through into the inner vaults. A deep scratch marks your forearm, and a prize stays clenched in your fist. An old brass key rests in your grip, notched for the high service locks that only the senior engineers are supposed to carry.

nodes.title: The Tool-Roll Vault
nodes.brief: You wrench the iron mounting bracket from the wall with brute force, shattering the door-lock, and retrieve a heavy leather tool-roll.
nodes.page:
Metal screams against metal as you throw yourself at the wall-mounted bracket, snapping the cast-iron mounting pins like dry twigs. The reinforced cabinet door swings wide with a hollow clang, revealing a rich trove of equipment left behind by fleeing maintenance crews. You plunge your hands into the dark recess, your fingers closing around a thick leather tool-roll filled with heavy spanners, wire ties, and oil-soaked rags.

Footsteps echo heavily up the adjacent iron staircase, warning you that the noise has drawn unwanted attention from the patrolling gangers. You tuck the leather roll securely beneath your arm and move out before the corner can be turned.

exits.label: Slip away down the lower gantry

nodes.title: The Gantry Transition
nodes.brief: You wrench the iron mounting bracket from the wall with brute force, shattering the door-lock, and retrieve a heavy leather tool-roll.
nodes.page:
High iron walkways stretch out over the yawning abyss of the water vaults like spiderwebs spun from soot and rivet-heads. Below, the great brass pipes of the Cinderfall reservoir pulse with a faint, rhythmic thrum that suggests the ancient machinery is waking up despite the drought. You step lightly across the open grates, keeping close to the shadowed wall where the steam lines hiss softly through cracked insulation.

A lone signal lamp flickers ahead, casting long, amber shadows across a heavy junction box marked with the insignia of the Rail Barons. The air grows noticeably colder here, smelling strongly of ozone and wet coal dust.

nodes.title: Breaking the Seal
nodes.brief: You wrench the iron mounting bracket from the wall with brute force, shattering the door-lock, and retrieve a heavy leather tool-roll.
nodes.page: Thick lead wire seals the inspection hatch of the junction box, stamped with the private crest of the Stationmaster-General to deter unauthorized tampering. You wedge the claw of your spanner beneath the lead disk, plant your boots against the riveted frame, and put your entire upper body behind the leverage point. The metal housing groans under the strain, resisting your push with stubborn, unyielding friction while the storm clock strikes another heavy, hollow note from across the yards.

check.label: Pry open the sealed junction box

nodes.title: The Snapped Claw
nodes.brief: You wrench the iron mounting bracket from the wall with brute force, shattering the door-lock, and retrieve a heavy leather tool-roll.
nodes.page: The tool slips off the greasy lead seal with a sharp metallic crack, barking your knuckles hard against the sharp edge of the iron casing. A hot trickle of blood mixes with the soot on your hand as you stumble back against the gantry rail, cursing softly in the dim amber light. The heavy junction box remains firmly locked, its lead seal mocking your effort while the lost time ticks away against the approaching storm. You suck on your bleeding knuckles, nursing the sharp sting as you look for another way to force the mechanism.

exits.label: Press onward through the bitter cold

nodes.title: The Iron Bracket
nodes.brief: You wrench the iron mounting bracket from the wall with brute force, shattering the door-lock, and retrieve a heavy leather tool-roll.
nodes.page: Muscle strains against rusted iron as you wrench the mounting bracket from the damp masonry, and the stubborn door-lock shatters with a sharp metallic clatter. Dust and powdered mortar billow into the stale air around your boots, coating your trousers in grey film. Within the splintered recess lies a grease-stained leather tool-roll, untouched by the damp for years. Fingers unbuckle the dry straps and turn up chunky spanners plus a spare valve-needle wrapped in oily rag. You tuck the prize securely beneath your belt, stepping back onto the gantry just as the structural bolts groan in protest.

exits.label: Climb upward toward the gantry watch

nodes.title: Three Heavy Notes
nodes.brief: The sky darkens to the bruised purple of the approaching ash-storm, and the storm clock strikes three heavy notes against the echoing vaults.
nodes.page: Heavy shadows stretch across the damp masonry as the overhead sky darkens to the bruised, sickly purple of the approaching ash-storm. Far above the great reservoir, the massive mechanical storm clock stirs in its iron cage and strikes three notes that roll through the vaults like hammer-blows on an anvil. Dust sifts down from the vaulted ceilings, settling on your shoulders and stinging your eyes in the thin air. The rising pressure of the gale howls through the intake pipes outside, warning that time has nearly run out for the walled city and its silent generators. You grip the railing tighter, bracing against the draft as the subterranean world holds its collective breath.

nodes.title: The Sump-House
nodes.brief: The Sump-House: Sludge-choked drainage tunnels beneath the great reservoir roar with the sound of boiling runoff and escaping steam.
nodes.page: Scalding steam vents from rusted flanges into the darkness, filling the vast chamber with a thick, choking mist that smells of boiled sulfur and old oil. Sludge-choked drainage tunnels beneath the great reservoir roar with the sound of boiling runoff and escaping pressure, shaking the metal walkways beneath your boots. Every shadow seems to shift and breathe in the flickering amber glow of the distant pilot lights. The narrow pathways branch off into the gloom toward churning machinery, hidden alcoves, and steep, greasy ladders disappearing into the upper gloom.

exits.label: Crawl through the narrow drainage culvert
Stare down the twitching pressure gauges
Clear the choked intake grate with a poker
Confront the Cinder Prophets on the stair

nodes.title: The Jammed Sprocket
nodes.brief: You hammer the jammed sluice-chain back onto its sprocket with a heavy brass spanner, risking a crushed knuckle, and win a heavy brass oil-can.
nodes.page: Steam hisses from a cracked elbow joint nearby, wreathing your face in white mist as you crouch beside the sluggish machinery. With a sudden grunt of effort, you swing the brass spanner against the jammed sluice-chain and hammer the links back onto the iron sprocket. A shower of hot sparks flies into the dark bilge-water below, accompanied by the metallic shriek of links biting home.
